project.name: massa-ai
project.description: massa-ai is a local-first MCP server that indexes codebases for semantic search, keyword search, and dependency-ranked symbol graphs, providing persistent cross-session memory of decisions and patterns while reducing the token cost of AI-assisted coding.

nodes.name: create-3072d-table.ts
nodes.summary: One-off Bun CLI script (run directly, not imported) that provisions a vector_documents_3072d PostgreSQL table for 3072-dimension embeddings such as Google Gemini's: ensures the pgvector extension, creates the table plus a project_id index, and prints the resulting column and embedding-dimension metadata for manual verification.
nodes.languageNotes: pgvector's HNSW/IVFFlat indexes cap out at 2000 dimensions, so 3072-d vectors intentionally get no vector index here and fall back to sequential scan for similarity search.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Connects to PostgreSQL via getPgPool, ensures the pgvector extension, creates the 3072-d vector table with a project_id index if missing, and logs the resulting schema and embedding dimension for verification.

nodes.name: _bun-mock-guard.ts
nodes.summary: Shared test-infrastructure guard that detects when Bun's process-global mock.module() registry has been contaminated by sibling test files' stubs (config, symbol repository, ignore-patterns) and exposes describeEtl to skip ETL-driving integration suites with a clear reason instead of crashing on missing mocked methods.
nodes.languageNotes: Bun 1.3.x has no per-file test isolation flag and mock.restore() only undoes mock() spies, not mock.module() registry mutations, so contamination from earlier test files in the same process cannot be cleared at runtime — this guard is a probe-and-skip workaround rather than a real fix.

nodes.name: describeEtl
nodes.summary: Wraps bun:test's describe to skip a suite with a printed reason when MOCK_CONTAMINATED is true, otherwise runs it normally.

nodes.name: capture-policy.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the Capture Policy engine (Wave 5 T15): verifies applyPolicy returns the first matching rule's disposition (else Keep), DEFAULT_POLICY's node_modules-drop / docs-keep behavior, validatePolicy's MAX_IGNORE_PATTERNS and denyUnknownFields enforcement, and that the Policy/Disposition/ApplyPolicyFn types are importable from capture-policy-interfaces.

nodes.name: concurrent-indexing.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the queue-based mutex in ContextualSearchRLM that serializes concurrent indexProject calls per project: serial-execution guarantees, lock-map cleanup, lock release on error, and return-value propagation across many concurrent callers. Restores any mock.module stubs leaked from sibling suites before running and skips on non-native targets via describeNative.

nodes.name: etl-idempotent.test.ts

Uses stubbed pipeline stages to isolate cursor/dedup semantics from the full parse/resolve pipeline.

nodes.summary: Unit tests for isRetriableTransactionError and withDeadlockRetry -- SQLSTATE deadlock/serialization-failure detection via error code or embedded Prisma message text, retry-then-succeed flows, and maxAttempts exhaustion.

nodes.name: db-connection.ts
nodes.summary: Shared PostgreSQL connection pool for the persistence layer -- lazily creates and caches a single pg Pool sized from DB_POOL_SIZE, with a matching close for graceful shutdown.

nodes.name: graph-generation-contract.ts
nodes.summary: Public TypeScript contract for GraphGenerationRepository -- lease lifecycle types (begin/heartbeat/complete/activate/abort/cleanupSuperseded) and outcome unions that PostgreSQL and any future backend implementation must satisfy verbatim.

nodes.name: graph-generation-repository-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Factory returning the singleton GraphGenerationRepositoryPg instance, guarding on a configured Postgres DATABASE_URL before construction.

nodes.name: graph-generation-repository-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL implementation of the graph-generation CAS lease protocol -- begin/heartbeat/complete/activate/abort/cleanupSuperseded -- using row-level FOR UPDATE locking inside Prisma transactions to serialize concurrent ETL generation attempts per project and atomically flip the active generation on activate.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Prisma's $transaction with tagged-template $queryRaw/$executeRaw for row locking (FOR UPDATE) and lease-token compare-and-swap, mirroring managed-run-repository-pg.ts's lease pattern for a different lifecycle (immutable generation snapshot vs. process-writer run).

nodes.name: keyword-search-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Factory providing a cached singleton KeywordSearchPg instance, guarding on a configured Postgres DATABASE_URL and closing the cached instance on reset.

nodes.name: keyword-search-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL full-text keyword search backed by tsvector/GIN indexes, with pg_trgm trigram similarity search and a Levenshtein-based fuzzy-correction vocabulary -- the lexical half of the hybrid search pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: Lazily initializes its connection pool and schema (including a best-effort pg_trgm extension install) on first use, and maintains a process-local LRU cache for fuzzy-correction lookups.

nodes.name: managed-run-contract.ts
nodes.summary: Public TypeScript contract for ManagedRunRepository -- the CAS-lease protocol for indexing/reindex/maintenance runs, combining lease acquire/heartbeat/release with idempotent event_id dedup and resumable FileCursor persistence, decoupled from the immutable graph_generations snapshot.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive doc comments encode the reaper and race-safety invariants (AD-W5-013, AC-22) that the PostgreSQL implementation and its tests must uphold verbatim.

nodes.name: managed-run-repository-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL CAS implementation of ManagedRunRepository for the managed_runs table -- a reaper flips expired active leases to aborted inside the same transaction as a new INSERT, and ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING resolves concurrent begin() races without triggering a Prisma transaction-poisoning unique-violation.
nodes.languageNotes: Mirrors graph-generation-repository-pg.ts's lease pattern but for a process-writer run rather than an immutable snapshot; relies on a partial unique index scoped to status='active' plus query-time expiry filtering since PostgreSQL rejects clock_timestamp() in index predicates.

nodes.name: symbol-repository-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Factory returning the singleton SymbolRepositoryPg instance for the symbol graph, guarding on a configured Postgres DATABASE_URL; reset is a no-op since the underlying PrismaClient connection is managed elsewhere.

nodes.name: hybrid-search.ts
nodes.summary: Combines vector (semantic) and keyword (lexical) search results using Reciprocal Rank Fusion, with additional weighted, boosted, and diversified search variants for tuning ranking behavior.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements RRF (score = sum of 1/(k+rank)) with observed-max normalization to 0-1, falling back to the theoretical ceiling when all scores tie.

nodes.name: postgres-vector-store.ts
nodes.summary: Core pgvector-backed vector store -- creates per-dimension tables and HNSW/IVFFlat indexes, embeds and upserts documents in resilient sub-batches, and searches either directly (cosine similarity, <=2000 dims) or via a two-phase binary-quantization ANN-then-rerank strategy (>2000 dims, e.g. the 4096-dim qwen3 embedding model).
nodes.languageNotes: All write/delete/list operations use raw parameterized SQL instead of Prisma's ORM layer to sidestep a Prisma 7.7.0 + Bun 'isObjectEnumValue is not a function' bug; binary quantization packs each float into a sign bit for Hamming-distance ANN candidate retrieval before an exact cosine re-rank.

nodes.name: vector-store-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Backend-neutral factory that constructs, health-checks, and caches a singleton PostgresVectorStore, reading HNSW/IVFFlat tuning parameters from environment variables and failing fast if the post-init health check doesn't pass within 5 seconds.

nodes.summary: Maps a raw SQL count row into the GenerationCounts shape used by complete/activate outcomes.

nodes.name: GraphGenerationRepositoryPg
nodes.summary: Singleton PostgreSQL implementation of GraphGenerationRepository: begin() acquires a lease via row locking (superseding any expired pending generation first), heartbeat() renews it, complete()/activate() validate completeness and atomically flip the active generation, abort() rolls back a failed attempt, and cleanupSuperseded() garbage-collects orphaned superseded generations.

nodes.summary: Returns a cached singleton KeywordSearchPg instance after confirming a Postgres DATABASE_URL is configured, constructing it lazily on first call.

nodes.name: resetKeywordSearch
nodes.summary: Closes and clears the cached KeywordSearchPg singleton, a no-op when nothing is cached.

nodes.name: KeywordSearchPg
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL full-text keyword search implementation: lazily initializes its connection pool and keyword_documents/keyword_vocabulary tables (with a best-effort pg_trgm install), and exposes tsvector full-text search, filtered search, trigram similarity search, and LRU-cached Levenshtein fuzzy correction alongside standard add/update/delete/clear operations.

nodes.name: validateBegin
nodes.summary: Validates and normalizes a ManagedRun begin() request, bounding projectId/eventId/contentHash length and the lease TTL.

nodes.name: toLease
nodes.summary: Maps a managed_runs row plus lease token into the public ManagedRunLease shape returned by begin().

nodes.name: toActive
nodes.summary: Maps a managed_runs row into the public ActiveManagedRun snapshot shape returned by getActive().

nodes.name: ManagedRunRepositoryPg
nodes.summary: Singleton PostgreSQL CAS implementation of ManagedRunRepository for the managed_runs table: begin() reaps expired active leases then races an ON-CONFLICT-DO-NOTHING INSERT against concurrent acquirers, heartbeat()/updateFileCursor() renew the lease (the latter also persisting a resumable FileCursor), and complete()/abort() terminate the run.

nodes.name: getSymbolRepository
nodes.summary: Returns the SymbolRepositoryPg singleton after confirming a Postgres DATABASE_URL is configured.

nodes.name: resetSymbolRepository
nodes.summary: No-op reset -- the underlying connection is the shared singleton PrismaClient managed elsewhere, not owned by this factory.

nodes.name: HybridSearch
nodes.summary: Fuses vector and keyword search results with Reciprocal Rank Fusion into a single ranked list, and offers weighted-sum, recency/popularity-boosted, and Jaccard-similarity-diversified search variants on top of the same two underlying providers.

nodes.name: PostgresVectorStore
nodes.summary: pgvector-backed IVectorStore implementation: provisions per-dimension tables and HNSW/IVFFlat vector indexes (plus a binary-quantized Hamming index for >2000-dim embeddings), upserts documents in resilient sub-batches with per-document fallback, and searches via direct cosine ranking or a two-phase ANN-then-exact-rerank strategy depending on embedding dimensionality.

nodes.name: PostgresVectorCollection
nodes.summary: IVectorCollection handle scoped to a single project (name), used by IndexManager for _metadata document lookup/persistence; embeds on demand for documents that arrive without a precomputed vector.

nodes.name: getVectorStore
nodes.summary: Constructs, initializes, and health-checks a singleton PostgresVectorStore from environment-configured HNSW/IVFFlat parameters, closing and rejecting it if the health check doesn't pass within 5 seconds; concurrent callers share the same in-flight initialization promise.

nodes.name: resetVectorStore
nodes.summary: Closes and clears the cached PostgresVectorStore singleton, a no-op when nothing is cached.

nodes.name: admin-preservation.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the admin-preservation middleware's exported pure functions, verifying isAdminEndpoint pattern matching (literal, prefix, param, query-strip) and the default 0-user bootstrap state.

nodes.name: architecture-route.test.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP-level test for the GET /api/v1/project/:id/architecture route, asserting the architecture map response shape and query-param handling.

nodes.name: dashboard-route.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration-style HTTP test for the scheduler-status and hook-queue-status dashboard routes, asserting real response shapes without mocking the underlying services.

nodes.name: events-job-filter.test.ts
nodes.summary: Exercises the SSE /api/v1/events endpoint's jobId query filter (Wave 5 FR-16), verifying jobId and projectId compose with AND and that the initial connected event reports both filters.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a custom SseCollector helper class that reads a ReadableStream reader in a loop to buffer and parse newline-delimited SSE frames for assertions.

nodes.name: hook-compact-snapshot-route.test.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level test verifying the POST /api/v1/hook/compact-snapshot endpoint accepts the optional cwd field on the wire without weakening existing sessionId validation.

nodes.name: parser-readiness-health.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for buildHealthResponse and listenAfterParserValidation, covering liveness-vs-parser-readiness separation and the validate-before-listen startup ordering.

nodes.name: search-error-envelope.test.ts
nodes.summary: Verifies the global errorHandler middleware sanitizes both typed SearchServiceError and generic thrown errors into safe JSON envelopes that never leak secrets, including a case that rethrows via the canonical handoff-error path.

nodes.name: startup-config.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests validateApiStartup's rejection of missing, malformed, non-PostgreSQL, and database-less DATABASE_URL values, and its acceptance of a valid PostgreSQL URL.

nodes.name: structural-transport.test.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP-transport tests for the project and workspace routes covering symbol-graph lookups: go-to-definition, ambiguous FQN resolution with candidates, references, project map, and path tracing.

nodes.name: wave-4-transport.test.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP-transport parity tests asserting that activatedGraphGenerationId and ifNoneMatch staleness checks (412 responses) propagate correctly across /api/v1/symbol/* routes, while confirming /api/v1/search/code intentionally excludes them.
nodes.languageNotes: Mocks the @massa-ai/core symbol-repository-factory before importing the route module so the route's closure captures the mocked generation lookup — a module-load-order-sensitive test technique.

nodes.name: web-ui-serve.test.ts
nodes.summary: Verifies the Tools API serves the web-ui static bundle (index shell, CSS, JS, SPA fallback) directly via webUiRoutes.handle, plus a real Node HTTP server boot test using a dynamically allocated TCP port.

nodes.name: health.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the liveness health-check response shape and a startup gate that validates tree-sitter parser readiness before the server begins listening.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Entry point for the massa-ai Tools API: bootstraps the Elysia/Node server, wires every route and middleware module, configures Swagger docs, runs parser-readiness validation before binding the port, and starts the stale-job reaper and in-process job scheduler.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Elysia's chained .use() plugin composition to assemble roughly twenty route modules into a single app instance, plus graceful-shutdown signal handlers and a self-unref'd reaper interval.

nodes.name: admin-preservation.test.ts
nodes.summary: Co-located branch-coverage tests for the admin-preservation middleware: isAdminEndpoint pattern variants, user-count cache hit/miss/reset, and full onBeforeHandle request behavior via a mounted Elysia app.

nodes.name: admin-preservation.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the admin-endpoint preservation ladder that keeps destructive admin routes open during first-run bootstrap (0 users) and defers to API-key auth once users exist, with a short-TTL cache around the user-count check.

nodes.name: auth.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the API-key auth middleware's public-path bypass, dev-mode pass-through when no key is configured, and 401 rejection on missing or invalid x-api-key.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia middleware that validates the x-api-key header against MASSA_AI_API_KEY (skipping public /health and /swagger paths) and derives a minimal ActorContext from the x-actor-id header for audit-log attribution.

nodes.name: error.ts
nodes.summary: Global Elysia error-handler middleware that converts typed SearchServiceError, framework validation/parse errors, and unknown exceptions into standardized, sanitized JSON error envelopes.

nodes.name: analytics.test.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP-level test for POST /api/v1/analytics, asserting the analytics route delegates to GetAnalyticsTool and returns its response through the Elysia handler.

nodes.name: analytics.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia route exposing POST /api/v1/analytics, a thin wrapper that lazily instantiates and delegates to the core GetAnalyticsTool for search analytics and performance metrics.

nodes.name: architecture.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia routes exposing GET /api/v1/project/:id/architecture (architecture map with opt-in aspects like cycle detection) and a companion endpoint listing valid aspect names, mirroring the get_architecture MCP tool over REST.

nodes.name: bootstrap.test.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP-level test for POST /api/v1/bootstrap, verifying the route delegates to the bootstrap service and returns its result.

nodes.name: bootstrap.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia route exposing POST /api/v1/bootstrap, which scans a project's git log, README, docs, and central files to seed idempotent bootstrap memories, gated by a config-driven disabled flag (423) and projectId validation (400).

nodes.name: checkpoints-errors.test.ts
nodes.summary: Error-path coverage for the checkpoint routes, mocking ListCheckpointsTool, CreateCheckpointTool, and RestoreCheckpointTool to throw and asserting each route's catch block returns a sanitized failure envelope.

nodes.name: checkpoints.test.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP-level happy-path test for the checkpoint routes, exercising the real ListCheckpointsTool/CreateCheckpointTool/RestoreCheckpointTool wiring through checkpointRoutes.

nodes.name: checkpoints.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia routes exposing POST /api/v1/checkpoints/{list,create,restore}, thin wrappers with typed request bodies that delegate to the core checkpoint tools and catch failures into a sanitized error envelope.

nodes.name: context.test.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP-level test for the context compress and optimized-context routes, verifying delegation to CompressContextTool and GetOptimizedContextTool.

nodes.name: context.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia routes exposing POST /api/v1/context/compress and /api/v1/context/optimized, thin wrappers delegating to CompressContextTool and GetOptimizedContextTool for semantic context compression and search+compress retrieval.

nodes.name: dashboard.test.ts
nodes.summary: Mocked unit test for the dashboard routes covering per-field job projection and the graceful-degradation catch blocks when the scheduler or hook service throws.

nodes.name: dashboard.ts
nodes.summary: Read-only Elysia routes exposing GET /api/v1/scheduler/status and /api/v1/hooks/queue-status for dashboard observability, each degrading to a safe unavailable response instead of a 500 when the underlying subsystem throws.

nodes.name: events.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia route exposing GET /api/v1/events, a Server-Sent Events stream that relays real-time indexing and workspace events from the process-wide eventBus, with optional projectId/jobId filtering, heartbeats, and auto-close after a max duration.

nodes.name: withCollector
nodes.summary: Test helper that opens an SseCollector against a query string, runs the given async callback while the SSE stream is live, then stops the collector and returns the buffered frames.

nodes.name: SseCollector
nodes.summary: Test helper class that opens the SSE /api/v1/events stream via the mounted Elysia app, reads the ReadableStream reader in a loop, and buffers parsed JSON frames for test assertions.

nodes.name: testApp
nodes.summary: Builds a throwaway Elysia app wired with the real errorHandler and three routes that throw a typed SearchServiceError, a generic Error, and a handoff-corruption error respectively, to exercise the sanitized error envelope.

nodes.name: postJson
nodes.summary: Test helper that issues a JSON POST request against the mounted app and returns the parsed status/body pair, used to assert generation-staleness responses.

nodes.name: allocateTcpPort
nodes.summary: Test helper that binds a temporary net server to port 0 to obtain an OS-assigned free TCP port, then closes it, used to spin up a real Node HTTP server for the web-ui boot test without port collisions.

nodes.name: buildHealthResponse
nodes.summary: Builds the /health liveness response, always reporting status ok while additively surfacing the current tree-sitter parser-readiness snapshot.

nodes.name: listenAfterParserValidation
nodes.summary: Startup gate that awaits parser-grammar validation, invokes an onValidationFailure callback if it throws, and always proceeds to start listening regardless of validation outcome.

nodes.name: getUserCount
nodes.summary: Returns the registered user count; hardcoded to 0 today as a documented seam since no User model exists yet, to be replaced with a real prisma.user.count() query.

nodes.name: isAdminEndpoint
nodes.summary: Checks whether a request path matches an admin-endpoint pattern, supporting exact/prefix matches and :param placeholders converted to regex segments, after stripping the query string.

nodes.name: resetUserCountCache
nodes.summary: Clears the cached user count so the admin-preservation ladder re-evaluates immediately, intended to be called after a user is created.

nodes.name: deriveActor
nodes.summary: Pure function that derives a minimal ActorContext for audit attribution from the optional x-actor-id header, defaulting to actorId 'unknown' when absent, the seam future identity sources (JWT, session) will replace.

nodes.name: post
nodes.summary: Test helper that POSTs a JSON body to the mounted analytics app and returns the parsed status/body pair.

nodes.name: boundedInt
nodes.summary: Parses a query-string value into an integer clamped between min and max, falling back to a default on missing, empty, or non-finite input.

nodes.name: post
nodes.summary: Test helper that POSTs a JSON body to the mounted bootstrap app and returns the parsed status/body pair.

nodes.name: post
nodes.summary: Test helper that POSTs a JSON body to a given checkpoint sub-path and returns the parsed status/body pair, used to assert sanitized error envelopes.

nodes.name: post
nodes.summary: Test helper that POSTs a JSON body to a given checkpoint sub-path against the real checkpointRoutes and returns the parsed status/body pair.

nodes.name: post
nodes.summary: Test helper that POSTs a JSON body to a given context sub-path and returns the parsed status/body pair.

nodes.name: executor.test.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level test suite for the code-execution sandbox endpoints, driving the Elysia app via app.handle() to verify request/response wiring for /execute, /execute_file, and /batch_execute against a mocked ExecutorController.

nodes.name: executor.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia route module exposing the polyglot code-execution sandbox as REST endpoints: run arbitrary code (execute), run code over a file's content (execute_file), and run N shell commands in parallel via run-pool (batch_execute). Local-dev only — code executes on the host as the current user.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a module-level lazily-initialized singleton (getController) mirroring the project's get*() factory convention, backed by ExecutorController.getInstance().

nodes.name: file.test.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level test suite for the file-read endpoint, exercising POST /api/v1/file/read via app.handle() against a mocked ReadFileTool.

nodes.name: file.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia route exposing ReadFileTool as POST /api/v1/file/read: reads a file with optional line-range slicing, automatic compression for content over 100 lines, and symbol-graph metadata enrichment for token-efficient reads.

nodes.name: handoff.test.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level test suite for cross-session handoff endpoints (begin/accept/cancel/list), verifying status-code mapping, disabled-flag gating, the SearchServiceError rethrow, and the rethrowCanonicalHandoffError export directly.

nodes.name: handoff.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia routes implementing cross-session handoffs (begin/accept/cancel/list) so one agent session can pass context (summary, open questions, next steps, files) to another. Returns 423 when disabled via config, 400 on missing fields, and routes canonical storage failures to the global sanitized error envelope.
nodes.languageNotes: Domain rejections (missing/non-open/project-mismatch) surface as {ok:false, reason} while canonical persistence failures are rethrown via rethrowCanonicalHandoffError to a shared global HTTP error envelope instead of being swallowed as a generic 500.

nodes.name: hooks.test.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level test suite for lifecycle-hook ingestion endpoints, verifying single/batch event admission, queue-saturation (429), validation (400/413), and disabled-flag (423) responses.

nodes.name: hooks.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia routes for passive lifecycle-event capture: fire-and-forget single (POST /api/v1/hook) and batch (POST /api/v1/hook/batch) ingestion into Observations, plus a compaction-snapshot builder (POST /api/v1/hook/compact-snapshot). Returns 202 on admission, 429 when the single-writer queue is saturated, and 423 when hooks are disabled.

nodes.name: memory.test.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level test suite for the memory endpoints (store/search/update/delete/list), exercising each via app.handle() against a mocked memory repository and tool set, including formatRow's tags JSON-parse branches.

nodes.name: memory.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia routes for the PostgreSQL-backed hierarchical memory system: store, semantic search, partial update (re-embedding on content change), delete, and filtered list — each delegating to a dedicated Tool class except list, which queries the repository directly.

nodes.name: project-identity.test.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level test suite for POST /api/v1/project/rename and /merge, stubbing the core ProjectIdentityService via mock.module to verify dryRun default behavior, preview/apply dispatch, and sanitized error/status-code mapping in isolation from the transport layer.

nodes.name: project.test.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level test suite covering the project list/index/reset/upload-and-index/status endpoints and handleProjectIdentity's non-ProjectIdentityError rethrow, complementing project-identity.test.ts which covers rename/merge separately.

nodes.name: project.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia routes for project lifecycle management: list indexed projects, start async indexing, reset (delete vectors/symbols/memories with audit logging), upload-and-index for remote clients, index-status polling, and transactional rename/merge of project identities with dry-run preview + plan-hash-gated apply.
nodes.languageNotes: The reset handler derives an audit ActorContext via deriveActor from the shared auth middleware and records a best-effort operation_log entry after the destructive work finishes, so a broken audit table never blocks the reset itself.

nodes.name: proposals.test.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level test suite for the auto-improvement proposal endpoints (list/approve/reject), verifying status-code mapping and disabled-flag gating via a mocked auto-improve job.

nodes.name: proposals.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia routes exposing the auto-improvement review-gate: list pending memory-edit proposals, approve (apply + flip status + emit event), and reject (flip only) for a project. Returns 423 when auto-improve is disabled and routes canonical failures to the shared error envelope.

nodes.name: search.test.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level test suite for the search endpoints, covering normalizeArrayParam's parsing branches and success/failure mapping for POST /api/v1/search/project via app.handle() against a mocked SearchProjectTool.

nodes.name: search.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia routes for hybrid vector + keyword project search (RRF-ranked) and a semantic code-search alias, including a defensive array-param normalizer that tolerates JSON-, Python-repr-, and single-value-encoded query strings for include/exclude globs.

nodes.name: synapse.test.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level test suite for Synapse session-lifecycle and working-memory-buffer endpoints, using a fake in-memory session registry so no PostgreSQL backing is required.

nodes.name: synapse.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia routes for Synapse session lifecycle (create/inspect/update/end) and its working-memory buffer (prime/access/prefetch), plus 5-in-1 task-envelope endpoints (task/begin, task/:id/end) that collapse create, prime, search, prefetch, and access into a single call.
nodes.languageNotes: Several handlers explicitly await registry.ensureReady() before acting on a session, so a resume immediately after a process restart observes a PostgreSQL-mirrored session rather than a stale in-memory miss.

nodes.name: system.test.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level test suite for the system info/status/metrics/health endpoints, verifying request/response wiring via app.handle().

nodes.name: system.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia routes reporting system and dependency health: process/OS info, required-service status (PostgreSQL/pgvector/Ollama/data dir), aggregate metrics, a comprehensive local health check, and Ollama model availability, redacting database credentials from every response.

nodes.name: web-ui-contract.test.ts
nodes.summary: Response-shape contract test asserting the checkpoints/list route still emits every key the Web UI's checked-in golden fixture expects, guarding the exact bug class where a route's shape drifts silently and the UI renders a permanent empty state.
nodes.languageNotes: Reads its fixture from apps/web-ui via fs rather than a cross-package import, since apps/tools-api's tsconfig scopes rootDir to ./src with no allowJs.

nodes.name: web-ui-static-dir.test.ts
nodes.summary: Filesystem-level test suite validating buildStaticDirCandidates against the real static-asset directory from multiple simulated cwd/module-dir layouts (src, dist, turbo package dir, outside the repo), including one child-process probe that drives GET /ui end-to-end.

nodes.name: web-ui.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia routes serving the read-only Web UI (memory/search browser): the index.html shell and static assets from apps/web-ui/src/static, with a multi-layout static-dir resolver (src/dist/turbo/container cwd), traversal-safe path resolution, and an SPA-style index.html fallback for unknown paths.
nodes.languageNotes: buildStaticDirCandidates deliberately avoids depending on process.cwd() alone, walking up from both the module's own directory and cwd to cover every launch layout (monorepo root, package dir, container WORKDIR).

nodes.name: web.test.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level test suite for the fetch_and_index endpoint, exercising POST /api/v1/web/fetch_and_index via app.handle() against a mocked WebController and FetchAndIndexTool, including the cached-tool fast path on a second request.

nodes.name: web.ts
nodes.summary: Elysia route exposing SSRF-guarded web fetch-and-index: blocks loopback/private/link-local/IMDS targets (including redirect-to-internal and DNS-rebind), converts HTML to markdown and JSON to key-path chunks, then indexes the result with TTL caching (~24h).
nodes.languageNotes: getTool lazily resolves the async vector store + keyword search exactly once, serializing concurrent first-requests through a shared initPromise to avoid double-initializing the WebController singleton.

nodes.name: workspace.test.ts
nodes.summary: Route-level test suite covering all 12 workspace and symbol-graph endpoints (CRUD, definitions, references, definition, trace, impact, map, centrality, snippet) across happy, validation, stale-generation, and error paths, with core services stubbed so no DB or disk access beyond a tmp snippet fixture is required.

nodes.name: workspace.ts
nodes.summary: The largest route module in tools-api: workspace CRUD (list/get/delete/reindex) plus the full symbol-graph surface — definitions search, references, go-to-definition, BFS path tracing over typed edges, git-diff-driven impact analysis ranked by centrality, project map, top-central-files, and line-range snippets — with stale-generation preconditions (If-None-Match) guarding several read endpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: boundedInt coerces and clamps every numeric query/body param (depth, limit, centralityLimit...) so a malformed value falls back to a safe default instead of becoming NaN and defeating a service-side bound like the trace BFS's MAX_DEPTH of 6.

nodes.name: startup-config.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny startup gate that validates the mandatory PostgreSQL-only database contract (dedicated DB allowed and a Postgres DATABASE_URL present) before Tools API services initialize.

nodes.name: index-job-tracker-events.test.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-package integration test verifying IndexJobTracker publishes indexing:failed to the global eventBus only for transitions the ETL pipeline doesn't own (early-exit pending to failed, reaper running to failed), stays silent on progress ticks and the main pipeline path, and that an SSE client subscribed with ?jobId= receives the tracker's event end-to-end through apps/tools-api's events route.
nodes.languageNotes: Imports eventBus twice under two different module identities (the source copy and the @massa-ai/core dist copy) to work around bun test's lack of bundling, re-publishing on the dist bus so the SSE route's subscription observes the tracker's event.

nodes.name: rethrowCanonicalHandoffError
nodes.summary: Re-throws a caught error only if it is a SearchServiceError, preserving canonical handoff-storage failures so they reach the global sanitized HTTP/MCP error envelope instead of being downgraded to a generic 500.

nodes.name: formatRow
nodes.summary: Converts a raw PostgreSQL MemoryRow into the same response shape the search endpoint returns: parsing the JSON tags column, mapping importance as a search-score proxy, and ISO-formatting the creation timestamp.

nodes.name: handleProjectIdentity
nodes.summary: Shared dispatcher behind the rename and merge endpoints: previews (dryRun default true, returns a planHash) or applies (requires operationId + expectedPlanHash) a project-identity operation, mapping ProjectIdentityError to its sanitized status code and code.

nodes.name: normalizeArrayParam
nodes.summary: Coerces an include/exclude glob-pattern query param into a string array, tolerating a real array, a JSON-encoded string, a Python-repr-style bracket string, or a single bare value.

nodes.name: serializeSession
nodes.summary: Maps an internal Synapse session object to its wire representation, deriving accessHistorySize and bufferEnabled/bufferSize from the session's live buffer and access-history state.

nodes.name: getTool
nodes.summary: Lazily resolves the vector store and keyword search exactly once, binds them into the WebController singleton, and constructs the FetchAndIndexTool, serializing concurrent first-requests through a shared initPromise to prevent double-initialization.

nodes.name: buildStaticDirCandidates
nodes.summary: Builds the ordered list of candidate static-asset directories by walking upward from both the module's own directory and the process cwd, so the Web UI's assets resolve correctly whether launched from the monorepo root, a turbo package dir, or a container WORKDIR.

nodes.name: resolveStaticDir
nodes.summary: Returns the first candidate static directory that actually exists on disk, or null if none of the precomputed layout guesses resolve.

nodes.name: resolveSafePath
nodes.summary: Resolves a requested sub-path against the static root and rejects any path that escapes it via traversal, returning the absolute path plus an existence flag so the caller can choose between serving the asset or falling back to index.html.

nodes.name: boundedInt
nodes.summary: Parses a query-string value into a bounded integer, falling back to a safe default on missing, non-numeric, or out-of-range input so a malformed param like a non-numeric depth can never become NaN and silently defeat a downstream service bound.

nodes.name: validateApiStartup
nodes.summary: Startup gate that asserts a dedicated database is allowed and a PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL is configured, failing fast before any Tools API service initializes against a missing or wrong-type backend.

nodes.name: captureEvents
nodes.summary: Test helper that subscribes to a set of named eventBus events, collecting every published payload into an array, and returns an unsubscribe-all stop callback for cleanup.

nodes.name: SseCollector
nodes.summary: Test harness that opens a real SSE connection against the events route, incrementally decodes the 'data: ' chunk framing off the response stream, and buffers parsed frames for assertions, used to verify the tracker's events reach a live SSE client end-to-end.

nodes.name: with-deadlock-retry.ts
nodes.summary: Provides a generic retry wrapper for PostgreSQL operations that fail with a deadlock or serialization-conflict SQLSTATE, retrying with backoff before giving up.

nodes.name: isRetriableTransactionError
nodes.summary: Determines whether a caught error represents a retriable PostgreSQL deadlock or serialization failure by inspecting its SQLSTATE code.

nodes.name: withDeadlockRetry
nodes.summary: Executes an async database operation and automatically retries it with backoff when a deadlock or serialization-failure error is detected, up to a configurable attempt limit.

nodes.name: graph-generation-coordinator.ts
nodes.summary: Coordinates the lifecycle (begin/heartbeat/activate/abort/cleanup) of a symbol-graph generation — the versioned snapshot written by one ETL run — delegating lease bookkeeping to the graph-generation repository.

nodes.name: buildGraphInputSnapshotHash
nodes.summary: Computes a deterministic SHA-256 hash over a sorted, normalized list of discovered files, used to detect whether the graph generation's input set changed.

nodes.name: GraphGenerationCoordinator
nodes.summary: Wraps GraphGenerationRepository to manage the begin/heartbeat/activate/abort/cleanup state machine for a versioned symbol-graph generation during an ETL run.

nodes.name: pipeline.ts
nodes.summary: Singleton orchestrator that runs the 4-stage ETL pipeline (discover to parse to resolve to load) end-to-end for one project run, managing managed-run leases, graph-generation heartbeats, job-progress events, and busy/abort error handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs discover/graph-generation heartbeats and managed-run heartbeats as concurrent background loops guarded by AbortController, aborting the in-flight stage promise via the `abortable()` helper when a lease is lost.

nodes.name: buildHeaderLanguageEvidence
nodes.summary: Parses an optional compile_commands.json to determine whether ambiguous .h header files belong to C or C++ importers, producing per-header language evidence for the structural parser.

nodes.name: abortable
nodes.summary: Wraps an async operation so it rejects immediately when the given AbortSignal is triggered, used to make long-running stage calls cancellable.

nodes.name: EtlPipelineBusyError
nodes.summary: Error thrown when a managed-run lease for a project's indexing operation is already held by another live process, carrying the active run ID and lease expiry so callers can map it to a 409 response.

nodes.name: EtlPipeline
nodes.summary: Singleton that drives the discover/parse/resolve/load ETL stages in sequence for one project run, acquiring managed-run and graph-generation leases, emitting progress via EventBus and IndexJobTracker, and handling busy/abort/failure paths.

nodes.name: stage-context.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the shared TypeScript contracts (EtlStageContext, DiscoveredFile, ParsedFile, ResolvedFile, EtlResult, etc.) passed between the four ETL stages (discover to parse to resolve to load).

nodes.name: discover.ts
nodes.summary: First ETL stage: walks the project filesystem honoring ignore patterns, hashes each candidate file, skips files whose content hash is unchanged, and orders remaining files by symbol-graph centrality for prioritized reparsing.

nodes.name: DiscoverStage
nodes.summary: Discovers project files eligible for indexing via glob plus ignore rules, computes content hashes to detect changed files, and orders them by centrality so high-impact files are parsed first.

nodes.name: load.ts
nodes.summary: Final ETL stage: persists parsed/resolved file output to the vector store, keyword search index, and symbol database (definitions, references, imports, edges) in per-batch transactions with deadlock retry.

nodes.name: buildSymbolPersistenceBatch
nodes.summary: Transforms a resolved file's raw symbols, imports, and structural edges into the flat row batch shape expected by the symbol repository's bulk-write API.

nodes.name: LoadStage
nodes.summary: Writes each resolved file's chunks and symbols to the vector store, keyword index, and PostgreSQL symbol database, retrying on deadlock and reporting per-batch progress.

nodes.name: index-job-store-contract.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the JobStore persistence interface for indexing jobs and a MemoryJobStore in-process fallback implementation, used when no PostgreSQL-backed store is configured.
nodes.languageNotes: The entire interface and class body are written on 2 dense lines rather than the repo's usual multi-line style, likely to keep this contract file minimal.

nodes.name: MemoryJobStore
nodes.summary: In-memory JobStore implementation that clones job records into a Map, used as a lightweight fallback when a PostgreSQL-backed job store is unavailable.

nodes.name: index-job-store-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed JobStore that keeps an in-memory mirror hydrated from the database for synchronous reads, while writes are persisted asynchronously (fire-and-forget) via raw SQL through the shared Prisma client.
nodes.languageNotes: Reconciles a synchronous JobStore interface with an inherently async backend by serving reads from an in-memory mirror while writes fire-and-forget to PostgreSQL, matching the repo's one-backend-PostgreSQL rule.

nodes.name: rowToJob
nodes.summary: Converts a raw PostgreSQL row returned by $queryRaw into a fully-typed IndexJob object, coercing BIGINT timestamp columns to JS numbers.

nodes.name: PgJobStore
nodes.summary: Synchronous-facing JobStore backed by PostgreSQL, serving reads from an in-memory mirror hydrated on first use while persisting writes asynchronously via raw SQL, with crash-recovery for stale running jobs on startup.

nodes.name: index-job-store.ts
nodes.summary: Factory that lazily constructs and caches the singleton PgJobStore, requiring a PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL, and re-exports the JobStore contract types.

nodes.name: getJobStore
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide PgJobStore singleton, creating it on first call after asserting a PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL is configured.

nodes.name: resetJobStore
nodes.summary: Clears the cached PgJobStore singleton so the next getJobStore() call constructs a fresh instance, used to isolate tests.

nodes.name: index-job-tracker.ts
nodes.summary: In-memory singleton that tracks the lifecycle and progress of async indexing jobs (create/update/heartbeat/complete), persisting each job via a pluggable JobStore and publishing state changes on the EventBus, with stale-job reaping based on heartbeat timeout.

nodes.name: IndexJobTracker
nodes.summary: Singleton job tracker that records status/progress for async indexing runs, persists them through a JobStore, broadcasts changes over the EventBus, and reaps jobs whose heartbeat has gone stale.

nodes.name: alias-resolver.ts
nodes.summary: Application-layer canonical project-ID resolver that complements the database's identity-guard trigger for write paths the trigger cannot rewrite (filtered UPDATE/DELETE statements, payload-embedded IDs), with TTL caching and fail-open semantics on lookup errors.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately fail-open: if alias resolution errors or times out, the writer proceeds with the original ID rather than blocking, because the DB trigger remains the backstop for guarded columns.

nodes.name: ProjectIdentityAliasResolver
nodes.summary: Resolves a project ID to its canonical form via the server-side project_identity_resolve function, caching positive/negative results with a short TTL and failing open (returning the original ID) if the lookup errors or times out.

nodes.name: getProjectIdentityAliasResolver
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide ProjectIdentityAliasResolver singleton, constructing it on first use.

nodes.name: resetProjectIdentityAliasResolver
nodes.summary: Clears the cached alias resolver singleton so a subsequent call constructs a fresh instance, used to isolate tests.

nodes.name: setProjectIdentityAliasResolverForTests
nodes.summary: Overrides the singleton alias resolver instance with a caller-supplied one, used to inject fakes in tests.

nodes.name: identity-guard-installer.ts
nodes.summary: Installs (or idempotently reinstalls) PostgreSQL triggers that resolve project-identity aliases on INSERT/UPDATE and lock rows on DELETE for every guarded table in the direct-store registry plus runtime vector_documents* tables, recording sanitized per-table failures without aborting.

nodes.name: installGuardOnTable
nodes.summary: Idempotently installs the project-identity guard trigger on a single table/column via the project_identity_install_guard SQL function, returning a sanitized error code on failure instead of throwing.

nodes.name: installProjectIdentityGuards
nodes.summary: Iterates the static direct-store registry plus discovered runtime vector_documents* tables, installing the identity guard trigger on each and returning a report of installed, skipped, and failed tables.

nodes.name: installProjectIdentityGuardsFromPool
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that checks out a client from the shared PostgreSQL pool and runs installProjectIdentityGuards, releasing the client afterward.

nodes.name: analytics-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Factory that lazily constructs and caches the singleton SearchAnalyticsPg instance used to record and query search analytics.

nodes.name: getSearchAnalytics
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide SearchAnalyticsPg singleton, constructing it on first call.

nodes.name: resetSearchAnalytics
nodes.summary: Clears the cached search analytics singleton so tests can start from a fresh instance.

nodes.name: cache-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Factory that lazily constructs and caches the singleton SearchCachePg instance used for search result caching.

nodes.name: getSearchCache
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide SearchCachePg singleton, constructing it on first call.

nodes.name: resetSearchCache
nodes.summary: Clears the cached search-cache singleton so tests can start from a fresh instance.

nodes.name: capture-policy-interfaces.ts
nodes.summary: Pure TypeScript contract (Disposition, CapturePolicyRule, Policy, ApplyPolicyFn) for the capture-policy module, defining what file-capture decisions look like without any implementation.

nodes.name: capture-policy.ts
nodes.summary: Pure, side-effect-free implementation of the capture policy: converts gitignore-style glob patterns to regex, applies an ordered rule list to decide a file's Keep/Drop/MetadataOnly disposition, and validates policy bounds at config-load time.

nodes.name: globToRegex
nodes.summary: Compiles a gitignore-style glob pattern (supporting **, *, and negation) into a regular expression used by the policy matcher.

nodes.name: applyPolicy
nodes.summary: Evaluates a file path against an ordered capture-policy rule list and returns the first matching rule's disposition, defaulting to Keep.

nodes.name: validatePolicy
nodes.summary: Validates a capture policy's rule count and structure against configured bounds (MAX_IGNORE_PATTERNS, MAX_MATCH_WORK), throwing on violation to fail config load fast.

nodes.name: contextual-search-rlm.ts
nodes.summary: Central hybrid-search facade (vector + keyword with Reciprocal Rank Fusion) that owns per-project indexing, caching, and Synapse session integration; most of its method bodies delegate to extracted implementation modules (rlm-indexing, rlm-search, rlm-fusion, rlm-admin, rlm-synapse).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a 'delegate module' split: fields were widened from private to public so standalone *Impl functions in companion files can operate on the class instance passed in as an explicit `rlm` parameter, keeping state centralized while logic lives in smaller ~600-LOC-budgeted files.

nodes.name: ContextualSearchRLM
nodes.summary: Main search service exposing indexProject/search/warmupCache/getAnalytics and related methods; most method bodies were extracted into companion rlm-*.ts modules that take this instance as an explicit `rlm` parameter.

nodes.name: file-filter-cache.ts
nodes.summary: Caches the resolved set of files matching a project's include/exclude glob filters so repeated searches with the same filters skip re-running minimatch, with size-bounded eviction and per-project invalidation.

nodes.name: FileFilterCache
nodes.summary: Pre-computes and caches the file lists produced by include/exclude glob filters per project, evicting the oldest entries and invalidating on project changes to keep repeated filtered searches fast.

nodes.name: ignore-patterns.ts
nodes.summary: Shared file-scanning ignore logic used by DiscoverStage, ContextualSearchRLM, and IndexManager — merges .gitignore rules (via the `ignore` library, preserving negation semantics) with the configured capture policy before deciding whether to keep a file.

nodes.name: getActivePolicy
nodes.summary: Resolves and caches the active capture policy from config, falling back to the pure module's DEFAULT_POLICY when no capturePolicy block is configured.

nodes.name: _resetCapturePolicyCacheForTesting
nodes.summary: Clears the cached active capture policy so tests can reload configuration between cases.

nodes.name: applyCapturePolicy
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper applying the active capture policy to a single file path and returning its disposition.

nodes.name: loadProjectIgnore
nodes.summary: Builds an Ignore instance for a project by merging DEFAULT_IGNORES and the project's .gitignore, used as the single source of truth for which files DiscoverStage, ContextualSearchRLM, and IndexManager should scan.

nodes.name: index-manager.ts
nodes.summary: Manages project index lifecycle metadata — detects staleness via file mtimes, computes the incremental set of files needing reindexing, and persists/reads index metadata used to decide when automatic reindexing should trigger.

nodes.name: IndexManager
nodes.summary: Tracks per-project index metadata (file mtimes/hashes/counts) to detect staleness and compute which files changed since the last index, driving incremental reindexing decisions.

nodes.name: lexical-search.ts
nodes.summary: Pure-function toolkit for lexical/keyword search — trigram query sanitization, Levenshtein-based fuzzy correction, positional proximity scoring, and title/code-aware re-ranking — shared by the PostgreSQL keyword store and the RLM fusion layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Entirely I/O-free: every export is a pure function over strings/arrays, which is called out explicitly in the file's own header comment as an intentional design choice for unit-testability.

nodes.name: dedupeTokens
nodes.summary: Removes duplicate tokens from a token list while preserving first-seen order.

nodes.name: sanitizeTrigramQuery
nodes.summary: Sanitizes a raw search query for PostgreSQL trigram matching by stripping characters that would break the trigram operator syntax.

nodes.name: levenshtein
nodes.summary: Computes the classic Levenshtein edit distance between two strings, used for fuzzy term correction.

nodes.name: maxEditDistance
nodes.summary: Returns the maximum edit distance allowed for fuzzy-matching a word of a given length, scaling tolerance with word length.

nodes.name: findAllPositions
nodes.summary: Finds every occurrence index of a term within a text, used as input to proximity scoring.

nodes.name: findMinSpan
nodes.summary: Finds the minimum-width window of text that contains at least one occurrence of every query term, powering proximity-based relevance boosting.

nodes.name: countAdjacentPairs
nodes.summary: Counts how many query-term occurrences appear adjacent (within a gap threshold) to each other, used as a phrase-proximity signal.

nodes.name: extractQueryTerms
nodes.summary: Splits and normalizes a raw query string into a list of lowercase search terms, filtering stopwords.

nodes.name: resolveTitle
nodes.summary: Derives a human-readable title for a search result from its file path or heading metadata.

nodes.name: applyProximityRerank
nodes.summary: Re-ranks a list of search results by combining minimum-span proximity and adjacent-term-pair signals with the original relevance score, boosting results where query terms appear close together.

nodes.name: rlm-admin.ts
nodes.summary: Admin/stats delegate functions extracted from ContextualSearchRLM — clearing a project's index, computing project stats, warming the cache with sample queries, and exposing aggregated analytics — each taking the RLM instance as an explicit first parameter.
nodes.languageNotes: Part of the M14 Phase 3 refactor that extracted ContextualSearchRLM method bodies verbatim into standalone functions with `this` renamed to `rlm`, keeping runtime behavior byte-identical while shrinking the main class file.

nodes.name: clearProjectIndexImpl
nodes.summary: Deletes all vector, keyword, and cache entries for a project, delegated from ContextualSearchRLM.clearProjectIndex.

nodes.name: getProjectStatsImpl
nodes.summary: Computes aggregate indexing statistics (document/chunk counts) for a project, delegated from ContextualSearchRLM.getProjectStats.

nodes.name: warmupCacheImpl
nodes.summary: Runs a set of representative or caller-supplied queries against a project to pre-populate the search cache, delegated from ContextualSearchRLM.warmupCache.

nodes.name: getAnalyticsImpl
nodes.summary: Returns the search analytics summary for a project, delegated from ContextualSearchRLM.getAnalytics.

nodes.name: rlm-fusion.ts
nodes.summary: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) implementation that merges vector and keyword result sets into one ranked list with keyword/exact-match boosting, plus a helper that explains how each result's final score was derived — split out of rlm-search.ts to stay under its file's LOC budget.

nodes.name: fuseResultsImpl
nodes.summary: Combines multiple ranked result sets (vector, keyword) using Reciprocal Rank Fusion with query-aware keyword and exact-match boosting, producing one merged, re-ranked result list.

nodes.name: generateScoreExplanationImpl
nodes.summary: Builds a human-readable breakdown of how a result's final fused score was computed from its RRF, vector, and keyword components, for the explainScores debug option.

nodes.name: rlm-indexing.ts
nodes.summary: Indexing-lifecycle delegate functions extracted from ContextualSearchRLM — per-project mutex locking, project/file indexing, freshness checks, and search-admission gating — each taking the RLM instance as an explicit first parameter.

nodes.name: runWithIndexLock
nodes.summary: Serializes concurrent indexing calls for the same project ID through a per-project async mutex map so only one indexing run executes at a time.

nodes.name: _indexProjectInternalImpl
nodes.summary: Core project-indexing routine that walks project files, chunks and embeds them, and writes to the vector/keyword stores, delegated from ContextualSearchRLM._indexProjectInternal.

nodes.name: ensureFreshIndexImpl
nodes.summary: Checks whether a project's index is stale and triggers an incremental or full reindex as needed before serving a search, delegated from ContextualSearchRLM.ensureFreshIndex.

nodes.name: checkSearchAdmissionImpl
nodes.summary: Gates whether a search request may proceed given the project's current index/parser readiness state, delegated from ContextualSearchRLM.checkSearchAdmission.

nodes.name: indexFileImpl
nodes.summary: Indexes a single file into the vector and keyword stores with its centrality score, delegated from ContextualSearchRLM.indexFile.

nodes.name: loadGitignoreImpl
nodes.summary: Thin delegate that loads a project's merged ignore rules via loadProjectIgnore, exposed as ContextualSearchRLM.loadGitignore.

nodes.name: ensureInitializedImpl
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and wires the RLM instance's vector store, keyword search, symbol repository, and other dependencies on first use, delegated from ContextualSearchRLM.ensureInitialized.

nodes.name: rlm-search.ts
nodes.summary: Search-execution delegate functions extracted from ContextualSearchRLM — the main hybrid search entrypoint plus context-snippet extraction, average-score calculation, and include/exclude pattern filtering — and re-exports the fusion helpers from rlm-fusion.ts for backward-compatible imports.

nodes.name: searchImpl
nodes.summary: Executes the full hybrid search flow — admission checks, freshness refresh, vector+keyword retrieval, RRF fusion, Synapse-aware correction, and result formatting — delegated from ContextualSearchRLM.search.

nodes.name: addContextToResultsImpl
nodes.summary: Enriches raw search results with surrounding file context/snippets before they are returned to the caller, delegated from ContextualSearchRLM.addContextToResults.

nodes.name: extractPreviewImpl
nodes.summary: Truncates a result's content to a bounded number of lines for use as a search-result preview.

nodes.name: calculateAvgScoreImpl
nodes.summary: Computes the average relevance score across a list of search results.

nodes.name: filterByPatternsImpl
nodes.summary: Filters a result list to only those whose file paths match the caller's include glob patterns and none of the exclude patterns.

nodes.name: search-analytics-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed implementation that records every search query (latency, result count, cache hit, score) and serves aggregated per-project and per-query analytics, dashboards, and cache-performance summaries.

nodes.name: SearchAnalyticsPg
nodes.summary: Tracks search-query events in PostgreSQL and exposes aggregated analytics — top/recent queries, per-project stats, and cache-performance summaries — installing the project-identity guard on its table at init.

nodes.name: search-analytics.ts
nodes.summary: Compatibility alias re-exporting SearchAnalyticsPg as SearchAnalytics, so older code depending on the pre-PostgreSQL type name keeps compiling.

nodes.name: search-cache-pg.ts
nodes.summary: Two-tier (in-process L1 + PostgreSQL L2) cache for search results, keyed by normalized query and options, with size-bounded eviction, per-project and per-file invalidation, and hit/miss statistics.

nodes.name: SearchCachePg
nodes.summary: Caches search results in a fast in-memory L1 tier backed by a PostgreSQL L2 tier, evicting oldest entries when size bounds are exceeded and supporting project- and file-scoped invalidation.

nodes.name: search-warmup.ts
nodes.summary: Pre-loads a project's top or caller-supplied queries into the search cache on startup so the first real user searches hit a warm cache instead of a cold one.

nodes.name: SearchCacheWarmup
nodes.summary: Warms the search cache for one project or all active projects by replaying their top historical queries through ContextualSearchRLM at startup.

nodes.name: index_project.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler for index_project — validates and canonicalizes the target path, guards against concurrent/conflicting project roots, then kicks off the 4-stage ETL pipeline asynchronously and returns a jobId for polling via get_index_status.

nodes.name: canonicalizeProjectRoot
nodes.summary: Resolves a project path to its canonical real filesystem path (following symlinks), defaulting to Node's realpath.

nodes.name: assertProjectRootReuse
nodes.summary: Guards against indexing the same canonical project root under two different projectIds (or vice versa), throwing a descriptive error when a caller's request would create a conflicting identity mapping.

nodes.name: IndexProjectTool
nodes.summary: Implements the index_project MCP tool — validates input, resolves/guards the project root, acquires a managed-run lease, and launches EtlPipeline.run() in the background while returning a pollable jobId immediately.

nodes.name: embedded-api-client-endpoints.test.ts
nodes.summary: Exercises every REST endpoint route handled by EmbeddedApiClient's get/post/patch/delete dispatch, asserting its in-process responses match the shapes the HTTP ApiClient would return for the same endpoint templates.

nodes.name: embedded-api-client.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for EmbeddedApiClient's in-process request handling, verifying it satisfies the ToolProxyApiClient contract shared with the HTTP ApiClient.

nodes.name: embedded-mode-parity.test.ts
nodes.summary: Contract test asserting that ApiClient (HTTP) and EmbeddedApiClient (in-process) produce equivalent results for the same tool calls, guarding the REST/embedded parity invariant central to the mcp-client's dual-transport design.

nodes.name: index.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the McpProxyServer entry point in index.ts, covering CLI flag handling, tool listing, and tool call proxying via captured stdout/stderr output.

nodes.name: moonshot-flavor.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the moonshot-flavor transport wrapper's stripping of root-level JSON Schema combinators from tool input schemas.

nodes.name: tool-definitions.characterization.test.ts
nodes.summary: Characterization test pinning the canonical order and shape of the aggregated TOOL_DEFINITIONS registry so refactors of the tool-defs/ modules cannot silently reorder or drop tools.

nodes.name: api-client.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the HTTP ApiClient, covering request construction, retry/timeout behavior, and error handling against the Tools API.

nodes.name: api-client.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP client used by the MCP server to call the Elysia tools-api REST server, implementing retries with backoff, AbortController-based timeouts, and typed error handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses AbortController plus exponential backoff (Math.pow) for retry timing, and normalizes both JSON and plain-text error bodies into a single ApiHttpError type.

nodes.name: call-tool-proxy.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the tool-call proxy layer, covering endpoint-template parameter substitution and HTTP-method dispatch to the underlying API client.

nodes.name: call-tool-proxy.ts
nodes.summary: Translates an MCP CallTool request into an HTTP-shaped call against a ToolProxyApiClient by substituting path parameters into the tool's endpoint template and dispatching by HTTP method, then formats the result or error into MCP response content.

nodes.name: embedded-api-client.ts
nodes.summary: In-process implementation of the ToolProxyApiClient interface that dispatches MCP tool calls directly to core services/controllers instead of over HTTP, letting the MCP server run fully embedded when MASSA_AI_EMBEDDED=true while mirroring the tools-api REST route map exactly.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses lazy-initialized module-level singletons (one per tool class) to mirror the REST route layer's lazy-init pattern without paying construction cost until a given tool is first invoked.

nodes.name: file-collector.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the file-collector's directory walk, extension filtering, and size-limit enforcement used to build the file payload for the index tool.

nodes.name: file-collector.ts
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a project directory to collect indexable file contents for the MCP `index` tool, enforcing extension allow-lists, per-file and total size caps, and skipping common build/VCS directories.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Entry point for the massa-ai MCP stdio server: parses config-related CLI flags, wires up MCP SDK request handlers for tools/list and tools/call, and proxies tool calls to either the HTTP ApiClient or the in-process EmbeddedApiClient depending on MASSA_AI_EMBEDDED.

nodes.name: moonshot-flavor.ts
nodes.summary: Transport-only wrapper (Wave 5 FR-17) that strips root-level JSON Schema combinators (allOf/anyOf/oneOf/top-level $ref) from tool input schemas when a client requests the 'moonshot' flavor, working around Moonshot AI's stricter JSON Schema validator without touching stored schemas.

nodes.name: tool-definitions-checkpoints.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests covering the checkpoint-related tool definitions (list/create/restore checkpoints) exposed in the aggregated TOOL_DEFINITIONS registry.

nodes.name: tool-definitions-fields-flow.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests that argument fields declared in tool definitions correctly flow through the call-tool-proxy's endpoint-template substitution and payload construction.

nodes.name: tool-definitions-identity.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the project-identity related tool definitions and their interaction with the call-tool-proxy dispatch layer.

nodes.name: tool-definitions-synapse.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests verifying the Synapse-related tool definitions are present and correctly shaped in the TOOL_DEFINITIONS registry.

nodes.name: tool-definitions-wave5.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression tests for the Wave 5 batch of tool definitions added to the TOOL_DEFINITIONS registry.

nodes.name: tool-definitions.ts
nodes.summary: Facade that concatenates the per-domain tool-defs/ modules (search, memory, synapse, project, hooks-exec) into a single TOOL_DEFINITIONS array in the canonical order pinned by the characterization test, plus a getToolDefinition lookup helper.

nodes.name: tool-defs-hooks-exec.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the MCP tool definitions (JSON Schema + REST endpoint mapping) for hook ingestion and code-execution tools (hook_ingest, execute, execute_file, batch_execute).

nodes.name: tool-defs-memory.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the MCP tool definitions for the persistent memory API surface (remember, recall, memory_update, memory_delete, memory_list, checkpoints, compress, analytics).

nodes.name: tool-defs-project.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the MCP tool definitions for project lifecycle operations (index, index_status, list_projects, reset_project, rename_project, merge_projects, bootstrap, handoff, proposals).

nodes.name: tool-defs-search.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the MCP tool definitions for semantic/keyword search and symbol-graph navigation (search, search_definitions, get_references, go_to_definition, trace_path, impact_analysis, get_architecture, symbol_snippet, read_file).

nodes.name: tool-defs-synapse.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the MCP tool definitions for the Synapse cross-session context buffer (synapse_session, synapse_get, synapse_update, synapse_prime, synapse_access, synapse_prefetch, synapse_task_begin/end).

nodes.name: tool-discovery.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests cursor-based pagination of the tool registry, including invalid and stale cursor rejection via MCP error codes.

nodes.name: tool-discovery.ts
nodes.summary: Implements stable cursor-based pagination over the tool definitions registry for MCP's tools/list, encoding a SHA-256 registry fingerprint into each opaque cursor so stale or tampered cursors are rejected with McpError.
nodes.languageNotes: Canonicalizes objects (recursively sorted keys) before hashing so the registry fingerprint is stable regardless of property insertion order.

nodes.name: ApiHttpError
nodes.summary: Typed error thrown by ApiClient (and reused by EmbeddedApiClient) carrying the HTTP status code and parsed response body of a failed Tools API request.

nodes.name: ApiClient
nodes.summary: HTTP implementation of the ToolProxyApiClient contract: wraps fetch with configurable timeout/retry/backoff, JSON (de)serialization, and get/post/patch/delete/uploadAndIndex/healthCheck methods for talking to the tools-api REST server.

nodes.name: proxyToolRequest
nodes.summary: Substitutes `:param` placeholders in a tool's endpoint template with argument values (remaining args become the request payload) and dispatches the call via the matching HTTP method on the given API client.

nodes.name: proxyCallTool
nodes.summary: Resolves an MCP tool name to its definition, proxies the call via proxyToolRequest, and formats the response (or any ApiHttpError) into MCP CallTool content.

nodes.name: EmbeddedApiClient
nodes.summary: In-process counterpart to ApiClient: implements get/post/patch/delete by routing directly to core tool/controller/service calls (index, search, memory, checkpoints, synapse, handoff, proposals, executor) instead of an HTTP round trip, replicating the tools-api REST route map endpoint-for-endpoint.
nodes.languageNotes: The get/post/patch/delete methods pattern-match the requested endpoint string against the same route templates tools-api uses, so behavior stays endpoint-for-endpoint identical to the HTTP path.

nodes.name: fetchAndIndexTool
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs the singleton FetchAndIndexTool, wiring it to a lazily-instantiated WebController backed by the vector store and keyword search index.

nodes.name: serializeSession
nodes.summary: Converts an internal Synapse session object into the same JSON-safe shape the REST synapse_session route returns, omitting non-serializable buffer internals.

nodes.name: collectFiles
nodes.summary: Entry point that walks a project directory and returns the collected {relativePath, content} pairs for every file under the configured extension allow-list and size limits.

nodes.name: walk
nodes.summary: Recursive directory-walk helper that skips VCS/build directories and dotfolders, filters by allowed extension, and enforces per-file and cumulative byte/file-count caps while collecting file contents.

nodes.name: processCliArgs
nodes.summary: Handles massa-ai's config-related CLI flags (--config-show, --config-path, --config-dir, --config-init, --help) before the MCP server starts, returning a process exit code when a flag was handled or undefined to continue startup.

nodes.name: textContent
nodes.summary: Wraps a plain string into the MCP tool-response content shape `{content: [{type: 'text', text}]}`.

nodes.name: isEmbeddedMode
nodes.summary: Reads the MASSA_AI_EMBEDDED environment variable to decide whether the MCP server should run with the in-process EmbeddedApiClient or the HTTP ApiClient.

nodes.name: McpProxyServer
nodes.summary: The MCP stdio server: registers tools/list and tools/call handlers on the MCP SDK Server, applies pagination and moonshot-flavor schema stripping to tool listings, and proxies tool calls to whichever ApiClientLike implementation (HTTP or embedded) was selected at construction time.

nodes.name: stripMoonshotCombinators
nodes.summary: Returns a shallow clone of a JSON Schema with root-level allOf/anyOf/oneOf keys and a root-level $ref removed, leaving nested schema keys (properties, required, etc.) untouched.

nodes.name: applyMoonshotFlavor
nodes.summary: Applies stripMoonshotCombinators to every tool's inputSchema in a tools/list result when the requested flavor is 'moonshot'; returns the input unchanged (same reference) otherwise.

nodes.name: resolveFlavor
nodes.summary: Extracts the requested tool-listing flavor from an MCP request, checking both `_meta.flavor` and a top-level `flavor` param.

nodes.name: getToolDefinition
nodes.summary: Looks up a single ToolDefinition by name in the aggregated TOOL_DEFINITIONS registry.

nodes.name: pageToolDefinitions
nodes.summary: Returns one page (up to TOOL_DISCOVERY_PAGE_SIZE) of the public-facing tool registry along with an opaque nextCursor, validating any supplied cursor against a SHA-256 fingerprint of the current registry so pagination state can't outlive a registry change.

nodes.name: canonicalize
nodes.summary: Recursively sorts object keys and normalizes arrays so a value's JSON serialization is stable regardless of property insertion order, used as the input to the registry fingerprint hash.

nodes.name: decodeCursor
nodes.summary: Decodes and validates a base64url pagination cursor, checking its shape, version, registry fingerprint match, and offset alignment, throwing McpError InvalidParams on any mismatch.

nodes.name: captureConsole
nodes.summary: Test helper that temporarily replaces console.log/console.error to capture output produced while running an async callback, then restores the originals.

nodes.name: create-progress-memory.ts
nodes.summary: Standalone Bun script that writes a hard-coded status report of the SQLite-to-PostgreSQL migration into the memory table as a single DECISION-level record; a historical one-off tool, not part of the runtime product.
nodes.languageNotes: Lives at the package root instead of under src/, marking it as a throwaway operational script rather than shipped product code; the memory content itself is authored in Portuguese.

nodes.name: checkpoint-pg.test.ts
nodes.summary: PG-backed unit test suite covering PgCheckpointStore's CRUD/purge/stats/restore behavior, CheckpointManager's singleton and restore flow, and AutoCheckpointer's lifecycle.

nodes.name: checkpoint-schema-guard.test.ts
nodes.summary: DB-free guard test exercising PgCheckpointStore's rowToCheckpoint schema-ahead branch directly with synthetic rows carrying varying state_schema_version values.

nodes.name: fqn-codec-schema-guard.test.ts
nodes.summary: DB-free guard tests for the structural FQN codec's canonical-signature version decoding and the schema-ahead assertion that rejects signatures newer than the running binary supports.

nodes.name: impact-bfs-cte.test.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL integration test for runBfsCteImpact, the single recursive-CTE multi-source breadth-first search that walks the reverse import graph from changed files and collapses cycles via MIN(hop).
