nodes.summary: Curated categorical corpus (CORPUS) and per-query relevance judgments (GOLDEN) that emulate realistic hybrid-search hits across decision, implementation, ranking, and troubleshooting categories, used to drive Synapse's relevance, stability, and golden-relevance test suites.
nodes.languageNotes: Categories mirror the production benchmark v2 query taxonomy so unit-test outcomes read against the same buckets as live benchmarks.

nodes.name: synapse-agent-affinity.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for computeAgentAffinity, verifying the 0.6 same-agent authorship boost, the usage-frequency component capped at 10 accesses, and saturation at 1.0 when both signals combine.

nodes.name: synapse-attention-score.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit tests for applyAttentionScore covering semantic/recency/access-heat/task-alignment/agent-affinity signal blending, rerankWindow bounds, createdAt parsing (Date/ISO string/invalid), and NaN/degenerate-weight clamping.

nodes.name: synapse-buffer-integration.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests for SynapseManager working together with SessionRegistry and WorkingMemoryBuffer: verifies buffer-hit/buffer-put filter flags, primed-entry surfacing (IMP-9), and project-scoped buffer isolation that keeps cross-project entries from leaking into results.

nodes.name: synapse-chain-inhibition.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for detectIntent's query-intent classification (decision/debug/pattern/symbol/general, including Portuguese phrasing) and applyChainInhibition's per-intent score boosts and suppressions by result type.

nodes.name: synapse-classification-matrix.test.ts
nodes.summary: Table-driven categorical coverage suite for classifyQuery (broad/focused/specific) and detectIntent (decision/debug/pattern/symbol/general) across the benchmark v2 query taxonomy, plus a determinism check that both classifiers are stable across repeated calls.

nodes.name: synapse-confidence-gate.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for classifyQuery's specific/focused/broad heuristics (file paths, camelCase/PascalCase/snake_case symbols, quoted identifiers) and applyConfidenceGate's per-class score thresholding.

nodes.name: synapse-diversity-penalty.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for applyDiversityPenalty's MMR-style near-duplicate suppression, verifying disabled/single-item pass-through, penalization of near-identical content, and re-sorting so a unique result outranks a heavily penalized duplicate cluster.

nodes.name: synapse-edge-cases.test.ts
nodes.summary: Cross-cutting edge-case suite covering every Synapse pipeline stage (diversity penalty, confidence gate, temporal inhibition, chain inhibition, attention score, spectrum analysis, SynapseManager) against empty input, malformed metadata, extreme/NaN-producing scores, disabled-pipeline identity, and large candidate lists, modeled on the failure shapes the v2 benchmark emits.

nodes.name: synapse-embedding-evolution.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for evolveEmbeddings, verifying the minSamples gate, the drift-cosine threshold that skips low-alignment centroids, dimension-mismatch skipping, and the 0.7/0.3 blend math between original and query-centroid embeddings.

nodes.name: synapse-golden-relevance.test.ts
nodes.summary: Relevance benchmark suite that runs the full post-RRF SynapseManager pipeline against the curated corpus and asserts MRR/nDCG floors per query category, a non-regression check that enabling Attention Score never collapses ranking quality (the pre-IMP-1 regression), noise rejection via raw-cosine gating, and a same-file diversity invariant.

nodes.name: synapse-improvements-round2.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression suite pinning fixes IMP-8 through IMP-14: non-compounding buffer baseline scores, token-overlap gating for primed buffer entries, session TTL refresh on get(), LRU-bounded access history, mutually-exclusive spectrum flags, a continuous no-cliff strengthen ramp, and a rerankWindow minimum floor.

nodes.name: precisionAtK
nodes.summary: Computes precision@k, the fraction of the top-k retrieved ids that are in the relevant set, returning NaN for k<=0.

nodes.name: recallAtK
nodes.summary: Computes recall@k, the fraction of the relevant set found within the top-k retrieved ids, returning NaN when the relevant set is empty.

nodes.name: mrrAtK
nodes.summary: Computes mean reciprocal rank at k: the reciprocal of the 1-based position of the first relevant hit within the top-k, or 0 if none is found.

nodes.name: ndcgAtK
nodes.summary: Computes normalized discounted cumulative gain at k by dividing the DCG of the retrieved ranking by the ideal DCG for the same relevant-set size.

nodes.name: jaccard
nodes.summary: Computes the Jaccard similarity (intersection over union) between two string id lists, defined as 1 when both are empty.

nodes.name: toResult
nodes.summary: Converts a categorical CorpusItem fixture into a real SearchResult, folding optional fields (raw vector score, memory type, createdAt, access count) into the metadata bag exactly as production search results shape them.

nodes.name: synapse-improvements-round3.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression suite pinning fixes IMP-15 through IMP-17: the session create/get/prime/access lifecycle via SessionRegistry and WorkingMemoryBuffer, prefilterByRawScore cutting noise before the heavy pipeline, and executePrefetch's plan-to-fetch-to-prime composition including error swallowing.

nodes.name: synapse-improvements.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression suite pinning fixes IMP-1, IMP-3, IMP-4, and IMP-5: attention-score weight renormalization to avoid score collapse, filePath-based type inference driving chain-inhibition boosts, diversity penalty's same-path penalty, and confidence-gate's preference for raw vector score over the RRF-inflated score.

nodes.name: synapse-index.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for the Synapse service barrel (services/synapse/index.ts): the lazy getSynapseManager()/resetSynapseManager() singleton and that every re-exported class, function, and type from the subsystem's submodules is reachable through the barrel.

nodes.name: synapse-ir-metrics.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests pinning the exact math of the IR metric primitives (precision@k, recall@k, MRR@k, nDCG@k, Jaccard) in fixtures/ir-metrics.ts so the benchmark and unit tests never silently disagree on metric definitions.

nodes.name: synapse-manager.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for SynapseManager, the pipeline orchestrator: disabled no-op passthrough, that all sub-filters run and surface applied-filter/flag metadata, per-submodule enable/disable toggling, confidence-gate score dropping, low-confidence flagging, chain-inhibition intent boosts, and attention-score re-ranking ordering relative to chain inhibition.

nodes.name: synapse-prefetch.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for extractTopics (path and CamelCase-symbol tokenization with stopword filtering) and buildPrefetchPlan (enabled/disabled plan construction and the no-topics-found fallback).

nodes.name: synapse-score-spectrum.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for analyzeSpectrum's confidence-flag derivation from a result-score distribution: disabled/empty-list zeroing, definitiveMatch, lowConfidence, and noStrongMatch classification boundaries.

nodes.name: synapse-session-registry.test.ts
nodes.summary: Extensive unit-test suite (30+ cases) for SessionRegistry covering create/get/update/delete lifecycle, TTL eviction and sliding-window refresh, LRU-bounded access-history eviction, a FakeStore-backed persistence integration path with best-effort error swallowing on every store call, async ensureReady/getAsync, and the getSessionRegistry/resetSessionRegistry singleton.

nodes.name: synapse-session-store-pg.test.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL parity suite for PgSynapseSessionStore, gated behind MASSA_AI_DEDICATED and RUN_POSTGRES_TESTS against a dedicated test database: save/load round-trips, taskTokens/taskEmbedding/accessHistory/buffer persistence, upsert semantics, fire-and-forget chainWrite failure swallowing, hydration idempotency and in-flight-write replay, and BigInt column round-tripping.
nodes.languageNotes: Guarded by describe.skipIf so it only runs against the dedicated maintenance DB, keeping the default suite free of a live Postgres dependency.

nodes.name: synapse-session-store.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the in-memory session-store surface: MemorySessionStore's no-op SessionStore contract, the tokenize() text-normalization helper, the getSessionStore/resetSessionStore singleton, and re-exported types. The PG-backed store path is covered separately by synapse-session-store-pg.test.ts.

nodes.name: synapse-stability.test.ts
nodes.summary: Determinism suite asserting that every pure Synapse pipeline stage (diversity penalty, confidence gate, temporal inhibition, chain inhibition, attention score, spectrum analysis, strengthen updates, embedding evolution, and the full SynapseManager pipeline) produces byte-identical output across 10 repeated calls on identical input, guarding against Date.now/Math.random/Map-iteration-order non-determinism.

nodes.name: synapse-strengthen.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for computeStrengthenUpdates' importance-boost math: the recentAccessCount ramp threshold and saturation, graph-edge-count boost, decision-reference bonus, multi-signal stacking capped at maxDelta, and the importanceCap ceiling.

nodes.name: synapse-task-alignment.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for computeTaskAlignment: zero alignment with no session task, token-overlap-based alignment scoring against session taskContext, and embedding-cosine-based alignment when both the session and result provide embeddings.

nodes.name: FakeStore
nodes.summary: In-file SessionStore test double that records every save/load/delete/recordAccess/ensureReady call and can be configured to throw per-method, used to verify SessionRegistry's best-effort error-swallowing and store write-through behavior.

nodes.name: observation-extractor.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the pure extractCategory classifier in the observation-extractor hook, covering tool-call dispatch, user-prompt signals, session lifecycle events, error detection, and the lifecycle-raw fallback.

nodes.name: relation-extractor.test.ts
nodes.summary: Coverage for RelationExtractor's heuristic relation classification and embedding-similarity extraction, using a mocked memory repository and a scripted graph store so no live embedding provider or database is required.

nodes.name: search-session-hook.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for SearchSessionHook covering registration, memory storage on search:completed events, deduplication, empty-result skipping, store-failure resilience, and unregistration.

nodes.name: serialize.test.ts
nodes.summary: Extensive test suite for the MCP tool-response serialization helpers (TOON encoding, field projection, prefix grouping, tree building) exercised against real trace_path- and impact-analysis-shaped payloads.

nodes.name: observation-extractor-seam.test.ts
nodes.summary: Test-seam drift-detection suite that feeds frozen real API-response fixtures (search, impact-analysis, read-file) into extractCategory so a silent shape drift fails the test instead of breaking silently.

nodes.name: writer-queue.test.ts
nodes.summary: Pure async unit tests for WriterQueue covering pending-count getters, saturation detection, enqueue ordering, and failure isolation between chained tasks.

nodes.name: memory-controller.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestration-layer controller composing the memory repository, MemoryService, MemoryGraphService, salience judging, and the consolidation job into the single entry point that store_memory/search_memories tools delegate to.

nodes.name: handoff-repository.ts
nodes.summary: Backend-neutral entry point for the Handoff data store — lazily constructs and caches the PostgreSQL-backed PgHandoffStore singleton and re-exports its contract types.

nodes.name: memory-repository-contract.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the raw row and I/O shape contracts (MemoryRow, InsertMemoryInput, SearchFilters, UpdateMemoryPatch) shared by every memory-repository implementation.

nodes.name: memory-repository-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Backend-neutral factory returning the mandatory PostgreSQL-backed MemoryRepositoryPg singleton, guarded on a configured PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL.

nodes.name: memory-repository-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL implementation of the memory repository using raw $queryRaw/$executeRaw SQL to work around a Prisma 7.7.0 + @prisma/adapter-pg + Bun ORM incompatibility, covering CRUD, full-text search, and consolidation-candidate queries.
nodes.languageNotes: Every query goes through tagged Prisma.sql template fragments instead of Prisma's fluent ORM API (a documented workaround), and a custom parsePgTextArray undoes the pg driver returning text[] columns as raw Postgres array-literal strings instead of native arrays.

nodes.name: memory-repository.ts
nodes.summary: Two-line compatibility type barrel re-exporting the memory row and I/O type contracts from memory-repository-contract.ts for legacy import paths.

nodes.name: observation-repository.ts
nodes.summary: Backend-neutral entry point for the Observation data store — lazily constructs and caches the PostgreSQL-backed PgObservationStore singleton and re-exports its contract types.

nodes.name: mem
nodes.summary: Test factory building a partial in-memory MemoryRow fixture with sensible defaults for RelationExtractor test cases.

nodes.name: recordingStore
nodes.summary: Builds a scripted mock IGraphStore that records every createEdge call so tests can assert on emitted graph edges without a real database.

nodes.name: makePayload
nodes.summary: Test factory building a search:completed event payload with overridable fields for SearchSessionHook test scenarios.

nodes.name: MemoryController
nodes.summary: Singleton controller composing the memory repository, MemoryService, MemoryGraphService, salience judge, and consolidation job to implement store/update/delete/search — the single entry point every memory MCP tool delegates through.

nodes.name: getHandoffStore
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and caches the singleton PgHandoffStore after verifying a PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL is configured.

nodes.name: resetHandoffStore
nodes.summary: Clears the cached PgHandoffStore singleton, used to reset state between tests.

nodes.name: newHandoffId
nodes.summary: Generates a prefixed random UUID (handoff_<uuid>) used as the primary key for new handoff records.

nodes.name: getMemoryRepository
nodes.summary: Backend-neutral factory returning the mandatory PostgreSQL-backed MemoryRepositoryPg singleton after asserting a PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL is configured.

nodes.name: parsePgTextArray
nodes.summary: Parses a PostgreSQL text[] column into a JS string array, handling both the raw Postgres array-literal string format (with quoting/escaping) returned by @prisma/adapter-pg and already-native arrays.

nodes.name: MemoryRepositoryPg
nodes.summary: Raw-SQL PostgreSQL implementation of the memory repository (CRUD, full-text search, importance/access-count updates, consolidation-candidate queries), bypassing Prisma's ORM query builder to avoid a Prisma 7.7.0 + @prisma/adapter-pg + Bun crash.

nodes.name: getObservationStore
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and caches the singleton PgObservationStore after verifying a PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL is configured.

nodes.name: resetObservationStore
nodes.summary: Clears the cached PgObservationStore singleton, used to reset state between tests.

nodes.name: proposal-repository.ts
nodes.summary: Backend-neutral entry point for the Proposal data store (auto-improve suggestions) — lazily constructs and caches the PostgreSQL-backed PgProposalStore singleton and re-exports its contract types.

nodes.name: bootstrap-service.ts
nodes.summary: Scans a freshly indexed project (recent git history, README, docs, manifests, top-central files) and seeds initial pattern/code/decision memories via LLM summarization with a rule-based fallback, idempotent per project via a bootstrap marker tag.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements graceful LLM degradation end-to-end: falls back to ruleBasedSeed (derived from README + git log) when the LLM is disabled or fails, and every early-exit path returns a logged no-op result instead of throwing.

nodes.name: event-bus.ts
nodes.summary: Strongly-typed EventEmitter singleton defining the canonical cross-cutting event map (indexing progress, workspace status, search completion, memory lifecycle) used to decouple services like hooks, jobs, and the SSE layer.

nodes.name: graph-queries.ts
nodes.summary: Traversal and analytics operations over the memory knowledge graph — BFS-based related-context expansion, shortest-path finding, contradiction detection, decision chains, and hub analysis — optimized with batch memory loading to eliminate N+1 queries.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents a deliberate N+1 elimination refactor: loadMemoriesByIds batches every traversal method from O(N) individual queries down to O(1) per BFS level (roughly a 29x reduction on the file's own worked example).

nodes.name: graph-store-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Factory returning a backend-agnostic IGraphStore singleton (currently always GraphStorePg), decoupling consumers from the concrete PostgreSQL graph-store implementation.

nodes.name: graph-store-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL implementation of the memory-edge graph store via Prisma — edge CRUD, BFS neighbor traversal, degree/hub analytics, and path finding — behind a lazy Proxy-wrapped Prisma client so importing the module has no side effects.
nodes.languageNotes: The module-level prisma constant is a Proxy that defers getPrismaClient() to first property access, preventing environments without the PG adapter installed from crashing merely by importing the module.

nodes.name: memory-graph.service.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestration layer coordinating graph-store, relation-extraction, and query operations triggered by memory lifecycle events (store/delete), giving tools a single decoupled entry point into graph internals.

nodes.name: relation-extractor.ts
nodes.summary: Extracts semantic relationships between memories by combining embedding-similarity candidate search with bilingual (English/Portuguese) heuristic keyword rules to classify contradiction, resolution, derivation, and support relations, running in the background after each store_memory call.
nodes.languageNotes: Rule-based classification keyword lists include both English and Portuguese signal phrases (e.g. "nao usar", "substituir"), reflecting a bilingual usage context baked directly into the heuristics.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared internal type contracts for the graph module — memory row projections, edge create/filter shapes, and the canonical backend-agnostic IGraphStore interface implemented by GraphStorePg.

nodes.name: handoff-auto-injector.ts
nodes.summary: Subscribes to the observation:ingested event bus topic and, on a session-start observation, queries HandoffService for pending handoffs to log as an observability signal — never blocks or throws on the session-start path.

nodes.name: handoff-service.ts
nodes.summary: Manages the cross-session handoff lifecycle (open to accepted/expired), letting one agent session leave a structured note for a later session, dual-writing each handoff as both a Handoff-table row and a searchable FTS memory, with optional LLM summary polishing.

nodes.name: attribution-resolver.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves the durable project id for a hook event through a strict priority chain — explicit caller match, sticky session pin, path-containment against deduplicated workspace roots, verbatim fallback — always failing open so attribution never blocks or delays event admission.
nodes.languageNotes: Workspace roots are deduplicated by path before containment matching, so identical project_path values collapse into one candidate carrying its full live-id set instead of producing ambiguous matches.

nodes.name: co-retrieval-hook.ts
nodes.summary: Hebbian-style co-retrieval reinforcement hook that strengthens or creates a RELATES_TO graph edge between session memories stored close together in time, so they resurface together in future neighborhood queries.

nodes.name: getProposalStore
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and caches the singleton PgProposalStore after verifying a PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL is configured.

nodes.name: resetProposalStore
nodes.summary: Clears the cached PgProposalStore singleton, used to reset state between tests.

nodes.name: newProposalId
nodes.summary: Generates a prefixed random UUID (proposal_<uuid>) used as the primary key for new auto-improve proposal records.

nodes.name: readBootstrapConfig
nodes.summary: Reads bootstrap-related feature flags (enabled, max seed count, LLM timeout) from central config with defaults.

nodes.name: noopResult
nodes.summary: Builds a standard "nothing happened" BootstrapResult carrying a skip reason, used by every early-exit branch of bootstrap().

nodes.name: scanSignals
nodes.summary: Gathers raw project signals for seeding — recent git log, README, docs snippets, package manifests, and top-central files from the symbol graph — feeding both the LLM summarizer and the rule-based fallback.

nodes.name: walkMarkdown
nodes.summary: Iteratively walks a directory tree (skipping dotfiles) collecting markdown file paths, used to locate docs for signal scanning.

nodes.name: summarizeWithLlm
nodes.summary: Asks the LLM surface to turn scanned project signals into a validated list of seed memories (SeedMemoriesSchema), returning null on any failure so the caller can fall back to rule-based seeding.

nodes.name: buildSummarizePrompt
nodes.summary: Assembles the LLM prompt for bootstrap seeding from git log, README, docs, manifests, and central-file signals.

nodes.name: ruleBasedSeed
nodes.summary: Deterministic non-LLM fallback that derives a handful of seed memories directly from the README's first paragraph, recent git log entries, and the primary package manifest.

nodes.name: storeSeeds
nodes.summary: Persists generated bootstrap seeds as tagged, leveled memories through the injected memory repository, returning the ids actually stored.

nodes.name: seedTypeToMemoryType
nodes.summary: Maps a bootstrap SeedType (pattern/code/decision) to the corresponding MemoryType enum value.

nodes.name: seedLevelToMemoryLevel
nodes.summary: Maps a bootstrap seed's numeric level (0/1/2) to the corresponding MemoryLevel enum value.

nodes.name: countSignals
nodes.summary: Counts how many concrete signals (docs, manifests, central files, README presence) were scanned, used to decide whether there's enough material to bootstrap from.

nodes.name: defaultGitRunner
nodes.summary: Default git-log signal source — spawns git log as a child process and resolves with its captured stdout/stderr/exit code, injectable for tests.

nodes.name: getBootstrapService
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and caches the singleton BootstrapService.

nodes.name: resetBootstrapService
nodes.summary: Clears the cached BootstrapService singleton, used to reset state between tests.

nodes.name: BootstrapService
nodes.summary: Orchestrates a project's one-time bootstrap: checks the idempotency marker, scans signals, summarizes via LLM (or falls back to rule-based seeding), stores the resulting seed memories, and publishes a bootstrap-completed event — designed to never throw.

nodes.name: TypedEventBus
nodes.summary: Singleton EventEmitter subclass providing type-safe publish/subscribe over the module's EventMap, exported as the eventBus instance (and EventBus type alias) that the rest of the codebase uses as its cross-cutting pub/sub backbone.

nodes.name: GraphQueries
nodes.summary: Read-side traversal and analytics operations over the memory graph — BFS neighborhood expansion, shortest-path reconstruction, contradiction detection, decision chains, and hub analysis — refactored to batch-load memories via loadMemoriesByIds and cut query counts from O(N) to O(1) per BFS level.

nodes.name: getGraphStore
nodes.summary: Returns the cached backend-agnostic IGraphStore singleton, currently always resolving to GraphStorePg.getInstance().

nodes.name: resetGraphStore
nodes.summary: Clears all edges on the cached graph store and resets the singleton, defensively swallowing clear failures so a reset never throws.

nodes.name: rowToEdge
nodes.summary: Converts a raw memory_edges SQL row into the public MemoryEdge shape, unpacking the JSON metadata column into evidence/autoExtracted fields.

nodes.name: GraphStorePg
nodes.summary: Prisma-backed PostgreSQL implementation of IGraphStore — edge CRUD, BFS neighbor traversal, degree/hub analytics, and path finding — behind a lazily-initialized Proxy so merely importing the module never forces a Prisma client construction.

nodes.name: MemoryGraphService
nodes.summary: Orchestration singleton composing GraphStore, RelationExtractor, and GraphQueries behind lifecycle hooks (onMemoryStored, onMemoryDeleted) and pass-through query methods, so callers never touch graph internals directly.

nodes.name: RelationExtractor
nodes.summary: Finds semantically-similar memories via embedding cosine similarity, then classifies the relationship (contradiction/resolution/derivation/support) using bilingual keyword heuristics before creating a graph edge — runs in the background after each store_memory call.

nodes.name: HandoffAutoInjector
nodes.summary: Subscribes to observation:ingested; on a session-start observation, looks up pending handoffs for the project via HandoffService.listPending and logs a count as an observability signal, never blocking or throwing on the session-start path.

nodes.name: buildHandoffMemoryInput
nodes.summary: Builds the InsertMemoryInput used to dual-write a handoff as a searchable conversation memory, formatting the content and computing tags/importance.

nodes.name: formatMemoryContent
nodes.summary: Renders a handoff's summary, open questions, next steps, and touched files into a single readable memory-content string.

nodes.name: buildPolishPrompt
nodes.summary: Assembles the LLM prompt used to polish a raw handoff summary into a more coherent one.

nodes.name: dedupStrings
nodes.summary: Trims, stringifies, and deduplicates an array-like input while preserving order — used to sanitize open-questions/next-steps/files lists before persisting.

nodes.name: getHandoffService
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and caches the singleton HandoffService.

nodes.name: resetHandoffService
nodes.summary: Clears the cached HandoffService singleton, used to reset state between tests.

nodes.name: HandoffService
nodes.summary: Implements the cross-session handoff state machine (open to accepted/expired), persisting each handoff to the Handoff store and dual-writing it as an FTS-searchable memory, with best-effort LLM summary polishing that degrades safely on failure.

nodes.name: defaultCanonicalize
nodes.summary: Default cwd canonicalizer — resolves symlinks via fs.realpathSync, falling back to a plain path resolve when that fails.

nodes.name: getAttributionResolver
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and caches the singleton AttributionResolver.

nodes.name: resetAttributionResolver
nodes.summary: Clears the cached AttributionResolver singleton, used to reset state between tests.

nodes.name: setAttributionResolverForTests
nodes.summary: Directly injects a test-provided AttributionResolver instance as the singleton, bypassing the normal lazy constructor.

nodes.name: PgWorkspaceRootProvider
nodes.summary: Cached, timeout-bounded reader of registered workspace roots from PostgreSQL, failing open to an empty root list (with a sanitized warning) so a slow or unhealthy database never stalls hook admission.

nodes.name: AttributionResolver
nodes.summary: Resolves the durable project id for a hook event through a strict priority chain — explicit caller match, sticky session pin, path-containment against deduplicated non-broad workspace roots, then verbatim fallback — never rejecting or delaying event admission.

nodes.name: CoRetrievalHook
nodes.summary: Hebbian-style reinforcement hook — on memory:session-stored, finds recent same-session peer memories and creates or strengthens a bounded-weight RELATES_TO graph edge between them so co-retrieved memories keep surfacing together.

nodes.name: symbol-repo-graph.ts
nodes.summary: Graph-query methods for the PostgreSQL symbol repository -- project map snapshots, BFS impact analysis, edge search, and FQN resolution, split out of symbol-repository-pg.ts to keep each module under 500 LOC.

nodes.name: getActiveGraphSnapshot
nodes.summary: Captures one active-generation snapshot for a workspace inside a single transaction -- counts of files/definitions/references/imports/centrality plus diagnostics, used as the input source for project_map.

nodes.name: allFiles
nodes.summary: Returns every indexed relative file path for a project.

nodes.name: allImportEdges
nodes.summary: Returns every import edge (from_file/to_file) recorded for a project.

nodes.name: updateCentrality
nodes.summary: Bulk-writes centrality scores for a project inside a transaction, locking the active generation first to avoid racing a concurrent index run.

nodes.name: findImporters
nodes.summary: Finds every file that imports the given file path.

nodes.name: findReferencesByFqn
nodes.summary: Finds every reference row targeting a given fully-qualified symbol name.

nodes.name: findReferencesByName
nodes.summary: Finds every reference row targeting a given bare symbol name (name-only, non-FQN lookup).

nodes.name: getProjectMapAggregates
nodes.summary: Computes the aggregate counters for project_map -- symbol counts by kind, file counts by language/extension, and the most-recently-indexed files -- inside one transaction.

nodes.name: getProjectMapSnapshot
nodes.summary: Builds the full project_map response in a single transaction -- workspace metadata, centrality rankings, recent files, definitions, references, HTTP/call edges, and architecture data -- the primary read path behind the project_map tool.

nodes.name: runBfsCteImpact
nodes.summary: Runs a recursive-CTE breadth-first search over the import graph to compute which files are transitively impacted by a set of changed files, bounded by hop count.

nodes.name: findEdges
nodes.summary: Dynamically builds and executes a filtered symbol-reference-edge query (by type, from/to symbol, from file, direction) for graph exploration.

nodes.name: countEdgesByKind
nodes.summary: Counts symbol reference rows grouped by reference kind.

nodes.name: resolveDefinitionFqn
nodes.summary: Resolves a definition by modern or legacy FQN within the active generation, returning ambiguous-match candidates when a legacy FQN maps to more than one modern identity.

nodes.name: symbol-repo-identity.ts
nodes.summary: SQL identity helpers that derive definition/reference identity columns (qualified name, canonical signature hash, source span) consumed by the symbol repository's write paths.

nodes.name: definitionIdentityColumns
nodes.summary: Derives the qualified-name and canonical-signature columns written for a symbol definition, parsing its FQN into scope/kind components.

nodes.name: generationDefinitionIdentityColumns

nodes.name: referenceSourceSpan
nodes.summary: Validates and normalizes a reference's source-span byte-offset array before it is persisted.

nodes.name: symbol-repo-mappers.ts
nodes.summary: Raw-row-to-domain-type mapper functions (mapWs, mapFile, mapDef, mapRef, mapImp) that translate PostgreSQL $queryRaw row shapes into the symbol repository's typed domain objects.

nodes.name: mapWs
nodes.summary: Maps a raw workspace row to the WorkspaceRow domain type, converting timestamp columns to epoch millis.

nodes.name: mapFile
nodes.summary: Maps a raw symbol_files row to SymbolFileRow, including parser diagnostics and staleness fields.

nodes.name: mapDef
nodes.summary: Maps a raw symbol_definitions row to the SymbolDefinition domain type.

nodes.name: mapRef
nodes.summary: Maps a raw symbol_references row to the SymbolReference domain type.

nodes.name: mapImp
nodes.summary: Maps a raw symbol_imports row to the SymbolImport domain type.

nodes.name: symbol-repo-queries.ts
nodes.summary: CRUD and query methods for the PostgreSQL symbol repository -- workspace, file, definition, reference, import, and centrality operations plus batch upserts, implemented as free functions delegated to by SymbolRepositoryPg.

nodes.name: getWorkspace
nodes.summary: Fetches one workspace row by project id.

nodes.name: listWorkspaces
nodes.summary: Lists all workspace rows.

nodes.name: upsertFile
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a symbol_files row for one indexed file, including structural parser metadata.

nodes.name: getFile
nodes.summary: Fetches one file row by project id and relative path.

nodes.name: upsertDefinition
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a single symbol_definitions row, deriving its identity columns first.

nodes.name: searchDefinitions
nodes.summary: Searches symbol definitions by name substring with optional kind/exported/file filters -- backs the search_definitions tool.

nodes.name: countDefinitions
nodes.summary: Counts symbol definitions matching the same filter set as searchDefinitions, for pagination totals.

nodes.name: getDefinition
nodes.summary: Fetches one symbol definition by its fully-qualified name.

nodes.name: insertReference
nodes.summary: Inserts one symbol_references row after normalizing its source span.

nodes.name: getReferences
nodes.summary: Fetches reference rows for a symbol name -- backs the go_to_definition/get_references tools.

nodes.name: getImportsFrom
nodes.summary: Fetches all import rows originating from a given file.

nodes.name: upsertCentrality
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates one file's centrality score row.

nodes.name: getTopCentralFiles
nodes.summary: Fetches the highest-centrality-scored files for a project, ordered descending.

nodes.name: getCentrality
nodes.summary: Fetches the full file-to-score centrality map for a project.

nodes.name: batchUpsertDefinitions
nodes.summary: Batch-upserts many symbol definitions inside one transaction, locking the active generations for the affected projects first.

nodes.name: batchInsertReferences
nodes.summary: Batch-inserts many symbol references inside one transaction, locking active generations first.

nodes.name: batchInsertImports
nodes.summary: Batch-inserts many symbol imports inside one transaction, locking active generations first.

nodes.name: findDefinitionsByName
nodes.summary: Finds all definitions matching an exact symbol name.

nodes.name: listDefinitions
nodes.summary: Lists definitions with search/kind/file/exported filters -- a thin wrapper delegating to searchDefinitions.

nodes.name: listAllDefinitions
nodes.summary: Lists every definition for a project with optional kind/exported filters, used by full architecture-map scans.

nodes.name: symbol-repo-types.ts
nodes.summary: Domain type and interface barrel for the symbol repository (SymbolDefinition, SymbolReference, WorkspaceRow, ProjectMapGraphSnapshot, etc.), extracted so importers see no path change after the repository split.

nodes.name: symbol-repo-workspace.ts
nodes.summary: Workspace upsert and status-update methods for the symbol repository, split out of symbol-repo-queries.ts because their legacy-generation bridge and active-counts recompute logic made the main queries module too large.

nodes.name: upsertWorkspace
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a workspace row, bridging legacy-generation counts so pre-generation callers keep working during the migration window.

nodes.name: updateWorkspaceStatus
nodes.summary: Updates a workspace's indexing status plus its active-generation file/chunk/symbol counts, recomputing totals from the live generation scope.

nodes.name: symbol-repository-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed singleton facade for the symbol repository -- implements the SymbolRepositoryPg class as thin one-line delegates to the graph/queries/workspace/mappers/generation modules, and barrel-re-exports their types so import paths stay stable.

nodes.name: SymbolRepositoryPg
nodes.summary: Singleton facade implementing the full symbol-repository surface as one-line delegates to the graph/queries/workspace/generation modules -- the sole entry point other services use for symbol persistence and graph queries.

nodes.name: auto-checkpointer.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks per-agent operation counts and automatically triggers checkpoints via CheckpointManager on count thresholds, errors, or explicit milestones.

nodes.name: AutoCheckpointer
nodes.summary: Singleton that counts agent operations and auto-creates checkpoints via CheckpointManager on a configurable operation-count threshold, on markError, or on explicit markMilestone calls.

nodes.name: checkpoint-manager.ts
nodes.summary: Backend-neutral checkpoint facade that extends PgCheckpointStore with a restoreCheckpoint convenience method performing memory-integrity checks before returning task state.

nodes.name: CheckpointManager
nodes.summary: Backend-neutral checkpoint facade extending PgCheckpointStore; its restoreCheckpoint override runs a memory-existence integrity check and returns restore instructions alongside the raw task state.

nodes.name: checkpoint-store-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL implementation of ICheckpointStore -- persists task checkpoints with an in-memory mirror hydrated from PG on first use, fire-and-forget writes, and gzip-style compression of checkpoint state via Bun's deflate/inflate.

nodes.name: PgCheckpointStore
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL ICheckpointStore implementation -- an in-memory mirror hydrated from PG on first use serves reads while writes are fire-and-forget and chained per-key to avoid races; state is compressed with Bun's deflate/inflate before storage.

nodes.name: checkpoint-store.ts
nodes.summary: ICheckpointStore contract defining the checkpoint storage interface (create/get/list/restore/purge) implemented by PgCheckpointStore, decoupling CheckpointManager from its backend.

nodes.name: resolve.ts
nodes.summary: ETL Stage 3 -- resolves raw import specifiers and symbol references to concrete file paths and FQNs, handling relative imports, tsconfig/monorepo path aliases, and structural (tree-sitter) symbol resolution.

nodes.name: ResolveStage
nodes.summary: ETL pipeline stage that resolves every parsed file's raw import specifiers to concrete project-relative paths (via tsconfig/monorepo alias probing) and resolves structural symbol references to FQNs via the StructuralResolverSession.

nodes.name: memory-clustering.ts
nodes.summary: Groups memories into semantic clusters via a simplified k-means++ over embedding vectors, generating human-readable cluster labels from representative member keywords.

nodes.name: MemoryClustering
nodes.summary: Singleton k-means++ clustering service over stored memory embeddings, producing labeled clusters (dominant type + representative keywords) for topic-summary and consolidation use-cases.

nodes.name: prisma-client.ts
nodes.summary: Lazily-constructed singleton Prisma client wired to the pg adapter for the PostgreSQL-only backend, with a disconnect helper and test-only reset seam.

nodes.name: getPrismaClient
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and memoizes the process-wide Prisma client over a pg Pool via @prisma/adapter-pg, requiring a PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL.

nodes.name: disconnectPrisma
nodes.summary: Disconnects the memoized Prisma client and closes the underlying pg connection pool.

nodes.name: fqn-codec.ts
nodes.summary: Canonical structural-identity codec -- normalizes symbol/file text, canonicalizes signatures, computes SHA-256 signature hashes, and encodes/decodes the modern file~kind~hash FQN format via StructuralFqnRegistry, with legacy-FQN alias resolution.

nodes.name: normalizeStructuralFile
nodes.summary: Normalizes a file path to the canonical POSIX-relative form used inside structural FQNs (NFC unicode, forward slashes, no leading ./ or drive letters, rejects .. segments).

nodes.name: canonicalizeStructuralSignature
nodes.summary: Serializes a symbol's kind/type-tokens/modifiers/parameters/return-type into the versioned, order-stable canonical-signature string that gets SHA-256 hashed for structural identity.

nodes.name: decodeCanonicalSignatureVersion
nodes.summary: Extracts the schema-version prefix embedded in a canonical signature string.

nodes.name: assertCanonicalSignatureSupported
nodes.summary: Guards that a stored canonical signature's embedded version isn't newer than this binary supports, via the shared schema-version check.

nodes.name: createStructuralIdentity
nodes.summary: Builds a full StructuralIdentity (modern FQN, display name, signature hash) from a symbol's raw identity inputs, guarding against symbol names that collide with the reserved kind-hash suffix format.

nodes.name: parseStructuralFqn
nodes.summary: Parses a modern file~kind~hash structural FQN string back into its file/qualifiedName/kind/signatureHash parts.

nodes.name: candidate
nodes.summary: Builds a frozen StructuralFqnCandidate summary (fqn, file, name, kind, signature hash) from a full identity, used when reporting ambiguous-match alternatives.

nodes.name: compareCandidates
nodes.summary: Deterministic sort comparator for structural FQN candidates (by file, then qualified name, then kind, then signature hash).

nodes.name: FqnHashCollisionError
nodes.summary: Typed error thrown when a symbol's name collides with the reserved modern-FQN kind-hash suffix pattern, carrying the offending signature hash.

nodes.name: StructuralFqnRegistry
nodes.summary: Per-generation registry mapping structural identities by modern FQN and by legacy-FQN alias, detecting and reporting hash-collision or ambiguous legacy-alias cases as symbols are registered.

nodes.name: resolver.ts
nodes.summary: Structural-resolver registry and per-generation resolution session -- StructuralResolverRegistry dispatches by dialect to a language-specific resolver, and StructuralResolverSession resolves symbol references to FQNs across a batch of parsed documents.

nodes.name: buildStructuralResolverDefinitions
nodes.summary: Flattens every parsed document's structural symbols into StructuralResolverDefinition records, computing each symbol's exported/qualified-name/lexical-scope metadata used later for reference matching.

nodes.name: StructuralResolverRegistry
nodes.summary: Registry mapping a language dialect to its StructuralLanguageResolver implementation, enforcing one resolver version per dialect and exposing forDialect/requireDialect lookups.

nodes.name: StructuralResolverSession
nodes.summary: Per-ETL-run resolution session -- builds a StructuralFqnRegistry and per-file identity index from a batch of parsed documents, then resolves individual symbol references to FQNs by dispatching to the dialect-appropriate resolver.

nodes.name: data-document.ts
nodes.summary: Language resolver for document/data dialects (SFC, CommonMark-GFM, JSON, YAML) that reuses the TypeScript resolver's logic verbatim for embedded-reference resolution.

nodes.name: functional.ts
nodes.summary: Language resolver for the functional-language cohort (Elixir, Erlang, Clojure, OCaml, Haskell) -- rewrites unresolved wildcard/module-qualified references into TypeScript-resolver-compatible import bindings before delegating.

nodes.name: managed.ts
nodes.summary: Language resolver for managed-runtime languages (Java, Kotlin, Scala, C#, Swift, Dart) -- rewrites static-import and wildcard bindings to match owner-qualified names before delegating to the TypeScript resolver.

nodes.name: scripting.ts
nodes.summary: Language resolver for the scripting cohort (Python, Ruby, PHP, Lua/LuaJIT) -- syntax-independent identity/import/global resolution delegated straight to the TypeScript resolver.

nodes.name: systems.ts
nodes.summary: Language resolver for systems languages (C, C++, Go, Rust, Zig) -- normalizes header/module-relative import specifiers per dialect before delegating to the TypeScript resolver.

nodes.name: typescript.ts
nodes.summary: Reference-object resolution engine underlying every dialect's language resolver -- matches unresolved references against same-file, imported, and re-exported (barrel) definition candidates, disambiguating overloads by kind and computing structural FQN candidates.

nodes.name: candidates
nodes.summary: Converts a list of structural identities into frozen, sorted StructuralFqnCandidate summaries for ambiguous-match reporting.

nodes.name: outcome
nodes.summary: Builds a StructuralResolverOutcome (resolved/ambiguous/unresolved) from a set of matched definitions, deduplicating by FQN.

nodes.name: normalizedReference
nodes.summary: Normalizes a reference's lexical scope, target name, and qualifier (NFC unicode, private-field # handling) before matching.

nodes.name: indexDefinitions
nodes.summary: Indexes resolver definitions by bare name and by percent-escaped qualified name for O(1) candidate lookup during matching, and registers each with the FQN registry.

nodes.name: probe
nodes.summary: Probes a candidate relative path against the known-files set, trying JS/TS extension variants and directory-index fallbacks.

nodes.name: resolveStructuralSpecifier
nodes.summary: Resolves a raw import specifier (relative, path-alias, or bare) to a known project file path, the core specifier-resolution primitive reused by every dialect resolver.

nodes.name: matchesStructuralPathAlias
nodes.summary: Tests whether an import specifier matches any configured tsconfig-style path alias pattern.

nodes.name: exportedMatches
nodes.summary: Recursively resolves a sought export name through a file's own definitions and, for re-export forms, through the files it forwards to (barrel following), cycle-guarded by a visited set.

nodes.name: importedMatches
nodes.summary: Resolves a reference that originated from an import statement -- determines the imported file, the imported/local binding name, and whether to match a default, named, or namespace export, across every supported dialect's import forms.

nodes.name: sameFileMatches
nodes.summary: Resolves a reference against definitions in the same file, narrowing by lexical scope when the reference has one.

nodes.name: schema-version.ts
nodes.summary: Centralizes the schema-ahead guard for persisted structural/checkpoint data -- compares a stored semver-like version stamp against the running binary's supported version and throws SchemaAheadError only when the stored version is strictly newer.

nodes.name: parseSemver
nodes.summary: Parses a semver-like MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH string into numeric components, returning null on any malformed or non-integer part.

nodes.name: isStrictlyNewer
nodes.summary: Compares two semver-like strings, returning true only when the stored version is strictly newer than the supported version (malformed versions never compare as newer).

nodes.name: assertSchemaSupported
nodes.summary: Throws SchemaAheadError when a persisted row's schema version is strictly newer than this binary supports; the single guard every read path funnels through.

nodes.name: SchemaAheadError
nodes.summary: Typed error carrying the versioned-payload kind, stored version, and supported version when a read encounters data written by newer code than is running.

nodes.name: get_index_status.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler that queries an async indexing job's status and progress via the in-memory IndexJobTracker.

nodes.name: GetIndexStatusTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler (get_index_status) that looks up an async indexing job by id via indexJobTracker and reports its status, progress, and elapsed/estimated time.

nodes.name: list_checkpoints.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler that lists saved task checkpoints with optional filtering by task/project/type, delegating to CheckpointManager and serializing the response via serializeToolResponse.

nodes.name: ListCheckpointsTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler (list_checkpoints) that lists and filters saved task checkpoints via CheckpointManager and serializes the response, distinct from session-continuity snapshots.

nodes.name: restore_checkpoint.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler that restores a saved task checkpoint (by ID or latest-for-task), returning task state plus memory/file integrity checks via CheckpointManager.

nodes.name: RestoreCheckpointTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler (restore_checkpoint) that restores a checkpoint by id or the latest for a task via CheckpointManager, returning task state plus memory/file integrity results.

nodes.name: synapse-temporal-inhibition.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the temporal-inhibition module, covering temporal-indicator detection and the anti-recency score penalty across enabled/disabled, temporal-query, and no-createdAt edge cases.

nodes.name: synapse-working-memory-buffer.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit tests for WorkingMemoryBuffer covering put/get hit-boost math, primed-entry content-token matching, eviction, and snapshot/restore round-tripping.

nodes.name: synapse-consumer-seam.test.ts
nodes.summary: Test-seam contract test that feeds a frozen search-response fixture into WorkingMemoryBuffer.prime()/get() to detect SearchResult schema drift before it silently breaks Synapse.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the 'frozen fixture' pattern: intentionally mutating a captured real response to assert the extractor fails loudly on shape drift rather than silently passing.

nodes.name: working-memory-buffer.ts
nodes.summary: Session-scoped hot cache for retrieval results, keyed by result id, that matches new queries against past queries (or primed content) via Jaccard token overlap and boosts hit scores; includes snapshot/restore helpers so a session's buffer survives a process restart.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public barrel for the Synapse cognitive-modulation layer; re-exports all submodules and hosts the lazy SynapseManager singleton read from runtime config.

nodes.name: chain-inhibition.ts
nodes.summary: Detects query intent (decision/debug/pattern/symbol) via regex heuristics and boosts or suppresses search results whose memory-chain type matches, including a filePath-based type fallback for code-search results with no explicit type metadata.

nodes.name: confidence-gate.ts
nodes.summary: Adaptive relevance gate that classifies a query as specific/focused/broad via cheap heuristics and filters results below a class-proportional score threshold, preferring the raw pre-RRF vector score over the normalized one to avoid letting noise through on weak queries.

nodes.name: diversity-penalty.ts
nodes.summary: MMR-inspired re-ranker that demotes results too textually similar (Jaccard over tokens) or from the same file as a higher-ranked result, so the top-N results cover more distinct topics.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the four inhibition strategies (diversity penalty, confidence gate, temporal inhibition, chain inhibition) as the module's public surface.

nodes.name: temporal-inhibition.ts
nodes.summary: Anti-recency-bias filter that penalizes memories younger than a configurable age when the query itself carries no temporal intent, preventing freshness from masquerading as relevance.

nodes.name: type-inference.ts
nodes.summary: Heuristic that infers a synthetic memory-chain type (code, code-test, documentation) from a result's filePath, letting chain inhibition operate on code-search results that carry no explicit type metadata.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: One-line barrel re-exporting the score-spectrum metacognition function and its config type.

nodes.name: score-spectrum.ts
nodes.summary: Computes spread/mean/confidence over a result-score distribution and derives mutually-exclusive metacognition flags (definitiveMatch, noStrongMatch, lowConfidence) so callers can tell when retrieval itself is unsure.

nodes.name: embedding-evolution.ts
nodes.summary: Experimental (default-off) synaptic-plasticity helper that blends a memory's original embedding toward the centroid of the query embeddings that recently retrieved it, skipping the blend when drift exceeds a cosine-similarity threshold to avoid destabilizing multi-context memories.

nodes.name: strengthen.ts
nodes.summary: Pure analysis function that computes importance-score deltas for memories based on recent access frequency, graph-edge count, and decision references, using a smooth ramped boost instead of a hard threshold cliff; callers such as a consolidation job apply the deltas via the DB layer.

nodes.name: prefetch.ts
nodes.summary: Experimental (default-off) predictive-prefetch helpers that derive topic keywords from a file path and its symbols, build a search plan from them, and prime a session's working-memory buffer with the fetched results ahead of the agent's next query.

nodes.name: agent-affinity.ts
nodes.summary: Computes a [0,1] agent-affinity signal combining authorship (did this agent create the memory) and in-session usage frequency, used as one input to attention scoring.

nodes.name: attention-score.ts
nodes.summary: Multi-signal re-ranker that folds semantic, recency, access-heat, task-alignment, and agent-affinity signals into a final score over the top-N results, with active-weight renormalization so signals with no available data (e.g. no session) don't collapse the score.
nodes.languageNotes: Renormalizes weights over only the structurally-available signals per call, so a degenerate case (no session, no createdAt) still preserves the original RRF ordering instead of collapsing every score toward zero.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the attention-score, task-alignment, and agent-affinity scoring functions as the scoring module's public surface.

nodes.name: task-alignment.ts
nodes.summary: Measures how relevant a candidate result is to the agent session's current task, preferring embedding cosine similarity when both sides carry embeddings and falling back to token-overlap Jaccard over the result content.

nodes.name: session-registry.ts
nodes.summary: In-memory registry of ephemeral agent sessions keyed by sessionId, with lazy TTL sliding on access, LRU-bounded access-history tracking, and write-through/lazy-load delegation to an optional durable SessionStore; exposes a lazy-singleton factory that falls back to an in-memory store if the PostgreSQL-backed one fails to initialize.

nodes.name: session-store-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed implementation of the Synapse SessionStore that serves synchronous reads from an in-memory mirror hydrated from PG on first use, writes fire-and-forget via raw SQL against synapse_sessions/synapse_access_history, and chains per-session writes so concurrent access-count updates commit in call order.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses raw $queryRaw/$executeRaw instead of the Prisma query builder to sidestep a Prisma 7.7.0 + adapter-pg incompatibility, mirroring the same pattern used by PgScheduledJobStore/MemoryRepositoryPg elsewhere in the codebase.

nodes.name: session-store.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the synchronous SessionStore contract, a no-op MemorySessionStore test double, and the lazy-singleton factory that always instantiates PgSynapseSessionStore in production (requiring DATABASE_URL to be set).
nodes.languageNotes: Extremely condensed single-line-per-member style packs the interface, test double, and factory into 12 lines total.

nodes.name: synapse-manager.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full post-retrieval Synapse pipeline in a fixed order -- buffer merge, pre-gate, attention re-rank, chain inhibition, diversity penalty, temporal inhibition, confidence gate, then metacognition spectrum -- and writes survivors back into the session's working-memory buffer for the next query.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared type definitions for the Synapse cognitive-modulation layer: query classification, metacognition flags, the ephemeral AgentSession shape, query-intent-to-chain-boost mapping, and the full pipeline result shape.

nodes.name: WorkingMemoryBuffer
nodes.summary: Map-backed hot cache of SearchResults for a session; put()/get() match new queries against remembered query or content tokens via Jaccard, apply a hit-score boost off a stable baseline score, and evict by TTL or over-capacity lowest-score-first.

nodes.name: restoreWorkingMemoryBuffer
nodes.summary: Reconstructs a live WorkingMemoryBuffer from a persisted snapshot, skipping already-expired entries and treating a missing/malformed snapshot as a signal to start with a fresh buffer.

nodes.name: snapshotWorkingMemoryBuffer
nodes.summary: Serializes a live WorkingMemoryBuffer's entries and config into a plain BufferSnapshot for persistence, shared by session stores.

nodes.name: getSynapseManager
nodes.summary: Lazy singleton accessor that constructs the SynapseManager from the current runtime config on first call and caches it.

nodes.name: detectIntent
nodes.summary: Classifies a query string into decision/debug/pattern/symbol/general intent by testing it against specificity-ordered regex pattern groups.

nodes.name: extractType
nodes.summary: Reads a result's memory-chain type from metadata.type or metadata.context.type, falling back to a filePath-derived synthetic type when neither is present.

nodes.name: applyChainInhibition
nodes.summary: Applies the detected intent's per-chain boost multipliers to each result's score and re-sorts, passing results through unchanged for general intent or untyped results.

nodes.name: classifyQuery
nodes.summary: Classifies a query as specific/focused/broad using regex signals (file paths, identifier casing, function calls, quoted symbols) and a technical-keyword count, driving the adaptive confidence threshold.

nodes.name: prefilterByRawScore
nodes.summary: Cheap pre-pipeline filter that drops only results whose raw pre-RRF vector score is already below the classified threshold, sparing the expensive downstream re-ranking stages from candidates that would be cut anyway.

nodes.name: applyConfidenceGate
nodes.summary: Final-stage filter that drops results below the query-class-proportional relevance threshold, using the raw vector score when available instead of the RRF-normalized one.

nodes.name: applyDiversityPenalty
nodes.summary: MMR-style re-ranker that walks results in score order and multiplicatively penalizes each candidate's score for token-Jaccard similarity and same-filePath overlap with already-selected higher-ranked results.

nodes.name: hasTemporalIndicator
nodes.summary: Checks whether a query contains an English or Portuguese temporal indicator word (e.g. 'recent', 'hoje'), used to skip the anti-recency penalty when the user is explicitly asking for what's new.

nodes.name: applyTemporalInhibition
nodes.summary: Subtracts a fixed score penalty from results younger than a configurable age when the query carries no temporal intent, then re-sorts.

nodes.name: inferTypeFromPath
nodes.summary: Applies ordered regex rules to a file path to infer a synthetic memory-chain type (code-test, documentation, or code), returning null when the path gives no signal.

nodes.name: analyzeSpectrum
nodes.summary: Computes min/max/mean/spread/confidence over a set of result scores and derives three mutually-exclusive flags -- definitiveMatch, noStrongMatch, lowConfidence -- prioritized so a single strong hit isn't misclassified as low-confidence.

nodes.name: evolveEmbeddings
nodes.summary: Blends each memory's original embedding toward the centroid of its recent query embeddings when enough samples exist and drift stays within the configured cosine threshold, returning the batch of blended updates for the caller to persist.

nodes.name: computeStrengthenUpdates
nodes.summary: Sums ramped (non-cliff) boosts for recent-access frequency, graph-edge count, and decision-reference flags into a capped importance delta per memory, returning only memories whose importance actually increased.

nodes.name: extractTopics
nodes.summary: Tokenizes a file path and its symbol names into deduplicated, stop-word-filtered lowercase topic keywords for use as a prefetch search query.

nodes.name: buildPrefetchPlan
nodes.summary: Turns extracted topics plus prefetch config into a concrete PrefetchPlan (query string, chains, thresholds, TTL) for the caller to execute.

nodes.name: executePrefetch
nodes.summary: Builds a prefetch plan, fetches matching entries via a caller-supplied function, and primes the working-memory buffer with the results, swallowing fetch errors into a skippedReason summary.

nodes.name: computeAgentAffinity
nodes.summary: Combines an authorship bonus (result created by the current agent) with a usage-frequency bonus (session access count, capped) into a clamped [0,1] agent-affinity score.

nodes.name: applyAttentionScore
nodes.summary: Re-ranks the top rerankWindow results by a weighted sum of semantic, recency, access-heat, task-alignment, and agent-affinity signals, renormalizing weights over only the structurally-available signals so missing session/metadata never collapses the score, and appends the untouched tail.

nodes.name: computeTaskAlignment
nodes.summary: Scores how aligned a result is with the session's current task via embedding cosine similarity when both sides carry embeddings, otherwise via token-overlap Jaccard against the task context.

nodes.name: SessionRegistry
nodes.summary: In-memory Map of AgentSessions keyed by sessionId with lazy TTL-sliding on get(), LRU-bounded per-session access-history tracking, and best-effort write-through/lazy-load delegation to an optional durable SessionStore.

nodes.name: getSessionRegistry
nodes.summary: Lazy singleton that wires the durable session store (falling back to an in-memory store if PG-backed store construction throws) and constructs the SessionRegistry with it.

nodes.name: PgSynapseSessionStore
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed SessionStore whose synchronous save/load/recordAccess/delete are served from an in-memory mirror hydrated from PG on first use, with fire-and-forget raw-SQL persistence chained per-session so concurrent writes commit in call order.

nodes.name: MemorySessionStore
nodes.summary: No-op SessionStore test double whose save/load/delete/recordAccess methods are all no-ops; production code always uses PgSynapseSessionStore instead.

nodes.name: getSessionStore
nodes.summary: Lazy singleton factory that validates a PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL is configured and constructs the sole PgSynapseSessionStore instance.

nodes.name: SynapseManager
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the post-retrieval Synapse pipeline's process() method, composing buffer merge, scoring, and inhibition stages over a result set in a fixed order and recording which filters actually ran.

nodes.name: compaction-snapshot-service.ts
nodes.summary: Builds a bounded (<2KB), reference-based XML compaction snapshot from a session's observations — a table-of-contents with runnable recall/search calls rather than inlined data, used on /compact or the PreCompact hook to preserve session continuity without truncating raw events.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses codepoint-safe truncation (spreading the string into an array) rather than naive slicing, avoiding splits inside multi-byte Unicode characters.

nodes.name: hook-service.ts
nodes.summary: Validates, normalizes, and admits passive lifecycle hook events onto a single-writer queue, persisting each as an Observation, publishing `observation:ingested`, and debounce-triggering the observation-consolidation bridge; fire-and-forget with 429-on-saturation semantics.

nodes.name: observation-extractor.ts
nodes.summary: Pure, side-effect-free classifier pipeline that derives a semantic ObservationCategory from a lifecycle event's (source, payload) shape — normalizing tool names across hosts and dispatching through an ordered set of category classifiers, falling back to "lifecycle-raw" when nothing matches.

nodes.name: search-session-hook.ts
nodes.summary: Event-driven hook that subscribes to `search:completed` on the EventBus and auto-stores a lightweight, deduplicated session memory for every non-empty search, bridging ephemeral search context into the persistent memory layer.

nodes.name: session-pin-store.ts
nodes.summary: Bounded, TTL-expiring in-memory map from sessionId to projectId used for sticky hook-attribution pinning; an optimization only — process restart or eviction safely degrades attribution to a legal containment/verbatim fallback.

nodes.name: writer-queue.ts
nodes.summary: Single-writer promise-chain queue that serializes observation-persist writes so the hook ingestion fire-hose cannot starve readers, throwing QueueSaturatedError (mapped to HTTP 429) when the queue is full.

nodes.name: auto-improve-apply.ts
nodes.summary: Apply-phase logic for the auto-improve job — fail-closed payload validation and the actual memory.create / memory.update / memory.tag proposal application against the memory repository, rejecting pinned or malformed targets.

nodes.name: auto-improve-config.ts
nodes.summary: Thresholds, fallback defaults, and the defensive config reader for the auto-improve job, plus the set of valid memory-type strings used by apply-phase validation.

nodes.name: auto-improve-job.ts
nodes.summary: Facade for the Phase-5 auto-improvement loop — reviews recent observations for a project, detects recurring patterns, and proposes memory edits as pending/auto-approved proposals; re-exports and thinly delegates to its decomposed sibling modules (patterns, llm, apply, config, ops).
nodes.languageNotes: Barrel-style facade: the class body is almost entirely one-line delegates to sibling modules, and the file re-exports their public symbols so callers only need one import.

nodes.name: summarizeObservation
nodes.summary: Extracts a short representative summary token from an observation's JSON payload based on its category (files, git, prompts, errors, etc.) for inclusion in the snapshot table of contents.

nodes.name: buildRetrievalCall
nodes.summary: Builds the runnable recall/search MCP tool-call string (with deduped query tokens) that lets a resuming agent re-fetch a section's full raw events on demand.

nodes.name: getCompactionSnapshotService
nodes.summary: Factory returning (and memoizing) the singleton CompactionSnapshotService, defaulting to the shared observation store.

nodes.name: resetCompactionSnapshotService
nodes.summary: Test hook that clears the cached singleton CompactionSnapshotService instance.

nodes.name: CompactionSnapshotService
nodes.summary: Builds and XML-serializes a session's compaction snapshot — groups observations by category, ranks sections by activity, and trims to a hard byte ceiling while never dropping the underlying raw data.

nodes.name: validateEvent
nodes.summary: Pure validation/normalization of an incoming lifecycle event (kind, projectId, payload size, importance) into a discriminated union carrying an HTTP-like 400/413 error code on failure.

nodes.name: resolveDefaultBridge
nodes.summary: Resolves the production consolidation bridge to the real ObservationConsolidationJob (falling back to a no-op) so hook ingestion never crashes if the job is unavailable.

nodes.name: getHookService
nodes.summary: Factory returning (and memoizing) the singleton HookService wired with the default consolidation bridge.

nodes.name: resetHookService
nodes.summary: Test hook that clears the cached singleton HookService instance.

nodes.name: HookService
nodes.summary: Core service accepting single/batch lifecycle events, validating them, resolving attribution, and enqueueing persistence onto the WriterQueue with fire-and-forget semantics and debounced consolidation triggering.

nodes.name: ValidationError
nodes.summary: Typed error carrying an HTTP-like 400/413 status code for hook validation failures.

nodes.name: classifyToolCall
nodes.summary: Primary classifier mapping normalized tool names (Read, Write, Bash, Grep, etc., including MCP-namespaced calls) to their observation category.

nodes.name: classifyUserPrompt
nodes.summary: Classifies a user-prompt payload into goal/plan/decision/constraint/rejection/blocked/role categories via keyword-prefix and phrase matching.

nodes.name: classifySessionStart
nodes.summary: Classifies a session-start payload into session-settings, cwd-changes, or env-changes based on which fields are present.

nodes.name: classifyError
nodes.summary: Detects tool-response errors (explicit error flag/field or stdout error/failed markers) on post-tool-use events.

nodes.name: classifyRuleFile
nodes.summary: Detects reads of project rule files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, etc.) and classifies them as "rules".

nodes.name: classifyGitPayload
nodes.summary: Detects git operations directly from payload command/diff fields, independent of the Bash tool-call classification path.

nodes.name: extractCategory
nodes.summary: Public entry point running the ordered classifier pipeline over (source, payload), defensively catching classifier exceptions and falling back to source-based defaults.

nodes.name: SearchSessionHook
nodes.summary: Singleton hook that subscribes to search-completion events, dedupes by (session, project, query) within a TTL window, and stores a low-importance auto-tagged memory via MemoryController.

nodes.name: SessionPinStore
nodes.summary: LRU-ish bounded map (max size + lazy TTL expiry, oldest-access eviction) pinning a session id to a project id for sticky hook attribution.

nodes.name: QueueSaturatedError
nodes.summary: Typed error thrown when the writer queue is at capacity, carrying a retry-after-seconds hint for the caller.

nodes.name: WriterQueue
nodes.summary: Serializes async work onto a single promise chain with a pending-count cap; a failure in one queued item never poisons the chain.

nodes.name: validateCreatePayload
nodes.summary: Fail-closed validator for memory.create proposal payloads (type/importance/tags shape checks), throwing ApplyRejection on any violation.

nodes.name: buildUpdatePatch
nodes.summary: Builds a validated UpdateMemoryPatch from a memory.update proposal payload.

nodes.name: applyProposal
nodes.summary: Applies a proposal record (create/update/tag) against the injected memory-repo seam, dispatching on record.kind.

nodes.name: readTargetForApply
nodes.summary: Reads and guards a proposal's target memory row, rejecting when unreadable or pinned.

nodes.name: ApplyRejection
nodes.summary: Typed error carrying a reason code (pinned / unreadable_target / malformed-payload) for a rejected proposal apply.

nodes.name: readAutoImproveConfig
nodes.summary: Defensively reads memory.autoImprove config with a hard-coded fallback when the config block is absent (e.g. process-wide-mocked tests).

nodes.name: getAutoImproveJob
nodes.summary: Factory returning (and memoizing) the singleton AutoImproveJob.

nodes.name: resetAutoImproveJob
nodes.summary: Test hook that clears the cached singleton AutoImproveJob.

nodes.name: AutoImproveJob
nodes.summary: Central job class wiring the observation/proposal/memory stores and LLM surface, with debounced maybeRun triggering and thin one-line delegates to the ops module for runOnce/approve/reject.

nodes.name: auto-improve-llm.ts
nodes.summary: Optional LLM-based refinement of rule-based auto-improve pattern candidates — rewrites content/rationale via a zod-validated schema, silently degrading to the verbatim rule-based candidates when the LLM is disabled or fails.

nodes.name: auto-improve-ops.ts
nodes.summary: Run/approve/reject operations for the auto-improve job (extracted from the facade class) — detects patterns, optionally LLM-enriches them, creates proposals, and auto-approves them when the review gate is off.

nodes.name: auto-improve-patterns.ts
nodes.summary: Pure, LLM-free rule-based pattern detection over recent observations — frequency-counts recurring queries, hot files, and repeated edit signatures, and turns qualifying ones into proposal-candidate drafts.

nodes.name: memory-consolidation-job.ts
nodes.summary: Backend-polymorphic background job that decays stale memory importance, soft-deletes cold/old/low-access memories, and LLM-merges near-duplicate memories into consolidated batches linked via SUPERSEDES graph edges.

nodes.name: observation-consolidation-job.ts
nodes.summary: Phase-3 consolidation bridge that summarizes a recency window of raw observations per project into a structured memory via the LLM + shared ConsolidatedBatchSchema, debounce-triggered from the hook-ingestion writer turn; silently no-ops when the LLM is disabled.

nodes.name: consolidator.ts
nodes.summary: Two-stage memory-consolidation window — a pure cosine-similarity clique prefilter (no LLM) followed by an LLM merge step producing a zod-validated ConsolidatedBatch; returns null whenever no cluster qualifies or the LLM is unavailable/fails.

nodes.name: decay.ts
nodes.summary: Pure, dependency-free memory-salience decay function blending a recency-decayed importance term with an access-reinforcement term (pinned memories exempt); used by both the memory-consolidation job and MemoryService's ranking.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately has zero runtime dependencies beyond a shared type import, keeping it unit-testable without a database — the header comment calls this out explicitly.

nodes.name: memory-service.ts
nodes.summary: Pure domain-logic singleton for the memory subsystem — ID generation, L0-L4 level determination from agent hierarchy/scope rules, row-to-domain mapping, and the semantic/temporal/access/type-weighted ranking algorithm. No DB calls.

nodes.name: rlm-synapse.ts
nodes.summary: Synapse session-state and graph-stream delegate functions extracted from ContextualSearchRLM — applies per-session Synapse buffer injection to base search results, fuzzy-corrects single-term queries, and builds a BFS graph-neighbor RRF stream bridging chunk ids to memory ids.

nodes.name: enrichWithLlm
nodes.summary: Refines pattern candidates via the injected LLM surface's structured-object call, merging refined content/rationale back onto matching candidates by signalKey; never throws.

nodes.name: buildEnrichmentPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the LLM prompt listing candidate drafts plus recent observation context for the enrichment call.

nodes.name: runOnce
nodes.summary: One auto-improve cycle: lists recent observations, detects patterns, optionally LLM-enriches, dedupes by signal key, creates proposals, and auto-approves unless the review gate is enabled.

nodes.name: approve
nodes.summary: Approves a pending proposal — applies it to the memory store, flips its status, and publishes memory:auto-improved.

nodes.name: reject
nodes.summary: Rejects a pending proposal, flipping its status without applying it.

nodes.name: detectPatterns
nodes.summary: Frequency-analyzes observations into recurring-query / hot-file / recurring-fix candidates, gated by per-signal thresholds.

nodes.name: extractQuery
nodes.summary: Extracts and normalizes a user-prompt's query text into a dedup signature.

nodes.name: extractFilePath
nodes.summary: Extracts a file path from a tool-call payload across several possible field shapes.

nodes.name: extractFixSignature
nodes.summary: Builds a tool:pathBucket signature representing a recurring edit pattern.

nodes.name: pathBucket
nodes.summary: Returns the parent-directory portion of a path, or "root" when there is none.

nodes.name: normalizeSignature
nodes.summary: Normalizes free text into a short, stopword-filtered, sorted 3-token signature for dedup grouping.

nodes.name: truncate
nodes.summary: Truncates a string to max characters with an ellipsis suffix.

nodes.name: addSupercedesEdge
nodes.summary: Creates a SUPERSEDES graph edge from a newly merged memory to one of its source memories via the polymorphic IGraphStore contract.

nodes.name: MemoryConsolidationJob
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the decay → prune → promote → merge consolidation cycle on a debounce timer, backend-polymorphic via getMemoryRepository()/getGraphStore(), with LLM-gated silent-degrade on the merge phase.

nodes.name: readBridgeConfig
nodes.summary: Defensively reads hooks.bridge config with a hard-coded fallback when the block is absent.

nodes.name: buildObservationPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the LLM consolidation prompt from a recency window of observations.

nodes.name: ObservationConsolidationJob
nodes.summary: Debounce-gated bridge (by observation count or time interval) that summarizes a project's recent observations into one memory via the LLM object surface, publishing memory:consolidated; observations are always retained.

nodes.name: vecFrom
nodes.summary: Normalizes a stored embedding (Buffer/Uint8Array/Float32Array/number[]) into a plain number array.

nodes.name: cosineSimilarity
nodes.summary: Standard cosine similarity between two equal-length vectors.

nodes.name: pickConsolidationWindow
nodes.summary: Greedy clique search grouping candidates by project and mutual cosine similarity above a threshold, seeded by the most-recent embedded candidate.

nodes.name: buildPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the LLM merge prompt for a consolidation window.

nodes.name: consolidateWindow
nodes.summary: Runs the full two-stage consolidation (cosine prefilter + LLM merge) over a candidate set, returning null when no cluster qualifies or the LLM is unavailable/fails.

nodes.name: rowsToCandidates
nodes.summary: Converts MemoryRow[] into the lighter ConsolidateCandidate[] shape consumed by the prefilter.

nodes.name: decayScore
nodes.summary: Computes the decayed salience score for a memory, blending recency decay with access reinforcement; pinned memories return importance unchanged.

nodes.name: isCold
nodes.summary: Whether a memory's decayed score falls below the cold/prune threshold.

nodes.name: MemoryService
nodes.summary: Singleton owning memory ID generation, L0-L4 level determination, and semanticRank scoring (65% semantic + 20% temporal + 10% access + 5% type-boost), delegating temporal scoring to the shared decayScore.

nodes.name: applySynapseStateImpl
nodes.summary: Looks up the caller's Synapse session and, when workspace-scoped, runs SynapseManager.process to inject buffered results into the base search results; silently degrades to the base results on any lookup/processing failure.

nodes.name: correctQueryImpl
nodes.summary: Fuzzy-corrects a single-term query via the keyword store's vocabulary; declines multi-term queries as unsafe to rewrite.

nodes.name: buildGraphStreamImpl
nodes.summary: Builds the depth-2 BFS graph-neighbor result stream, bridging vector/code chunk ids to memory ids via filePath/symbol anchor lookups before walking the graph store; silent-omit on any failure.

nodes.name: compact_snapshot.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool wrapping CompactionSnapshotService — builds a session's reference-based compaction snapshot and optionally persists it as a `compaction-snapshots` observation with resolved attribution.

nodes.name: delete_memory.ts
nodes.summary: Thin MCP tool that hard-deletes a memory (and its graph edges) by delegating to MemoryController.

nodes.name: search_memories.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool for semantic memory search across sessions — validates filters, delegates to MemoryController.search, and shapes the response (including related-memory context) before serialization.

nodes.name: serialize-interfaces.ts
