nodes.summary: Explicit TypeScript contracts (GroupRowsByPrefixOptions, GroupedResult, GroupedGroup, GroupedRow) for the grouped-format helper in serialize.ts, shared verbatim by tools that consume grouped/tree output so interface drift fails the batch.

nodes.name: serialize.ts
nodes.summary: Shared serializer for MCP tool success-path responses — field projection (dotted-path, array-aware), TOON/JSON/tree format encoding, and the grouped-by-path-prefix helper used by both format:"tree" and format:"json" with grouped:true.

nodes.name: store_memory.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool for storing a new memory into the hierarchical memory system, delegating validation and persistence to MemoryController.store.

nodes.name: update_memory.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool for partially updating an existing memory (content re-embedding, importance, tag replace/merge), delegating to MemoryController.update.

nodes.name: CompactSnapshotTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation for compact_snapshot — builds the snapshot via the shared CompactionSnapshotService and optionally persists it through the attribution resolver.

nodes.name: DeleteMemoryTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation for delete_memory — thin delegate to MemoryController.delete.

nodes.name: SearchMemoriesTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation for search_memories — delegates to MemoryController.search and maps results into the wire response shape.

nodes.name: serializeToolResponse
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point — projects fields, then routes to grouped/tree/toon/json encoding based on options.

nodes.name: projectFields
nodes.summary: Recursively projects an object/array down to the requested dotted field paths, silently dropping unknown keys.

nodes.name: unescapeJsonField
nodes.summary: Detects and parses escaped-JSON string values into nested structures for projected output.

nodes.name: projectPath
nodes.summary: Recursive dotted-path walker used by projectFields for nested field projections.

nodes.name: mergeProjection
nodes.summary: Merges two projections sharing a top-level key (array element-wise or shallow object merge).

nodes.name: groupRowsByPrefix
nodes.summary: Groups rows by a 2-segment path prefix with per-group row caps and a group cap folding overflow into (other), powering both tree and grouped-JSON output.

nodes.name: resolvePrefix
nodes.summary: Resolves a row's group prefix from an explicit field or a derived file-path prefix.

nodes.name: twoSegmentPrefix
nodes.summary: Extracts the 2-segment directory prefix from a file path.

nodes.name: groupedToTree
nodes.summary: Renders a GroupedResult as a text-indented tree string.

nodes.name: treeFlat
nodes.summary: Fallback flat-tree text rendering for ungrouped data.

nodes.name: StoreMemoryTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation for store_memory — thin delegate to MemoryController.store with a broad input schema (type/tags/linkTo/importance).

nodes.name: UpdateMemoryTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation for update_memory — thin delegate to MemoryController.update.

nodes.name: architecture-map.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the architecture-map feature end-to-end: pure Louvain community detection, package/entry-point/route/hotspot heuristics and layer classification, and the computeArchitectureMap orchestrator, plus an ETL-fixture integration test asserting getProjectMap's additive architecture fields without breaking backward compatibility.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-layer test structure: pure unit tests with no DB, then a throwaway-projectId ETL fixture integration test that never triggers a full-repo index.

nodes.name: centrality.test.ts
nodes.summary: Pure unit tests for computePageRank covering empty graphs, single nodes, import-target score boosting, self-loop and unknown-endpoint edge skipping, [0,1] normalization, and convergence behavior.

nodes.name: cycle-detection.property.test.ts
nodes.summary: Property-based test validating the iterative Tarjan SCC implementation in detectCycles against a brute-force O(V^3) reachability oracle across 100 random small graphs, guarding against subtle lowlink-update bugs in the iterative algorithm.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a seeded mulberry32 PRNG for deterministic, reproducible fuzz-graph generation rather than Math.random().

nodes.name: cycle-detection.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the iterative Tarjan SCC detectCycles implementation covering mandated fixtures (self-loop, shared-node cycles, K5 fully-connected, disconnected cycles, DAG), edge-budget truncation, run-to-run determinism, and an RSS memory-growth guard on a 500k-edge stress case.

nodes.name: definition-lookup.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the shared definition-identity lookup path (findDefinitionsByName resolution semantics) used jointly by TracePathService, SymbolGraphService, and SearchDefinitionsTool.

nodes.name: filter-validation.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for validateFilters covering the include/exclude pattern-count cap, invalid-glob teaching errors, and the same-pattern contradiction downgrade where the exclude entry is dropped, include survives, and a downgrade record is emitted.

nodes.name: get-architecture.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for GetArchitectureTool's parameter validation, covering the unknown-aspect teaching-error path (400 response with the valid-values list) and basic response shape; the full integration path is covered separately by architecture-map.test.ts.

nodes.name: graph-controller.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for GraphController with tracePathService and impactAnalysisService module-mocked out, covering tracePath's found/not-found/throw/identity-resolution branches, analyzeImpact's result shaping, defaults and throw behavior, and the getInstance singleton — all without a live database.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bun:test's mock.module to replace trace-path.js and impact-analysis.js wholesale before import, so the controller's own logic is isolated from the real traversal services.

nodes.name: impact-analysis-diff.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests defaultDiffRunner's committed-scope git diff behavior against a real throwaway git repository created via execFileSync, exercising the three-source diff logic that feeds ImpactAnalysisService.

nodes.name: impact-analysis.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests computeImpactedModules' path-prefix quotient rollup (grouping impacted files by 2-segment prefix, capped at 20 with an '(other)' overflow bucket) both as a pure function and end-to-end through ImpactAnalysisService.analyze.

nodes.name: read-file-containment.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for ReadFileTool's absolute-path containment rules: only paths under the project root, process.cwd(), or MASSA_AI_READ_FILE_ROOTS are allowed, with a teaching error listing valid roots (never host paths) when a path resolves outside them.

nodes.name: read-file.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for ReadFileTool.resolveFilePath's three branches (relative path without projectId, relative path resolved against the workspace project_path, and absolute path used verbatim), plus cache-key composition, LRU cap/promotion, and cache-hit metadata writeback.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-mocks event-bus.js and workspace-manager.js with in-file fakes before importing ReadFileTool, so the real EventBus and WorkspaceManager implementations are stubbed rather than exercised.

nodes.name: buildGv
nodes.summary: Test helper that builds an adjacency snapshot (out/in edge sets keyed by file index) from a list of files and edges, used to assert architecture-map graph shape in fixtures.

nodes.name: makeTempProject
nodes.summary: Test helper that materializes an in-memory file map as a real temporary directory tree on disk, used to feed the ETL pipeline for architecture-map integration tests.

nodes.name: mulberry32
nodes.summary: Seedable pseudo-random number generator used to make the property test's random graph generation deterministic and reproducible across runs.

nodes.name: bruteForceSccs
nodes.summary: O(V^3) brute-force reference implementation of strongly-connected-component detection via mutual reachability, used as the correctness oracle against which the Tarjan-based detectCycles is validated.

nodes.name: randomGraph
nodes.summary: Generates a random directed edge list of a given node count and density using the seeded PRNG, for property-test fuzzing of the cycle-detection algorithms.

nodes.name: teachingError
nodes.summary: Test helper that invokes a tool call expected to throw and asserts the thrown error carries a teaching message (e.g. a valid-values hint) rather than failing silently or opaquely.

nodes.name: imp
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing an ImpactedSymbol fixture object for a given file path, used to assert the impacted_modules quotient-rollup grouping logic.

nodes.name: search-definitions.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the SearchDefinitionsTool and GoToDefinitionTool success paths — kind-filtered listDefinitions results shaped into the definitions_total/shown/omitted response, and go-to-definition found/not-found/error handling — with symbolGraphService and active-generation mocked out.

nodes.name: symbol-graph-service.test.ts
nodes.summary: Full-method unit-test suite for SymbolGraphService (hasData, goToDefinition, lookupDefinition, getReferences, getEdges, getDependencies, listDefinitions, getTopCentralFiles, getProjectMap, getArchitecture, recomputeCentrality, snippet enrichment, and project-root caching), with the symbol-repository factory and workspace manager module-mocked so no live database is required.
nodes.languageNotes: Mocks module-level singletons (symbol-repository-factory, workspace-manager) before import so getSymbolRepository() resolves to a controllable stub — a bun:test module-mocking pattern that requires isolated-process execution.

nodes.name: trace-path-unit.test.ts
nodes.summary: Exhaustive unit-test suite for TracePathService internals — resolveSeeds, the outbound/inbound/both BFS core, syntheticTarget, extractCallerFqn, fqnToName, buildChains, deadline handling, MAX_NODES truncation, edge_types override, and the include_tests file gate — with symbol-graph.service and definition-lookup mocked out so no database is needed.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest test file in the batch (978 lines); mocks two service modules before import to inject a fully controllable BFS environment.

nodes.name: trace-path.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests that run the ETL pipeline on a tiny TypeScript fixture with a known 3-hop call chain to exercise trace_path's BFS traversal end-to-end: outbound/inbound/both direction, mode-to-edge-type filtering, depth cap, cycle guard, cross-service HTTP_CALL following, and the include_tests toggle.

nodes.name: wave-4-correctness.test.ts
nodes.summary: Wave-4 correctness suite covering defaultDiffRunner's three-source diff and secrets denylist across scope=unstaged/staged/all/committed, ReadFileTool's line-cap and source_clipped flag, and the N4 total/shown/omitted counting contract shared by ImpactAnalysisService, SearchDefinitionsTool, GetReferencesTool, and SearchController.
nodes.languageNotes: Spans six independent describe blocks across five different subsystems, unified by the shared N4 pagination-counting contract (_total/_shown/_omitted fields).

nodes.name: wave-4-enum-validation.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the ToolError + validateEnum teaching-error contract (invalid/empty/undefined/null enum values all throw with a valid-values list), validateGitRef's ref-safety checks, and the wiring of validateEnum into eight concrete tool handlers.

nodes.name: wave-4-generation-staleness.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests getActiveGeneration and assertGenerationNotStale — the opt-in If-None-Match-style staleness precondition — plus its wiring into the four graph-reader tools (impact_analysis, trace_path, get_references, search_definitions) that surface activatedGraphGenerationId and honor ifNoneMatch.

nodes.name: workspace-manager.test.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed unit tests for WorkspaceManager covering markIndexing/markIndexed/markError status transitions, listWorkspaces filtering, resolveByNameTail lookup (including ambiguous-match errors), removeWorkspace, the getInstance singleton, and EventBus-driven indexing-lifecycle integration.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses describe.skipIf(!DB_AVAILABLE) to gracefully skip the whole suite when no live PostgreSQL connection is configured.

nodes.name: graph-controller.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestration controller fronting the Symbol Graph traversal tools (currently trace_path and impact_analysis): validates input, delegates BFS/impact work to TracePathService and ImpactAnalysisService, and shapes results — including not-found hints and identity resolution — for tool/API consumers.
nodes.languageNotes: Singleton via private constructor + static getInstance(), matching the repo's controller pattern; keeps tool handlers thin by delegating all traversal logic to services.

nodes.name: filter-validation.ts
nodes.summary: Pure, I/O-free revalidation of client-supplied include/exclude glob filter patterns before filterByPatterns consumes them: enforces a pattern-count cap, validates glob syntax via minimatch, and downgrades (rather than silently dropping) patterns that contradict by appearing in both include and exclude.

nodes.name: active-generation.ts
nodes.summary: Two small helpers shared by the graph-reader tool handlers (impact_analysis, trace_path, get_references, search_definitions): getActiveGeneration looks up a workspace's current active_graph_generation_id, and assertGenerationNotStale enforces an opt-in If-None-Match-style 412 precondition when the client's cached generation is stale.

nodes.name: makeDef
nodes.summary: Test helper building a SymbolDefinition fixture with sensible defaults, overridable per test case, for SearchDefinitionsTool success-path assertions.

nodes.name: makeDef
nodes.summary: Test helper building a SymbolDefinition fixture for a given file/name with overridable fields, used across SymbolGraphService method-coverage tests.

nodes.name: makeRef
nodes.summary: Test helper building a SymbolReference fixture (caller file/line/symbol/kind/target) for graph-traversal assertions in the SymbolGraphService suite.

nodes.name: makeImport
nodes.summary: Test helper building a SymbolImport fixture describing a from/to file import edge, optionally marked external, for dependency-graph assertions.

nodes.name: mockLookupResult
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing a DefinitionLookupResult fixture (found/ambiguous/not-found status) for stubbing DefinitionLookupService responses.

nodes.name: makeSnapshot
nodes.summary: Test helper assembling a full ProjectMapGraphSnapshot fixture (definitions, references, imports, centrality) used across SymbolGraphService.getProjectMap assertions.

nodes.name: makeDef
nodes.summary: Test helper building a SymbolDefinition fixture with overridable fields for trace-path seed-resolution tests.

nodes.name: mockLookupResult
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing a DefinitionLookupResult fixture for stubbing TracePathService's seed-resolution outcomes.

nodes.name: edge
nodes.summary: Test helper building a graph edge fixture (caller/target/kind/meta) consumed by the mocked getEdges stub during BFS traversal tests.

nodes.name: makeTempProject
nodes.summary: Test helper that writes an in-memory file map to a real temporary directory tree, used to seed the ETL pipeline for trace_path integration fixtures.

nodes.name: makeDef
nodes.summary: Test helper building a minimal symbol-definition fixture (fqn/name/file) for N4 total/shown/omitted counting assertions.

nodes.name: freshControllerWithResults
nodes.summary: Test helper that creates a SearchController instance (via Object.create, bypassing the constructor) pre-seeded with a fixed results array and a stubbed ContextualSearchRLM, used to assert the N4 results_total/shown/omitted response shape without a live search backend.

nodes.name: teachingError
nodes.summary: Test helper that invokes a tool call expected to throw and asserts the error message teaches the caller the valid-values list rather than failing silently.

nodes.name: GraphController
nodes.summary: Singleton controller class exposing tracePath and analyzeImpact, each validating required inputs, timing the call, logging structured metrics, and reshaping the underlying TracePathService/ImpactAnalysisService result for tool/API callers.

nodes.name: validateFilters
nodes.summary: Validates and cleans client include/exclude filter patterns: enforces the maxFilterPatterns cap, checks glob syntax on every pattern, and reconciles same-pattern contradictions by dropping the exclude entry and recording a downgrade.

nodes.name: assertValidGlob
nodes.summary: Asserts a single glob pattern compiles via minimatch.makeRe, throwing a teaching ToolError naming the offending array and pattern when it doesn't.

nodes.name: getActiveGeneration
nodes.summary: Looks up the workspace's current active graph generation id via the symbol repository, returning null for never-indexed or vector-only workspaces.

nodes.name: assertGenerationNotStale
nodes.summary: Opt-in precondition check that throws a 412 ToolError when the client's cached generation id doesn't match the workspace's current active generation, and is a no-op when ifNoneMatch is omitted or empty.

nodes.name: base-vector-store.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for BaseVectorStore's abstract utility methods -- cosine similarity, distance/similarity conversion, and lazy embedding-provider bootstrapping -- exercised through a TestableVectorStore subclass that exposes protected members and stubs the abstract CRUD methods.

nodes.name: embedding-cache-factory.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test verifying createEmbeddingCache always returns an EmbeddingCachePg instance with a provider/model-derived namespace.

nodes.name: embedding-cache-pg.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the PostgreSQL-backed embedding cache covering get/set, batch operations, hit-rate tracking, cleanup, and stats.

nodes.name: embedding-service.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the legacy EmbeddingService class, mocking createEmbeddingProvider to cover initialization success/fallback, embed/embedBatch degraded-mode behavior, and similarity calculation.
nodes.languageNotes: The module under test (embedding-service.ts) is loaded via a dynamic `await import()` performed after `mock.module()`, not a static import -- only the `EmbeddingProvider` type is statically imported from provider.ts.

nodes.name: embeddings-cached-provider.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for CachedEmbeddingProvider using an in-memory fake cache, covering embedQuery/embedBatch cache hit/miss paths, availability delegation, stats, and the withCache factory helper.

nodes.name: embeddings-config.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the embedding provider configuration module, covering environment-variable-driven rate limits, max character limits, and API-key detection.

nodes.name: embeddings-local-transformers.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the offline local-transformers embedding provider, mocking the dynamic @huggingface/transformers import to cover embedding shape validation, cache composition, and config/registration wiring.

nodes.name: embeddings-provider.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for AISDKEmbeddingProvider covering text sanitization/truncation, per-provider model selection, direct Ollama API calls, retry/timeout behavior, availability checks, and the createProvider factory.

nodes.name: metrics-collector.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the MetricsCollector singleton, isolating filesystem I/O per test via a temp working directory and covering embedding/compression/context-optimization recording, persistence, reset, and summary formatting.

nodes.name: rate-limiter.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for EmbeddingRateLimiter covering RPM/TPM/RPD sliding-window limiting and status reporting.

nodes.name: base-vector-store.ts
nodes.summary: Persistence-layer abstract base class defining the vector-store contract -- lazy embedding-provider bootstrapping, cosine-similarity math, and the CRUD/search method signatures -- shared by concrete backends such as PostgresVectorStore.
nodes.languageNotes: Abstract class with protected math/embedding helpers and an all-abstract CRUD/search surface concrete stores must implement.

nodes.name: embedding-cache-contract.ts
nodes.summary: Type-only contract defining the EmbeddingCacheStore interface (get/set/batch/stats/cleanup) implemented by the PostgreSQL embedding cache.

nodes.name: embedding-cache-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Single-function factory that selects the embedding-cache backend; currently always returns a PostgreSQL-backed EmbeddingCachePg instance.

nodes.name: embedding-cache-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed embedding cache keyed by SHA-256 content hash, storing embeddings as binary Float32 buffers via Prisma with batch get/set, hit-rate tracking, and TTL-based cleanup.
nodes.languageNotes: Serializes embedding vectors to/from a binary Float32 buffer for compact PostgreSQL storage rather than JSON arrays.

nodes.name: cached-provider.ts
nodes.summary: Decorator that wraps any EmbeddingProvider with a cache-first strategy, batching cache lookups and only calling the base provider for cache misses.
nodes.languageNotes: Decorator pattern over the EmbeddingProvider interface -- implements the same interface it wraps.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Central configuration for the multi-provider embedding system: per-provider env-driven rate limits and max-character limits, the embeddingProviders priority-ordered registry (Google, Vercel gateway, Ollama, and more), API-key detection, and retry/batch defaults.

nodes.name: embedding-service.ts
nodes.summary: Legacy EmbeddingService class providing auto-fallback embedding generation with degraded-mode random vectors when no provider is configured; relocated from the old ChromaDB vector-store module and still consumed by several production callers.
nodes.languageNotes: Forms a circular module relationship with index.ts: it imports createEmbeddingProvider from index.ts while index.ts re-exports this class.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel and factory module for the embeddings subsystem -- builds a priority-ordered, cache-wrapped EmbeddingProvider via createEmbeddingProvider/createAllProviders, checks provider availability, and re-exports config, cache, and provider types.
nodes.languageNotes: Re-exports EmbeddingService from embedding-service.ts (`export { EmbeddingService } from "./embedding-service.js"`), which in turn imports createEmbeddingProvider from this file -- a circular module dependency resolved by ESM export hoisting.

nodes.name: provider.ts
nodes.summary: Vercel-AI-SDK-backed AISDKEmbeddingProvider supporting OpenAI, Google, Cohere, Mistral, Ollama, and LiteLLM-gateway embedding models with exponential-backoff retry, timeouts, text sanitization, and an Ollama request queue; also hosts the createProvider factory that dispatches to the local-transformers provider when configured.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest file in the batch; centralizes provider-specific model-selection branching (Vercel AI Gateway, OpenAI-compatible/LiteLLM, Google, Cohere, Mistral, Ollama) behind one EmbeddingProvider interface.

nodes.name: local-transformers.ts
nodes.summary: Offline embedding provider running ONNX models locally via @huggingface/transformers (dynamically imported to keep it out of the hot path for other providers), used when no remote embedding provider is configured.
nodes.languageNotes: Loads the @huggingface/transformers runtime via dynamic import() inside ensureModel(), keeping the heavy dependency out of the module graph for consumers that never use the local provider.

nodes.name: rate-limiter.ts
nodes.summary: Sliding-window rate limiter for embedding API calls, enforcing per-provider requests-per-minute, tokens-per-minute, and requests-per-day limits with automatic wait/backoff.

nodes.name: metrics.ts
nodes.summary: Singleton MetricsCollector persisting embedding, compression, and context-optimization metrics (calls, tokens, cost, cache hit rate, latency percentiles) to a JSON file on disk, with a human-readable summary report and per-provider cost pricing table.
nodes.languageNotes: Classic singleton (static instance + getInstance()) that persists state to disk rather than an in-memory-only counter, so metrics survive process restarts.

nodes.name: BaseVectorStore
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for vector-store backends providing lazy embedding-provider bootstrapping and shared cosine-similarity/distance-conversion math, leaving CRUD, search, and collection management as abstract methods for concrete backends.

nodes.name: createEmbeddingCache
nodes.summary: Factory function selecting the embedding-cache backend from the application's canonical database setting; always constructs an EmbeddingCachePg today.

nodes.name: EmbeddingCachePg
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL implementation of the EmbeddingCacheStore contract: hashes content with SHA-256, stores embeddings as binary Float32 buffers via Prisma, and tracks in-process hit/miss counters alongside batch get/set, cleanup, and stats operations.

nodes.name: CachedEmbeddingProvider
nodes.summary: EmbeddingProvider decorator that checks the cache before delegating to a wrapped base provider, batches cache misses into a single embedBatch call, and writes new results back to the cache.

nodes.name: withCache
nodes.summary: Convenience helper that wraps a base EmbeddingProvider and an EmbeddingCacheStore into a CachedEmbeddingProvider.

nodes.name: getRateLimits
nodes.summary: Resolves RPM/TPM/RPD and batch-size/delay rate limits for a provider from provider-specific environment variables, falling back to generic EMBEDDING_* vars.

nodes.name: getMaxChars
nodes.summary: Determines the maximum characters to send per embedding request based on provider and model-specific context-window heuristics, overridable via environment variable.

nodes.name: getProvidersByPriority
nodes.summary: Returns the configured embedding providers sorted by ascending priority (lower number tried first).

nodes.name: hasApiKey
nodes.summary: Checks whether a named embedding provider has the credentials it needs to run (API key for remote providers, or unconditionally true for local/no-key providers like Ollama and transformers).

nodes.name: EmbeddingService
nodes.summary: Auto-fallback embedding service that lazily initializes a provider via createEmbeddingProvider, degrading to random vectors outside production when no provider is available, and exposing embed/embedBatch/getSimilarity.

nodes.name: tryCreateProvider
nodes.summary: Attempts to construct and health-check a single embedding provider by id, returning null if the API key is missing or the provider fails its availability check.

nodes.name: createEmbeddingProvider
nodes.summary: Builds the primary cache-wrapped EmbeddingProvider by trying configured providers in priority order (or a specific provider when requested), falling back through the list until one is available.

nodes.name: createAllProviders
nodes.summary: Instantiates and returns every available embedding provider (not just the first successful one), each wrapped with caching, for callers that need multi-provider access.

nodes.name: checkProviderAvailability
nodes.summary: Health-checks every configured embedding provider and returns an availability/reason map, used for diagnostics without constructing long-lived provider instances.

nodes.name: withRetry
nodes.summary: Generic exponential-backoff retry wrapper that retries a failing async operation up to a configured maximum, logging each attempt.

nodes.name: withTimeout
nodes.summary: Races an async operation against a timeout, rejecting with a labeled error if the operation does not settle in time.

nodes.name: createProvider
nodes.summary: Factory dispatching to LocalTransformersEmbeddingProvider for the 'transformers' provider type, or AISDKEmbeddingProvider for every other configured provider.

nodes.name: AISDKEmbeddingProvider
nodes.summary: Vercel-AI-SDK-backed EmbeddingProvider implementation covering OpenAI, Google, Cohere, Mistral, Ollama, and the Vercel AI Gateway/LiteLLM path, with text sanitization/truncation, a serialized Ollama request queue, retry/timeout wrapping, and rate-limit-aware batching.

nodes.name: LocalTransformersEmbeddingProvider
nodes.summary: EmbeddingProvider implementation that loads and runs an ONNX feature-extraction model locally via @huggingface/transformers (dynamically imported), for fully offline embedding generation.

nodes.name: EmbeddingRateLimiter
nodes.summary: Sliding-window rate limiter tracking per-minute and per-day request windows for a single embedding provider, exposing waitForCapacity to block until capacity is available and getStatus for current usage.

nodes.name: MetricsCollector
nodes.summary: Singleton metrics store that records embedding calls, compression runs, and context-optimization events with cost estimates from a per-provider pricing table, persists to a JSON file under data/metrics.json, and formats a human-readable summary report.

nodes.name: TestableVectorStore
nodes.summary: Test-only concrete subclass of BaseVectorStore that exposes its protected similarity/embedding helpers as public methods and stubs every abstract CRUD/search method so the base class's shared logic can be unit tested in isolation.

nodes.name: makeProvider
nodes.summary: Test fixture builder that returns a minimal fake EmbeddingProvider implementation, overridable per test.

nodes.name: makeBaseProvider
nodes.summary: Test fixture builder that returns a minimal fake base EmbeddingProvider for exercising CachedEmbeddingProvider in isolation.

nodes.name: makeMemoryCache
nodes.summary: Test fixture builder returning an in-memory EmbeddingCacheStore implementation used as a fast, dependency-free cache double in CachedEmbeddingProvider tests.

nodes.name: mockTransformers
nodes.summary: Test harness that mocks the dynamic @huggingface/transformers import, returning deterministic fake embedding vectors so the local-transformers provider can be tested without loading a real ONNX model.

nodes.name: makeConfig
nodes.summary: Test fixture builder returning a default EmbeddingProviderConfig for the Ollama provider, overridable per test.

nodes.name: freshInstance
nodes.summary: Test helper that isolates MetricsCollector's file-backed state per test by chdir-ing into a fresh temp directory and resetting the module's cached singleton instance.

nodes.name: 00.harness.smoke.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E smoke test (T1) that proves the E2E harness itself works: verifies the live HTTP API is reachable, the MCP subprocess boots and advertises all 52 tools in the exact declared order, and the HTTP/MCP matrix-equivalence assertion holds for a read-only tool call.
nodes.languageNotes: Hardcodes the 52 expected tool names in declaration order and asserts a strict === count so a missing or misordered tool fails loudly instead of being masked by a >= comparison.

nodes.name: 02.indexing.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test validating the polyglot indexing contract: asserts the 33-file polyglot fixture covers every DEFAULT_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS entry with a deterministic per-language sentinel, and exercises live indexing against the running stack including StructuralRuntime directly.

nodes.name: 05.memory.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test suite (T5) covering remember/recall/memory_update/memory_delete/memory_list against the live Tools API, Ollama embeddings, and MCP subprocess, seeding a canonical memory batch once and reusing it to amortize embedding latency.

nodes.name: postLong
nodes.summary: Issues a fetch POST with an AbortController-based timeout and JSON body/response handling, used as the base HTTP helper for every memory-tool call in this suite.
nodes.languageNotes: This timeout-bounded POST helper is re-implemented locally (not shared via _helpers.ts) in at least five E2E files — 05, 08, 14, 15, 19 — each with slightly different timeout defaults, rather than being centralized once.

nodes.name: assertRecallScores
nodes.summary: Asserts every memory in a recall/search payload carries a finite score within [0,1], labeling failures with the originating call for easier debugging.

nodes.name: seedAll
nodes.summary: Seeds the canonical set of test memories once per suite run, checking existing content via memList to avoid re-storing duplicates before subsequent tests reuse them.

nodes.name: 06.checkpoints.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test suite (T6, F68-F73) exercising create/list/restore checkpoint tools against the live stack, normalizing volatile fields (ids, timestamps) before comparing HTTP and MCP transport responses.

nodes.name: 08.search.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test suite (T3) covering search, optimized_context, compress, read_file, and symbol_snippet against the shared live index, comparing HTTP and MCP transport output and documenting known product limitations such as missing structured score breakdowns.

nodes.name: postLong
nodes.summary: Issues a timeout-bounded fetch POST used as the shared HTTP helper underlying search, optimized_context, compress, and read_file calls in this suite.

nodes.name: 09.symbol-graph.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test suite (T4) covering the symbol graph surface -- list_projects, project_map, search_definitions, get_references, go_to_definition -- against a freshly indexed 33-file polyglot fixture, validating FQN structure via parseStructuralFqn and deterministic active-generation contracts.

nodes.name: 10.synapse.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test suite (T7) covering the Synapse session lifecycle and working-memory buffer (F74-F80) against the live Tools API and MCP subprocess, regression-testing several previously-fixed MCP proxy bugs around path-param substitution and input schemas.

nodes.name: httpJson
nodes.summary: Generic timeout-bounded fetch helper supporting arbitrary HTTP methods, parsing the response as JSON via a text-then-parse step so a malformed body produces a readable error.

nodes.name: 11.lifecycle.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test suite (T8, F84-F97) covering bootstrap, hooks, handoff, and proposals against the live stack, using a per-file scoped projectId for most scenarios while reusing the shared index for bootstrap.

nodes.name: searchMemories
nodes.summary: Calls the shared httpPost helper to search memories for a project and query, used by lifecycle scenarios that assert on memory side-effects.

nodes.name: 13.cli.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E smoke test (T12) that runs the built massa-ai and massa-ai-config CLI binaries as subprocesses, isolating mutating commands through a throwaway XDG_CONFIG_HOME so they never touch the real user config.

nodes.name: runBin
nodes.summary: Spawns a built CLI binary as a child process, captures stdout/stderr, and resolves with the combined output and exit code once the process exits.

nodes.name: 14.needles.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E needle-in-haystack search-quality benchmark (T10) that runs the dogfood corpus from benchmarks/needles/fixtures against the shared live index sequentially (to respect the Ollama embedding mutex), asserting hit@k/MRR floors and re-run determinism.

nodes.name: postLong
nodes.summary: Timeout-bounded fetch POST helper used to issue each needle's search request against the shared live index.

nodes.name: findRank
nodes.summary: Finds the 1-based rank of a needle's expected file/line-range within a list of search hits, using a line-range intersection with tolerance.

nodes.name: runSweep
nodes.summary: Runs every needle in the dogfood corpus sequentially against a project, computes hit@1/3/5/10 and MRR, and returns an aggregate scorecard plus per-needle detail.

nodes.name: printTable
nodes.summary: Pretty-prints a needle sweep's per-needle ranks and aggregate hit@k/MRR scorecard to the console for human-readable benchmark output.

nodes.name: 15.nfr.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E non-functional test suite (T9) covering concurrency, PostgreSQL data integrity, and auth against a capped-parallelism tiny fixture, deliberately avoiding indexing the full repository to prevent OOM.

nodes.name: postLong
nodes.summary: Timeout-bounded fetch POST helper that parses the response via text-then-JSON.parse, used by the concurrency and integrity scenarios in this file.

nodes.name: getLong
nodes.summary: Timeout-bounded fetch GET helper mirroring postLong's text-then-JSON.parse handling, used for job-status and search polling in this file.

nodes.name: pollSearchable
nodes.summary: Polls a project's search endpoint via the shared pollUntil helper until a query returns at least one hit, used to detect index warmness after a concurrent indexing scenario.

nodes.name: indexTinyAndWait
nodes.summary: Triggers indexing of the tiny polyglot fixture into a throwaway projectId and polls until the job reports a terminal state, guarding the projectId with assertE2ePrefix first.

nodes.name: 16.destructive.test.ts
nodes.summary: Dedicated-stack destructive E2E suite (T13) covering global-state mutations (stopping Ollama, forcing PostgreSQL/Ollama outages, throughput timing) that would disrupt the shared live stack; every scenario skips by default and only runs with RUN_E2E_DESTRUCTIVE=1 against an isolated target.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents, scenario by scenario, WHY each test is destructive to shared infra (global singleton, shared PG, shared cache) as a file-level contract comment -- a deliberate substitute for actually running them against production-like shared state.

nodes.name: 17.cleanup-verify.test.ts
nodes.summary: Final E2E gate (T14) that asserts no e2e-ai-* test pollution leaked onto the live shared stack after the full suite runs, checking the workspace list contains only the intentionally-persistent shared index.
nodes.languageNotes: The isolation test runner (scripts/run-tests-isolated.ts) forces this file to execute last regardless of its filename-number position among 18-24.

nodes.name: 18.graph-phase4.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test suite (T11b) covering the Phase-4 typed-edge and architecture surface -- typed edges, trace_path BFS, impact_analysis, and architecture-map -- against the shared live index, cross-checking MCP and HTTP transport parity.

nodes.name: 19.web-exec.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test suite (T11c) covering web fetch_and_index with its SSRF guard, plus the polyglot code executor (execute/execute_file/batch_execute), asserting private-IP requests are rejected by construction and executor snippets stay side-effect-free.

nodes.name: postLong
nodes.summary: Timeout-bounded fetch POST helper shared by the web fetch_and_index and polyglot-executor scenarios in this file.

nodes.name: 20.new-features.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test suite (T11c) covering post-baseline features without prior coverage -- compaction snapshots, Synapse PostgreSQL persistence, the OpenCode hook_ingest observation bridge, and lexical-RRF search quality -- and documenting black-box coverage gaps such as the offline-embeddings provider switch.

nodes.name: 22.path-identity.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test (T15) verifying dedicated shared-index identity and path hygiene: indexing the polyglot fixture from a different filesystem path must not corrupt the canonical shared index's identity.

nodes.name: 23.owned-destructive.test.ts
nodes.summary: Self-contained destructive-recovery E2E harness that spawns its OWN dedicated PostgreSQL, Ollama, and Tools API child processes on isolated ports (3334/5433/11435), then verifies recovery behavior when each dependency is killed or restarted -- all gated behind RUN_OWNED_DESTRUCTIVE=1 and never touching the shared live stack.
nodes.languageNotes: Reimplements a miniature version of _helpers.ts/_mcp.ts's process-management primitives (spawn, health-poll, listener-pid tracking) scoped to an isolated port range, trading shared-helper reuse for total isolation from the live stack the other 20 E2E files depend on.

nodes.name: spawnOwned
nodes.summary: Spawns a child process for one owned-stack service (api/postgres/ollama), waits for its listener to bind the target port, and registers it in the ownedChildren map for later cleanup.

nodes.name: assertOwned
nodes.summary: Asserts a spawned owned service is the actual process listening on its port via lsof/ps cross-checks, and for Postgres additionally verifies its data directory and postmaster.pid agree with the spawned instance.

nodes.name: stopOwned
nodes.summary: Sends SIGTERM to an owned child process, waits for its listening port to free up, and deregisters it from ownedChildren.

nodes.name: cleanupOwned
nodes.summary: Best-effort teardown for one owned service: stops it if still tracked, then force-kills any leftover process still bound to its port.

nodes.name: writeConfig
nodes.summary: Writes a throwaway massa-ai config.json, with hooks enabled or disabled, into the isolated XDG config root used by the owned stack.

nodes.name: serviceEnv
nodes.summary: Builds the environment variable set (ports, DATABASE_URL, XDG paths) shared by every owned child process so they never collide with the real shared stack.

nodes.name: startPostgres
nodes.summary: Initializes (on first run) and spawns an owned, disposable PostgreSQL instance bound to a dedicated port and data directory.

nodes.name: startOllama
nodes.summary: Spawns an owned Ollama instance bound to a dedicated port and waits for its /api/tags endpoint to respond.

nodes.name: startApi
nodes.summary: Spawns an owned Tools API instance pointed at the owned PostgreSQL/Ollama pair and waits for its /health endpoint to report ready.

nodes.name: json
nodes.summary: Timeout-bounded fetch helper against the fixed-port owned API instance that returns the parsed JSON body alongside the HTTP status.

nodes.name: indexProject
nodes.summary: Triggers indexing on the owned API for a given project path/id and polls until the job completes, returning the final status.

nodes.name: createFixture
nodes.summary: Writes a small throwaway multi-file fixture project under a UUID-named temp directory for use by an owned-stack scenario.

nodes.name: hook
nodes.summary: Posts a single and a batch hook_ingest call against the owned API and asserts both return their expected status codes.

nodes.name: 24.dashboard-architecture.test.ts
nodes.summary: E2E test suite (T24) covering three disjoint surfaces added since the last coverage update: dashboard routes (/scheduler/status, /hooks/queue-status), get_architecture, and dry-run-only previews of rename_project/merge_projects.

nodes.name: _helpers.ts
nodes.summary: Central shared helper module for the entire E2E suite: live-stack availability probing, HTTP GET/POST/raw clients with e2e-prefix safety guards, shared-index lifecycle management (index-once, warm-check, reset), and the HTTP/MCP matrix-equivalence assertion used across nearly every E2E test file.
nodes.languageNotes: Central hub imported by 19 of the other 21 files in this suite; the shared index (SHARED_PID) is indexed exactly once via ensureSharedIndex/doSharedIndex and memoized so every search/graph/architecture test reuses it instead of re-paying embedding latency.

nodes.name: resolveE2EProjectPath
nodes.summary: Resolves the filesystem path to index for self-referential E2E scenarios, preferring an explicit MASSA_AI_E2E_PROJECT_PATH override when running against a dedicated environment.

nodes.name: matchesDedicatedDatabaseUrl
nodes.summary: Checks whether a DATABASE_URL points at a non-default port or host, used to detect an intentionally dedicated (non-shared) PostgreSQL target.

nodes.name: isOwnedDedicatedE2eEnvironment
nodes.summary: Determines whether the current process is running against an owned, dedicated E2E stack rather than the default shared one, combining explicit path and database-url signals.

nodes.name: assertSafeE2eEnvironment
nodes.summary: Guards every mutating HTTP call by throwing if the environment looks unsafe for E2E -- an ambiguous mix of dedicated-environment signals that could target the wrong stack.

nodes.name: deriveSharedProfileIdentity
nodes.summary: Derives a short deterministic hash identifying the shared index's embedding profile (commit, provider, model, dimensions) so tests can detect when the shared index needs re-indexing.

nodes.name: resolveSharedProfileIdentity
nodes.summary: Resolves the current embedding provider and repo commit hash, then derives the shared profile identity used to key the persistent shared index.

nodes.name: resolveBackendAttestation
nodes.summary: Normalizes the live server's reported storage backend and dedicated-environment flag into a single Backend classification (postgres/unknown).

nodes.name: assertE2ePrefix
nodes.summary: Fails fast if a projectId does not carry the e2e-ai- prefix, preventing any mutating test call from accidentally targeting a non-test project.

nodes.name: probeAvailability
nodes.summary: Probes the full live-stack precondition set once per process -- MCP binary built, config file present, API /health, Ollama availability, backend type -- and caches the result for every subsequent gating check.

nodes.name: httpGet
nodes.summary: Performs a safety-guarded GET request against the live Tools API with query-string serialization and a default timeout.

nodes.name: httpPost
nodes.summary: Performs a safety-guarded JSON POST request against the live Tools API with a default timeout.

nodes.name: httpRaw
nodes.summary: Performs a safety-guarded fetch against the live Tools API returning the raw Response, for tests that need to inspect status codes or headers directly.

nodes.name: pollUntil
nodes.summary: Generic poll-until-truthy helper that retries an async predicate on an interval until it succeeds or a timeout elapses, used to wait for async indexing/job state across the suite.

nodes.name: indexAndAwait
nodes.summary: Triggers indexing for a project and polls the job-status endpoint until it reaches a terminal state, returning the final status payload.

nodes.name: getJobStatus
nodes.summary: Fetches the status of a single background indexing job by id.

nodes.name: decideSharedWorkspaceIdentity
nodes.summary: Decides whether an existing shared workspace entry's path matches the current fixture, distinguishing a stale entry from a genuine identity conflict.

nodes.name: prepareSharedWorkspaceIdentity
nodes.summary: Reconciles the shared project's workspace list against the current polyglot fixture path, resetting the shared project if a stale or conflicting entry is found before indexing.

nodes.name: isSearchable
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given query currently returns at least one search hit for a project, used to detect index warmness.

nodes.name: isSharedIndexWarm
nodes.summary: Checks a fixed set of probe queries against the shared index and reports true only if every one is already searchable.

nodes.name: ensureSharedIndex
nodes.summary: Lazily triggers the one-time shared-index build the first time any test file needs it, memoizing the in-flight promise so concurrent callers share a single indexing run.

nodes.name: doSharedIndex
nodes.summary: Performs the actual one-time shared-index build: reconciles workspace identity, skips reindexing if the shared index is already warm, otherwise triggers indexing and polls until every probe query is searchable.

nodes.name: resetProject
nodes.summary: Resets (deletes) an e2e-prefixed project via the reset_project API, used to clean up per-test projectIds in afterAll hooks.

nodes.name: normalize
nodes.summary: Recursively strips volatile keys (ids, timestamps, generated stats) from a response payload and rounds near-integer floats, producing a value stable enough for HTTP/MCP matrix comparison.

nodes.name: assertMatrix
nodes.summary: Asserts that normalized HTTP and MCP responses for the same logical call are deeply equal, throwing a labeled AssertionError with truncated payloads on mismatch.

nodes.name: _mcp.ts
nodes.summary: MCP transport driver for E2E tests: spawns the real built massa-ai MCP server as a subprocess and drives it through the official SDK Client over StdioClientTransport, giving tests a true black-box MCP connection identical to how OpenCode or Claude connect.

nodes.name: startMcp
nodes.summary: Spawns the built massa-ai MCP server binary as a subprocess wired to the live Tools API, connects an SDK Client over stdio, and returns a handle exposing the client, its advertised tool names, and a stop() teardown.

nodes.name: mcpCall
nodes.summary: Invokes a single MCP tool by name through the connected client and parses its text-content result back into a JSON value.

nodes.name: requireTool
nodes.summary: Throws if a required tool name is not present in the MCP server's advertised tool list, failing a test early with a clear message.

nodes.name: polyglot-fixture.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the 33-language polyglot fixture contract -- one deterministic sentinel symbol expected per allowed file extension -- and provides helpers to inspect the fixture directory and statically assert its extension coverage matches DEFAULT_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS exactly.

nodes.name: inspectPolyglotFixture
nodes.summary: Reads the polyglot fixture directory and returns its file list and sorted unique extension set, frozen to prevent accidental mutation by tests.

nodes.name: assertPolyglotContractStatic
nodes.summary: Statically asserts the polyglot fixture's declared expectations exactly match DEFAULT_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS and that every sentinel maps to a real fixture file, catching drift between the fixture and the indexer's supported-extension list.

nodes.name: architecture.ts
nodes.summary: Derives architectural signal (packages, entry points, routes, hotspots, layers) from the file-import graph and symbol definitions; the pure computation engine behind the get_architecture tool and project-map enrichment. Also runs an opt-in Tarjan SCC pass over CALL edges to surface cyclic call chains.
nodes.languageNotes: Heuristics ported-and-rewritten from a prior codebase-memory-mcp project, adapted to massa-ai's symbol_imports/symbol_references model; every exported function is pure (no DB/IO).

nodes.name: centrality.ts
nodes.summary: Computes simplified PageRank centrality scores over the file-import graph to identify the most-depended-on files, feeding search ranking, ETL prioritization, and hotspot detection.

nodes.name: communities.ts
nodes.summary: Implements multi-level Louvain community detection with a connectivity-refinement pass over the file-import graph to surface de-facto modules/clusters, feeding architecture-map layer classification.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs Louvain modularity optimization plus an explicit connected-component refinement pass to approximate Leiden-quality output without the extra dependency; falls back to a cheaper label-propagation hybrid above 8000 nodes / 50000 edges.

nodes.name: cycle-detection.ts
nodes.summary: Iterative (non-recursive) Tarjan strongly-connected-components finder over directed CALL edges, used by the architecture map's opt-in `cycles` aspect to surface file-level call cycles without risking a JS stack overflow.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an explicit heap-allocated work stack instead of recursion specifically to avoid stack overflow on deep CALL graphs.

nodes.name: definition-lookup.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves a symbol name or FQN query to its definition (or reports ambiguous/missing/bare status), providing the single shared identity-lookup contract used by go_to_definition, get_references, and trace_path.

nodes.name: git-ref-validation.ts
nodes.summary: Validates git ref parameters (base_branch, since) against an arg-injection pattern before they reach execFileSync('git', ...), rejecting values that look like option flags or shell metacharacters.
nodes.languageNotes: Defends the git CLI's own flag-injection surface (e.g. `--upload-pack=evil`), a narrower concern than shell injection since execFileSync already avoids `sh -c`.

nodes.name: impact-analysis.ts
nodes.summary: Given a scoped git diff, reverse-traverses the import/reference graph to compute which symbols are impacted by a change and ranks them by a centrality+proximity risk score, bounded by depth/time/count budgets.
nodes.languageNotes: Reverse BFS is bounded by MAX_DEPTH, MAX_IMPACTED, MAX_DEF_QUERIES, and a wall-clock deadline so a pathological fan-out cannot exhaust memory or time; ships a behind-a-flag recursive-CTE alternative to the in-process BFS.

nodes.name: symbol-graph.service.ts
nodes.summary: Central high-level API for code navigation — go_to_definition, get_references, get_dependencies, list_definitions, typed edge queries, and architecture-map/project-map assembly — plus centrality recomputation after ETL. The primary consumer-facing facade over the symbol PostgreSQL repository.
nodes.languageNotes: Acts as the composition root tying together centrality.ts, communities.ts, architecture.ts, and definition-lookup.ts behind one facade class.

nodes.name: trace-path.ts
nodes.summary: Bounded, cycle-guarded BFS traversal over typed structural edges (calls/data-flow/http/emit/listen) from a seed symbol, producing agent-consumable nodes, edges, and readable call chains for the trace_path tool.
nodes.languageNotes: Depth bounded at 6 hops and node count at 2000, with a wall-clock deadline, so pathological fan-out graphs cannot hang the traversal.

nodes.name: workspace-manager.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for project registration and indexing status, persisting workspace rows to PostgreSQL and reacting to EventBus indexing lifecycle events to keep status current and trigger background centrality recomputation.

nodes.name: compress_context.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool that compresses arbitrary text/code content via CodeCompressor using a selectable strategy (code_structure, conversation_summary, semantic_dedup, hierarchical), reporting token savings.
nodes.languageNotes: Source comments are written in Portuguese, unlike the rest of the batch.

nodes.name: buildGraphView
nodes.summary: Builds an internal adjacency-list graph view (in/out degree, adjacency sets) from the flat file list and import edges, used as the shared substrate for every architecture-detection function.

nodes.name: detectPackages
nodes.summary: Groups files into package boundaries (packages/<pkg>/, apps/<pkg>/, or first path segment) and computes cross-package fan-in/fan-out for the architecture map's `packages` aspect.

nodes.name: detectEntryPoints
nodes.summary: Flags entry-point candidates by combining high in-degree/low out-degree signal with bootstrap-style filename patterns (index/main/server/app/cli/bootstrap/entry).

nodes.name: detectRoutes
nodes.summary: Surfaces the API surface by merging HTTP_CALL typed edges, route-kind symbol definitions, and METHOD+path name patterns into a deduplicated route list.

nodes.name: detectHotspots
nodes.summary: Ranks the most-depended-on files by combining PageRank centrality (when available) with in-degree and per-file symbol counts.

nodes.name: labelCommunities
nodes.summary: Converts raw Louvain community memberships into labeled clusters with a representative path-prefix label, a cohesion score, and top files by degree.

nodes.name: commonPrefixLabel
nodes.summary: Computes the longest common directory-boundary path prefix among a set of files, used to label communities.

nodes.name: classifyLayers
nodes.summary: Classifies labeled communities into de-facto architectural layers (entry/api/core/leaf/service) using fan-in/fan-out and route-membership signals.

nodes.name: computeArchitectureMap
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestrator that validates opt-in aspects, builds the graph view, and assembles packages/entryPoints/routes/hotspots/communities/layers (plus an opt-in Tarjan-SCC `cycles` aspect) into the full ArchitectureMap. Pure — no DB or I/O.

nodes.name: decorateCycle
nodes.summary: Decorates one strongly-connected component with a stable deterministic id and its intra-cycle CALL-edge count for reproducible snapshot fingerprinting.

nodes.name: computePageRank
nodes.summary: Computes simplified PageRank over the file-import graph via iterative power iteration with damping 0.85, normalizing scores to [0,1].

nodes.name: buildGraph
nodes.summary: Builds a symmetrized, weighted CSR adjacency structure from directed import edges, folding self-loops into weighted degree, as the input graph for Louvain local-moving.

nodes.name: localMove
nodes.summary: Louvain local-moving phase: greedily reassigns each node to the neighboring community that maximizes modularity gain until stable, re-queuing only neighbors of moved nodes.

nodes.name: refineConnectivity
nodes.summary: Closes Louvain's known internal-disconnection gap by splitting each community along its connected components, approximating Leiden's connectivity guarantee.

nodes.name: relabel
nodes.summary: Compacts community labels into a contiguous 0-based id range after splitting/merging.

nodes.name: aggregate
nodes.summary: Collapses the current communities into super-nodes to build the coarsened graph for the next Louvain level.

nodes.name: modularityOf
nodes.summary: Computes the modularity score of a given community partition, used as the Louvain optimization objective and final-result quality metric.

nodes.name: fallbackCommunities
nodes.summary: Cheaper connected-components + weighted label-propagation hybrid used instead of full Louvain when the graph exceeds the node/edge caps.

nodes.name: runLouvain
nodes.summary: Public entry point for community detection: runs multi-level Louvain with connectivity refinement (or the cheaper fallback above the size caps), back-projecting the final partition onto original node ids.

nodes.name: buildCommunities
nodes.summary: Converts a flat community-assignment array into the public Community[] shape grouping member node indices by community id.

nodes.name: detectCycles
nodes.summary: Iterative Tarjan SCC algorithm over directed CALL edges using an explicit work stack (not recursion) to avoid stack overflow on deep call graphs; returns SCCs of size >1 plus self-looping singletons, budget-truncated for very large inputs.

nodes.name: toSymbolIdentityResolution
nodes.summary: Projects an internal DefinitionLookupResult onto the stable public SymbolIdentityResolution shape shared by the HTTP and MCP transports.

nodes.name: DefinitionLookupService
nodes.summary: Resolves a bare name or FQN query against the symbol repository, distinguishing resolved/ambiguous/missing/bare outcomes for every graph consumer (go_to_definition, get_references, trace_path).

nodes.name: validateGitRef
nodes.summary: Rejects git ref parameter values that start with '--' or contain shell/git metacharacters, throwing a ToolError; empty string is allowed as a caller-handled default-to-main sentinel.

nodes.name: ImpactAnalysisService
nodes.summary: Singleton service that runs a scoped git diff, maps changed files to symbols, reverse-traverses the import/reference graph up to a bounded depth, and scores impacted symbols by centrality+proximity risk.

nodes.name: computeImpactedModules
nodes.summary: Groups the full (pre-clamp) impacted-symbol set by 2-segment path-prefix into a capped quotient rollup, folding overflow into an '(other)' bucket.

nodes.name: defaultDiffRunner
nodes.summary: Production git-diff runner: runs a scoped `git diff --name-only` (unstaged/staged/committed/all), includes untracked new files while excluding secret-like paths, and validates ref params before shelling out.

nodes.name: SymbolGraphService
nodes.summary: Singleton facade providing go_to_definition, get_references, typed edge queries, dependency BFS, definition listing, centrality recomputation, and architecture/project-map assembly — the central navigation API consumed by nearly every symbol-related tool.

nodes.name: TracePathService
nodes.summary: Singleton service performing bounded, cycle-guarded BFS over typed structural edges from a resolved seed symbol, reconstructing readable call chains for the trace_path tool.

nodes.name: WorkspaceManager
nodes.summary: Singleton managing project registration and indexing-status lifecycle (indexing/indexed/error) against the PostgreSQL workspaces table, subscribing to EventBus to auto-update status and trigger background centrality recomputation.

nodes.name: CompressContextTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler that delegates to CodeCompressor for one of four compression strategies and reports token-count savings before/after.

nodes.name: create_checkpoint.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool that creates a versioned task-progress checkpoint (manual or milestone) via CheckpointManager, capturing status, progress, decisions, and file changes for later resumption or rollback.

nodes.name: enum-validation.ts
nodes.summary: Shared finite-set validation helper (validateEnum) and the ToolError type used across nearly every tool handler to replace silent-fallback branches with teaching errors that list valid values.
nodes.languageNotes: Foundational cross-cutting module imported by most other files in this batch and across the tools/ directory.

nodes.name: get_analytics.ts

nodes.name: get_architecture.ts

nodes.name: get_references.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool that finds all usage sites of a symbol across the project, grouping results by file and supporting an optional stale-graph-generation precondition.

nodes.name: go_to_definition.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool that resolves where a symbol is declared, disambiguating by calling-file context, and returns location, doc comment, and code snippet.

nodes.name: impact_analysis.ts

nodes.name: list_projects.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool listing all indexed workspaces with status, file/symbol counts, and last-indexed time, sourced from WorkspaceManager.

nodes.name: read_file.ts

nodes.name: search_definitions.ts

nodes.name: trace_path.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool that traces paths through the typed structural-edge graph from a seed symbol (calls/data-flow/cross-service/all modes, outbound/inbound/both direction) — the recommended alternative to grep for callers/dependents.

nodes.name: CreateCheckpointTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler that assembles a TaskState from request params and delegates to CheckpointManager to persist a versioned checkpoint (manual or milestone).

nodes.name: ToolError

nodes.name: validateEnum
nodes.summary: Validates that a value is a member of a finite string-literal set, throwing a ToolError listing all valid values on mismatch instead of silently falling through a default branch.

nodes.name: GetAnalyticsTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler exposing five analytics views (summary/project/query/cache/recent) by delegating to the singleton search-analytics service.

nodes.name: GetArchitectureTool

nodes.name: GetReferencesTool

nodes.name: GoToDefinitionTool

nodes.name: ImpactAnalysisTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler that validates scope/generation-freshness and delegates to ImpactAnalysisService.analyze, serializing changed files and ranked impacted symbols.

nodes.name: ListProjectsTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler listing workspaces from WorkspaceManager, optionally filtered by status, with counts and timestamps shaped for client consumption.

nodes.name: SearchDefinitionsTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler that validates symbol-kind filters, checks graph-generation freshness, and delegates to SymbolGraphService.listDefinitions for filtered symbol browsing.

nodes.summary: MCP tool handler that validates direction/mode enums and generation freshness, then delegates to TracePathService.tracePath, serializing nodes/edges/chains.

nodes.summary: Orchestration layer for project search: runs the two-tier admission preflight, optional auto-reindex, glob include/exclude filtering, Symbol-Graph centrality boosting, and optional LLM-judge reranking before formatting results and generating usage recommendations.

nodes.languageNotes: Read-through mirror pattern: a hydrate-once Map cache backs all reads while writes go straight to Postgres via Prisma's $queryRaw/$executeRaw, keeping the mirror consistent without a full ORM model.

nodes.name: apply.ts
nodes.summary: Transactional apply engine for project identity rename/merge: locks source and target, recomputes the plan inside the transaction, rewrites direct and payload stores across every registered table, repairs the graph-generation active pointer on merge, and runs post-commit cache invalidation and event publishing that can never flip a committed operation to failure.

nodes.name: contracts.ts

Gated on IDENTITY_ACCEPTANCE_DATABASE_URL and skipped otherwise.

nodes.name: PgPoolTransactionRunner

nodes.name: ProjectIdentityApplyService

nodes.name: seedGraphSource
nodes.summary: Seeds graph-generation rows for the source project to exercise repairGraphForMerge's active-pointer repair.

nodes.name: seedGraphTarget
nodes.summary: Seeds graph-generation rows for the target project to exercise repairGraphForMerge's active-pointer repair on merge.

nodes.name: clearAll
nodes.summary: Truncates every registered table in the owned acceptance database between tests.

nodes.name: canon
nodes.summary: Canonicalizes a row/value for order-independent snapshot comparison in acceptance assertions.

nodes.name: applyRename
nodes.summary: Drives a full rename apply call against the real service for a given operation ID and target, used to set up multi-step acceptance scenarios.

nodes.name: FakeClient
nodes.summary: Fake ProjectIdentityQueryClient returning canned information_schema and workspace rows for storage-discovery and preview-planner scenarios.

nodes.name: plannerClient
nodes.summary: Fake client recording every query call and returning a canned preview response, used to verify createProjectIdentityService's default wiring.

nodes.name: discovery.ts
nodes.summary: Introspects PostgreSQL information_schema at runtime to discover every table carrying a project_id/workspace_id column (direct stores) or a policy-registered payload column (payload stores), and inspects payload contents for embedded identity references.

nodes.name: errors.ts
nodes.summary: Defines ProjectIdentityError, the single sanitized error type (with SQLSTATE-style codes and HTTP status mapping) shared by Core, REST, and MCP transports for every project rename/merge failure mode.

nodes.name: hash.ts
nodes.summary: Deterministic canonical-JSON serialization and SHA-256 hashing utilities for project identity plans and apply requests, with special tagged encodings for PostgreSQL driver values (Date, bytea, bigint) so hashes never collide across representations.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the full public surface of the project-identity service: contracts, hashing, discovery, planner, apply service, registry, guard installer, invalidator registry, production wiring, the top-level service factory, and the alias resolver.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure re-export barrel (export { X } from "./file.js"); the project-scanner's import extraction does not treat these re-exports as resolvable imports for this file, so its outgoing dependency edges are intentionally sparse here.

nodes.name: invalidator-registry.ts
nodes.summary: Process-local registry of in-memory cache invalidators invoked after a rename/merge commits; fans out invalidateProject calls across every registrant for both source and target IDs in parallel and isolates/sanitizes any invalidator failure so it can never flip a committed operation to failure.

nodes.name: pg-array-codec.ts
nodes.summary: Hand-written parser and serializer for PostgreSQL TEXT-column array literals (e.g. `{a,b}`), handling quoting, escaping, and NULL tokens so identity payloads round-trip correctly regardless of whether the driver returns a literal string or a native array.

nodes.name: planner.ts
nodes.summary: Computes the authoritative, order-independent project identity plan (store counts, conflicts, unknown storage, and a storage fingerprint) shared by preview and apply, and exposes ProjectIdentityPreviewPlanner as the read-only dry-run entry point.

nodes.name: production-wiring.ts
nodes.summary: Composition-root helpers that wire the project identity module to production runtime singletons: lazily-resolved search/symbol-graph cache invalidators (via dynamic import to avoid a cold-start dependency) and an EventBus-backed change publisher.
nodes.languageNotes: Resolves SearchController and SymbolGraphService via dynamic import() so importing the project-identity module never pulls in the search/controller graph for a process that never renames.

nodes.name: registry.ts
nodes.summary: Static catalog of every PostgreSQL table carrying a direct project/workspace identity column or a payload column with embedded identity references, plus lookup functions used by discovery and the guard installer to classify tables.

nodes.name: service.ts
nodes.summary: Production factory that composes the Core ProjectIdentityService over the shared pg pool: wraps a raw pg client with transaction methods, wires the default production invalidator registry and event publisher, and exposes preview/apply as the public entry point consumed by REST and MCP transports.

nodes.name: quoteDiscoveredIdentifier
nodes.summary: Quotes a discovered SQL identifier for safe interpolation, throwing a TypeError if the identifier does not match the safe-identifier pattern - the injection guard used everywhere apply.ts and planner.ts build dynamic SQL.

nodes.name: materialColumnsFor
nodes.summary: Computes the set of non-identity, non-heavy-type columns safe to load and fingerprint as row material, excluding bytea/vector columns so previews never ship embeddings or binary payloads.

nodes.name: discoverProjectIdentityStorage
nodes.summary: Queries information_schema for every table/column in the schema, classifies each project_id/workspace_id column against the static registry into direct or payload stores, and collects any unrecognized project/workspace-scoped table as unknown storage.

nodes.name: countIdentityReferences
nodes.summary: Recursively counts occurrences of a given project ID under identity-shaped keys (projectId/project_id/workspaceId/workspace_id) anywhere inside a nested JSON value.

nodes.name: inspectIdentityPayload
nodes.summary: Inspects a raw payload column value (JSON, JSON-as-text, or text-array) for identity references to a given project ID, returning a match count, a malformed flag, and its canonical JSON form for fingerprinting.

nodes.name: fingerprintProjectIdentityRows
nodes.summary: Produces a stable SHA-256 fingerprint over a set of rows by canonicalizing and sorting each row's JSON form, used to detect storage drift between preview and apply.

nodes.name: ProjectIdentityError
nodes.summary: Sanitized public error class for the project identity module: maps each error code to a fixed message and HTTP status, shared verbatim by Core, REST, and MCP so no transport leaks raw SQL or row data.

nodes.name: hashProjectIdentityRequest
nodes.summary: Computes a stable SHA-256 digest over an apply request's identity material (mode, source, target, operationId) used to detect operationId reuse with different request material.

nodes.name: canonicalize
nodes.summary: Recursively converts an arbitrary value into a canonical JSON-safe form: sorts object keys, rejects NaN/undefined/cycles, and tags Date/Buffer/Uint8Array/bigint values so they never collide with plain strings holding the same characters.

nodes.name: canonicalProjectIdentityJson
nodes.summary: Serializes a value to its canonical JSON string via canonicalize, the shared building block for every hash and fingerprint in the project identity module.

nodes.name: hashProjectIdentityPlan
nodes.summary: Computes the deterministic, version-bound SHA-256 plan hash over a normalized (sorted) ProjectIdentityPlanMaterial, so the same storage snapshot always yields the same hash regardless of query row order.

nodes.name: ProjectIdentityInvalidatorRegistry
nodes.summary: Registry of process-local cache invalidators; invalidateBoth fans out invalidateProject across every registrant for both source and target project IDs in parallel via Promise.allSettled, isolating and sanitizing any registrant failure so a cache problem can never flip a committed rename/merge to failure.

nodes.name: parsePgArrayLiteral
nodes.summary: Parses a PostgreSQL TEXT-array literal string (or passes through a native JS string array) into a string array, handling quoting, backslash escapes, and case-insensitive NULL tokens; returns undefined only for genuinely malformed input.

nodes.name: toPgArrayLiteral
nodes.summary: Serializes a string array to a PostgreSQL array literal, quoting and escaping elements that contain separators, quotes, braces, whitespace, or the NULL token so the literal round-trips through the parser unchanged.

nodes.name: selectColumnsFor
nodes.summary: Builds the deduplicated, quoted SELECT column list (identity column + primary key + material columns) for a discovered direct store.

nodes.name: loadDirectRows
nodes.summary: Loads every row from a direct store matching either the source or target project ID, projected to just the columns the plan needs.

nodes.name: computeIdentityPlan
nodes.summary: Computes the authoritative identity plan for a rename/merge request: validates source/target existence and retirement state, enforces root-match for merges, tallies per-store direct and adapted counts, detects key-collision and malformed-payload conflicts, and hashes the whole plan plus a storage fingerprint. Shared by preview and by apply inside its transaction.

nodes.name: ProjectIdentityPreviewPlanner
nodes.summary: Read-only dry-run entry point: parses a preview request, computes the identity plan, and wraps it as a ProjectIdentityPreview, translating any unexpected failure into PROJECT_IDENTITY_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE.

nodes.name: resolveServingTargets
nodes.summary: Default production target resolver: dynamically imports the SearchController and SymbolGraphService singletons on first invalidation so importing the project-identity module never pulls in the search/controller graph for a process that never renames.

nodes.name: createProductionProjectIdentityInvalidatorRegistry
nodes.summary: Composes the production invalidator registry with five registrants - query-understanding cache, file-filter cache, index-manager metadata, symbol-graph project-root cache, and the alias resolver's own cache - each resolved lazily and isolated from failure.

nodes.name: createEventBusProjectIdentityChangedPublisher
nodes.summary: Builds a ProjectIdentityChangedPublisher backed by the shared TypedEventBus singleton, publishing project-identity:changed strictly after commit.

nodes.name: directStorePolicy
nodes.summary: Looks up the direct-store policy for a table/column pair, with a regex fast-path for the sharded vector_documents tables plus the static STATIC_DIRECT_STORES catalog.

nodes.name: payloadStorePolicies
nodes.summary: Returns the payload-store policies registered for a table, including the dynamic vector_documents metadata policy for sharded vector tables.

nodes.name: isKnownRegistryTable
nodes.summary: Reports whether a table name is recognized by the identity registry (direct store, payload store, sharded vector table, or the alias table), used to flag unclassified project-scoped storage.

nodes.name: wrapPgClient
nodes.summary: Adapts a raw pg PoolClient to the ProjectIdentityTransactionClient contract by issuing real BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK statements over the same client.

nodes.name: createProjectIdentityService
nodes.summary: Production factory for the Core ProjectIdentityService: defaults client acquisition to the shared pg pool, wires the production invalidator registry and EventBus publisher, and returns preview (short-lived read-only client) plus apply (delegated to the transactional apply service).

nodes.name: proposal-contract.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the ProposalStore contract (insert/getById/listPending/setStatus/journalMode) and status/kind enums shared by memory-change proposals, plus an in-memory MemoryProposalStore reference implementation used in tests and fallback paths.

nodes.name: MemoryProposalStore
nodes.summary: In-memory implementation of ProposalStore used for tests and non-persistent fallback paths; deep-clones records on every read/write to prevent aliasing.

nodes.name: proposal-repository-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed ProposalStore implementation with a hydrate-once in-memory mirror, strict payload validation on read (parsePayload/toRecord), and fail-loud error translation via searchBackendUnavailable/storeCorruption on corrupt rows.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Prisma's tagged-template $queryRaw/$executeRaw for typed raw SQL, with a defensive validation layer (isRecord/stringArray/validKeys) that treats any malformed row as store corruption rather than silently coercing it.

nodes.name: parsePayload
nodes.summary: Validates and narrows a raw JSON payload column into a typed CreateMemoryPayload/UpdateMemoryPayload/TagMemoryPayload based on proposal kind, throwing storeCorruption on any structural mismatch.

nodes.name: toRecord
nodes.summary: Converts a raw Postgres proposal row into a validated ProposalRecord, checking enum membership and timestamp shape and raising storeCorruption for any invalid field.

nodes.name: PgProposalStore
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed ProposalStore that lazily hydrates a full in-memory mirror on first use, serves reads from the mirror, and writes through to Postgres, resolving the caller's alias identity on insert.

nodes.name: session-file-cache.ts
nodes.summary: Singleton in-memory cache that tracks which file chunks were already delivered to an LLM within a session, enabling diff-only or reference-token delivery instead of resending unchanged content; evicts by LRU after a session cap or TTL.

nodes.name: computeDiff
nodes.summary: Produces a compact unified-style line diff between two versions of a file chunk's content, used to deliver only the changed lines instead of the full new content.

nodes.name: SessionFileCache
nodes.summary: Singleton per-session chunk-delivery tracker: classifies each check() as new/unchanged/changed against the session's last-seen hash, records token savings via TokenMetrics, and evicts idle or over-cap sessions.

nodes.name: run-pool.ts
nodes.summary: Standalone, dependency-free worker pool primitive that runs an array of jobs with bounded (optionally CPU-capped) concurrency, preserving input order and allSettled-shaped results so one job's failure never strands its siblings.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately imports only node:os to remain a clean, reusable primitive decoupled from any massa-ai service.

nodes.name: runPool
nodes.summary: Runs jobs with bounded, optionally CPU-capped concurrency using a shared-counter worker pool, writing each result into its fixed input index so output order matches input order regardless of completion order.

nodes.name: fulfilledValues
nodes.summary: Extracts just the fulfilled values from a RunPoolResult's settled array, discarding rejected entries.

nodes.name: local-health-checker.ts
nodes.summary: Aggregates health checks for Ollama, the local data directory, and PostgreSQL into a single readiness report, surfacing current search diagnostics and generating actionable remediation recommendations.

nodes.name: LocalHealthChecker
