nodes.summary: Runs Ollama, data-directory write, and PostgreSQL checks in parallel, timing each and reporting model availability/embedding readiness plus generated remediation recommendations.

nodes.name: redundancy-filter.ts
nodes.summary: Singleton service that finds near-duplicate memories via embedding similarity (cosine distance grouping) and merges them transactionally, transferring graph edges and boosted access counts while recording token savings.

nodes.name: RedundancyFilter
nodes.summary: Singleton that queries memory embeddings, buckets them by a coarse similarity key, and pairwise-compares within buckets to find near-duplicates above a cosine-similarity threshold, then merges them in a single transaction.

nodes.name: token-metrics.ts
nodes.summary: Singleton metrics collector that tracks token savings from session caching, redundancy filtering, and compression, estimates USD cost savings via a fetched/cached model-pricing table, and exposes rolling history plus a human-readable summary.

nodes.name: TokenMetrics
nodes.summary: Singleton that accumulates token-savings counters across session cache, redundancy filter, and compression sources, fetches and caches model pricing to estimate USD cost savings, and maintains a bounded rolling request history.

nodes.name: search-diagnostics.ts
nodes.summary: Central fail-loud diagnostics hub for the search subsystem: defines SearchServiceError plus structured degradation/failure recorders used to surface which optional search enrichments (trigram, fuzzy, proximity, graph, synapse, audit) silently degraded versus which backends hard-failed.

nodes.name: SearchServiceError
nodes.summary: Typed error class for search backend failures, carrying a component name and HTTP-style status code so callers can distinguish transient backend outages from data corruption.

nodes.name: searchBackendUnavailable
nodes.summary: Factory that builds a SearchServiceError for a backend-unavailable condition (e.g. Postgres/pgvector unreachable) with a consistent message and status code.

nodes.name: storeCorruption
nodes.summary: Factory that builds a SearchServiceError for a store-corruption condition (e.g. a row that fails schema validation), signalling a data-integrity fault rather than an outage.

nodes.name: recordSearchDegradation
nodes.summary: Appends a timestamped degradation diagnostic (e.g. trigram/fuzzy/synapse enrichment unavailable) to the bounded in-memory diagnostics ring buffer for later inspection via health/analytics endpoints.

nodes.name: recordSearchFailure
nodes.summary: Records a hard search failure diagnostic exactly once per SearchServiceError instance (deduped via a WeakSet) into the bounded diagnostics buffer.

nodes.name: getSearchDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Returns a defensive copy of the current diagnostics buffer (degradations and failures) for callers such as the local health checker.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting WorkingMemoryBuffer and its config/result types from the sibling working-memory-buffer implementation, forming the public entry point for Synapse's working-memory buffer.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting SessionRegistry and its getSessionRegistry/resetSessionRegistry accessors from the sibling session-registry implementation, forming the public entry point for Synapse session management.

nodes.name: task-envelope.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the synapse_task_begin/synapse_task_end MCP tool contract, collapsing session creation, buffer priming, first search, prefetch, and access recording into one call with a partial-failure contract that always returns a usable session.

nodes.name: TaskEnvelopeService
nodes.summary: Implements begin()/end() for synapse_task_begin/synapse_task_end: begin() chains session creation, buffer priming, first search, prefetch, and access recording with independent per-step failure tracking; end() summarizes and deletes the session.

nodes.name: fetcher.ts
nodes.summary: Fetches and converts a single URL's content (HTML→markdown or JSON→key-path chunks) behind the SSRF guard, applies a size cap while streaming the body, chunks the result for indexing, and honors a TTL-based re-index skip.

nodes.name: composeFetchCacheKey
nodes.summary: Builds the TTL-cache key for a fetched URL from its source label and a truncated SHA-256 hash of the URL.

nodes.name: readCappedBody
nodes.summary: Streams a fetch Response body up to MAX_FETCH_BYTES, aborting the read and canceling the stream once the cap is exceeded to bound memory use for arbitrarily large remote responses.

nodes.name: fetchAndConvertOne
nodes.summary: End-to-end single-URL pipeline: checks the TTL cache, fetches through the SSRF guard, reads the capped body, converts/chunks it by content type, indexes the chunks, and marks the URL as indexed.

nodes.name: buildChunks
nodes.summary: Converts a fetched body into IndexedChunks based on content type — JSON is flattened into key-path chunks, HTML is converted to markdown and sliced, everything else is treated as plain text.

nodes.name: sliceMarkdown
nodes.summary: Splits long markdown into size-bounded slices, preferring to break on the last newline before the limit to avoid cutting mid-line.

nodes.name: html-to-md.ts
nodes.summary: Converts HTML to markdown via a lazily-initialized Turndown instance (stripping scripts/styles) and flattens arbitrary JSON into readable key-path markdown chunks for indexing non-HTML fetch responses.

nodes.name: getTurndown
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and memoizes a single configured Turndown instance (with script/style tags stripped) used to convert HTML to markdown.

nodes.name: htmlToMarkdown
nodes.summary: Converts an HTML string to markdown via the shared Turndown instance and collapses excess blank lines.

nodes.name: jsonToKeyPathChunks
nodes.summary: Entry point that flattens an arbitrary JSON value into a list of readable key.path: value markdown lines via the recursive walk helper.

nodes.name: walk
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a JSON value, emitting one markdown bullet per leaf/array/object path so deeply nested JSON becomes flat, greppable text for indexing.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public barrel for the web ingestion service, re-exporting the SSRF guard, HTML/JSON-to-markdown converters, fetch-and-chunk primitives, and WebController orchestrator as a single import surface.

nodes.name: ssrf.ts
nodes.summary: Server-Side Request Forgery guard for fetch_and_index: classifies IPs against a strict block-list (link-local/IMDS, loopback, RFC1918, multicast, malformed), then resolves DNS once and pins the outbound connection to the classified IP to close TOCTOU DNS-rebinding gaps, including on redirects.
nodes.languageNotes: The DNS-pin technique rewrites the fetch URL to the already-classified literal IP and sets the Host header to the original hostname, so the runtime's own connect-time DNS re-resolution never runs — closing the classic TOCTOU rebinding window between check and connect.

nodes.name: setDnsResolver
nodes.summary: Test/DI seam that overrides the module's DNS resolver function, allowing tests to simulate DNS-rebinding scenarios without real network lookups.

nodes.name: classifyIp
nodes.summary: Classifies a raw IP string (v4 or v6) into a safety category — loopback, link-local/IMDS, private RFC1918/ULA, multicast, unspecified, malformed, or public — the core decision function the SSRF guard blocks on.

nodes.name: assertUrlSafe
nodes.summary: Validates a URL's scheme and resolves and classifies every DNS-returned address, throwing SsrfBlockedError if any address is unsafe or if the hostname is malformed — the pre-connect half of the DNS-rebinding defense.

nodes.name: looksLikeIpLiteral
nodes.summary: Heuristically detects whether a hostname string is already a literal IPv4/IPv6 address rather than a DNS name.

nodes.name: fetchWithSsrfGuard
nodes.summary: SSRF-safe fetch wrapper that validates the URL, pins the connection to its classified IP, performs the request with a timeout, and re-validates each redirect target before following it manually.

nodes.name: pinConnection
nodes.summary: Rewrites a URL's host to a literal, already-classified IP address so the runtime's own DNS resolution is bypassed at connect time, closing the SSRF TOCTOU window.

nodes.name: SsrfBlockedError
nodes.summary: Typed error thrown when a fetch target is blocked by the SSRF guard, carrying the offending URL/IP and the specific block reason.

nodes.name: web-controller.ts
nodes.summary: Singleton orchestrator for fetch_and_index: builds one PoolJob per URL, fetches them in parallel via runPool (indexing kept serial per URL for single-writer safety), maintains an injected vector/keyword index plus a bounded TTL cache, and returns per-URL status.

nodes.name: WebController
nodes.summary: Singleton composition root for fetch_and_index: wires real vector/keyword stores into WebIndexDeps, runs per-URL fetch jobs through runPool, and maintains a bounded insertion-order TTL cache to skip recently-indexed URLs.

nodes.name: fetch_and_index.ts
nodes.summary: Thin MCP tool handler for fetch_and_index; validates nothing itself and delegates entirely to an injected run function that the Tools API route binds to WebController.fetchAndIndex (tests bind a stub instead).

nodes.name: FetchAndIndexTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation for fetch_and_index that declares the tool's MCP input schema and forwards every call to an injected run function, keeping the tool itself free of business logic.

nodes.name: get_optimized_context.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler for get_optimized_context that delegates to ContextController.getOptimizedContext and serializes the result via serializeToolResponse.

nodes.name: GetOptimizedContextTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation for get_optimized_context that declares the MCP input schema, calls ContextController.getOptimizedContext, and serializes the result into a ToolResponse.

nodes.name: search_code.ts
nodes.summary: Thin MCP tool handler for search_code that logs the request and delegates directly to SearchProjectTool.handle, sharing its search implementation under a code-oriented alias.

nodes.name: SearchCodeTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation for search_code that logs the incoming request and delegates handling directly to an internal SearchProjectTool instance.

nodes.name: search_project.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler for search_project that delegates to SearchController.searchProject and serializes the response via serializeToolResponse; the primary search entry point that search_code wraps.

nodes.name: SearchProjectTool
nodes.summary: IToolHandler implementation for search_project that declares the MCP input schema, calls SearchController.searchProject, and serializes the response, catching and logging any failure.

nodes.name: native-skip.ts
nodes.summary: Test helper exposing an isNativeTarget platform/arch predicate and a describeNative conditional test-suite wrapper, used across the test suite to skip native tree-sitter grammar tests on unsupported platform/architecture combinations.

nodes.name: contextual-search-rlm.characterization.test.ts
nodes.summary: Characterization (golden-master) test suite for ContextualSearchRLM, covering RLM-gated contextual search behavior with mock search results, timing/gate helpers, and a stubbed native grammar set.

nodes.name: etl-cache-invalidation.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests cache-invalidation behavior in the ETL GraphGenerationCoordinator, verifying that graph regeneration correctly reacts to changed input snapshots using a stubbed native grammar set.

nodes.name: etl-pipeline-queue.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests EtlPipeline job queueing and concurrency behavior together with IndexJobTracker and the project-identity alias resolver, using deferred promises and a stubbed grammar set to control timing precisely.

nodes.name: grammar-integrity.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests native grammar package source-integrity verification, validating that computePackageSourceIntegrity and verifyNativeGrammarIntegrity correctly detect tampering against the locked native dependency identities.

nodes.name: language-manifest.test.ts
nodes.summary: Exhaustive test suite for the structural language manifest, validating version constants, per-language manifest entries, and structural language/parse-language resolution against the type taxonomy.

nodes.name: native-target-predicate.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the isNativeTarget platform/arch predicate that gates native tree-sitter grammar tests, exercising accepted and rejected platform/architecture combinations.

nodes.name: parse-long-class.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression test verifying that ParseStage correctly parses very large class bodies without truncation or structural extraction errors.

nodes.name: structural-data-document.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests structural parsing of data-document content through StructuralRuntime, including embedded-slice query execution and source-span handling for a capacity-configurable runtime.

nodes.name: structural-etl.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration test suite wiring the parse, resolve, and load ETL stages together against temp-directory fixtures to verify end-to-end structural symbol and import extraction.

nodes.name: result
nodes.summary: Builds a mock search-result object (id, score, source) used as fixture data for characterization assertions.

nodes.name: makeStubGrammarSet
nodes.summary: Builds a stub grammar set map, keying stubbed parser entries by grammarArtifactKey to simulate native tree-sitter grammar loading in tests.

nodes.name: stubGrammarSet
nodes.summary: Builds a stub grammar set map keyed by grammarArtifactKey to bypass real native grammar loading during cache-invalidation tests.

nodes.name: result
nodes.summary: Builds a mock pipeline-run result object (including an errors list) used as fixture data in queue/concurrency assertions.

nodes.name: stubGrammarSet
nodes.summary: Builds a stub grammar set map keyed by grammarArtifactKey so pipeline-queue tests avoid real native grammar loading.

nodes.name: fixture
nodes.summary: Writes a fixture file into a fresh temp directory (creating parent directories as needed) and tracks the temp directory for cleanup.

nodes.name: structural-grammar-readiness.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests parser-readiness validation and grammar-descriptor comparison logic, verifying grammar loader artifacts are validated and reported consistently before indexing begins.

nodes.name: structural-query-pack.test.ts
nodes.summary: Large test suite exercising tree-sitter query packs across TypeScript and other languages, verifying capability-gated query execution, capture normalization, and embedded-context resolution via StructuralRuntime.

nodes.name: structural-resolver.test.ts
nodes.summary: Extensive fixture-builder suite (identity, definition, import, reference, symbol factories) used to validate cross-file structural symbol resolution against StructuralRuntime and the services barrel.

nodes.name: structural-runtime.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests StructuralRuntime parsing, query execution, and parser-pool integration using fake tree/parser doubles and event-tracking helpers to validate lifecycle and diagnostic-bounding behavior.

nodes.name: parse.ts
nodes.summary: ETL parse stage that runs structural parsing across changed files in parallel phases, extracting symbols and imports via native tree-sitter grammars (with regex fallbacks for Python, Dart, and Kotlin) and recording header-importer evidence for C/C++ disambiguation.
nodes.languageNotes: Falls back to hand-rolled regex-based symbol/import extraction for languages without full tree-sitter query-pack coverage (Python, Dart, Kotlin), alongside native-grammar parsing for fully supported languages.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Root barrel for the entire services domain layer, re-exporting nearly every service module — search, embeddings, memory graph, ETL pipeline, structural parsing, synapse cognition, scheduler, workspace, and web-fetch controllers — as the single import surface consumed by tools/ and controllers/.

nodes.name: diagnostics.ts
nodes.summary: Structural-parsing diagnostics utilities: builds bounded diagnostic records from tree-sitter parse errors and classifies native-module load failures for actionable error reporting.

nodes.name: grammar-integrity.ts
nodes.summary: Computes and verifies a SHA-512 source-integrity hash over the native tree-sitter grammar packages, guarding against silent tampering or drift from the locked native dependency identities.
nodes.languageNotes: Walks the package source tree deterministically (sorted directory entries, POSIX-normalized relative paths) so the resulting hash is stable across platforms.

nodes.name: grammar-loaders.ts
nodes.summary: Central loader for native tree-sitter grammar artifacts: resolves platform-specific native bindings per language, masks the Bun version during load to work around upstream native-module version checks, and assembles the runtime GrammarSet consumed by StructuralRuntime.
nodes.languageNotes: withMaskedBunVersion temporarily rewrites process.versions.bun's property descriptor during grammar loading to bypass a native-module version check, then restores the original descriptor afterward — a targeted workaround rather than a general pattern.

nodes.name: descriptorEquals
nodes.summary: Structurally compares two PropertyDescriptor objects for the grammar-readiness test's own assertions.

nodes.name: parseTypeScriptWithCapabilities
nodes.summary: Parses TypeScript source with a given capability set by loading native grammars, selecting the dialect query pack, running StructuralRuntime, and executing the query pack against the resulting tree.

nodes.name: identity
nodes.summary: Fixture factory building a frozen structural-identity object (file, name, plus overrides) used across resolver test cases.

nodes.name: definition
nodes.summary: Fixture factory building a structural definition record from a file, name, and identity options.

nodes.name: imported
nodes.summary: Fixture factory building a frozen structural import record from a specifier and set of bindings.

nodes.name: reference
nodes.summary: Fixture factory building a frozen structural reference record from a symbol name and options.

nodes.name: symbol
nodes.summary: Fixture factory building a frozen structural symbol record from a name, qualified name, and overrides.

nodes.name: fakeTree
nodes.summary: Builds a fake parsed-tree double that records lifecycle events (walk/delete) so tests can assert on tree disposal and cursor-creation behavior.

nodes.name: fakeGrammarSet
nodes.summary: Builds a fake grammar set whose parser factory produces fake parsers wired to a given tree-producing factory, for StructuralRuntime tests.

nodes.name: StructuralEtlParseError
nodes.summary: Error type for structural ETL parse-stage failures, carrying a machine-readable error code alongside the message.

nodes.name: ParseStage
nodes.summary: ETL pipeline stage that parses each changed file's content via the native structural runtime (or regex fallback for Python/Dart/Kotlin), extracting symbols, imports, and C/C++ header-importer evidence, and emitting progress events for the pipeline.

nodes.name: resolveChunkerMaxChars
nodes.summary: Resolves the maximum characters per chunk for the code chunker from embedding-provider-specific env var overrides, defaulting per provider (e.g., Ollama).

nodes.name: diagnostic
nodes.summary: Builds a single structural diagnostic record from a parse error, code, and severity, truncating the message to a bounded length.

nodes.name: boundDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Caps a diagnostics array to MAX_STRUCTURAL_DIAGNOSTIC_DETAILS entries and freezes it for immutability.

nodes.name: classifyNativeFailure
nodes.summary: Classifies a caught native-module load error into a coarse failure category by inspecting the error message text.

nodes.name: GrammarIntegrityError
nodes.summary: Error type for grammar-integrity verification failures, carrying a machine-readable code for programmatic handling.

nodes.name: resolvePackageRoot
nodes.summary: Resolves the on-disk root directory of an installed native grammar package by walking up from its resolved entry file to the directory containing package.json.

nodes.name: listSourceFiles
nodes.summary: Recursively lists all source files under a package root in deterministic sorted order, excluding ABI-specific build directories.

nodes.name: pushContribution
nodes.summary: Appends a labeled byte-buffer contribution (path plus content) into the running hash-input chunk list.

nodes.name: computePackageSourceIntegrity
nodes.summary: Computes a deterministic SHA-512 digest over a native grammar package's package.json, compiled grammar binary, and all source files.

nodes.name: verifyNativeGrammarIntegrity
nodes.summary: Verifies the source integrity of every trusted native grammar package against expectations, returning per-package pass/fail results.

nodes.name: resetGrammarIntegrityForTests
nodes.summary: Resets any cached grammar-integrity state; a test-only escape hatch matching the project's get*/reset* factory convention.

nodes.name: descriptorEquals
nodes.summary: Structurally compares two PropertyDescriptor objects across value, writable, enumerable, and configurable fields.

nodes.name: withMaskedBunVersion
nodes.summary: Runs a callback with process.versions.bun temporarily masked or removed, then restores the original property descriptor, working around a native module's Bun-version sniffing during grammar loading.

nodes.name: grammarArtifactKey
nodes.summary: Derives the cache key used to identify a loaded grammar artifact within a GrammarSet map.

nodes.name: assertRuntimeTarget
nodes.summary: Asserts the current runtime matches the expected Bun major version target before attempting native grammar loads, failing fast on incompatible runtimes.

nodes.name: loadArtifact
nodes.summary: Loads a single grammar artifact (native binding or WASM module) by package name, dispatching a per-language require/dynamic-import strategy.

nodes.name: loadNativeGrammarSet
nodes.summary: Loads and caches the full set of native tree-sitter grammar artifacts for all supported languages, masking the Bun version during the load and asserting the runtime target first.

nodes.name: language-manifest.ts
nodes.summary: Central registry mapping file extensions to tree-sitter grammar packages, versions, and capability metadata (query-pack version, resolver version, native ABI) for every supported language, and derives the fingerprint inputs used to invalidate cached structural data when the manifest changes.
nodes.languageNotes: Backs every supported extension with a frozen manifest entry; exhaustiveness helpers (inspectLanguageManifest/assertLanguageManifestExhaustive) exist purely so tests can assert the manifest covers exactly the expected extension set.

nodes.name: native-lock-identities.ts
nodes.summary: Pinned lockfile-derived identity table (versions and hashes) for every native tree-sitter grammar dependency plus the patched tree-sitter core package, consumed to verify native module integrity before parsing.

nodes.name: native-node-helpers.ts
nodes.summary: Low-level tree-sitter AST helper library providing byte-range text extraction, field/child lookups, BFS descendant traversal, and the large per-language symbolName resolver that extracts a declaration's name from dozens of different grammar node shapes.
nodes.languageNotes: symbolName alone spans ~90 lines of language-specific branching (JS/TS, Python, Rust, Elixir, Haskell, Kotlin, Swift, C#, Erlang, Clojure, OCaml, and more) to locate a declaration's identifier node.

nodes.name: parser-pool.ts
nodes.summary: Bounded, timeout-aware object pool that hands out reusable native tree-sitter Parser instances so concurrent structural parses don't exceed a capacity limit or hang indefinitely waiting for one.

nodes.name: parser-readiness.ts
nodes.summary: Startup self-test gate that parses a fixture with every loaded grammar to confirm native tree-sitter modules actually work, caching the validated grammar set per process generation and exposing an assertion used before indexing begins.
nodes.languageNotes: Follows the repo's get*()/reset*ForTests() factory pattern so the readiness cache can be reset between test runs.

nodes.name: query-pack-captures.ts
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw tree-sitter query captures into deduplicated, sorted structures and extracts language-specific import bindings (including Rust's nested use trees) and embedded-language slices such as Vue SFC blocks and fenced Markdown code blocks.

nodes.name: query-pack-edges.ts
nodes.summary: The heavyweight edge builder that turns raw query captures into typed import, call, and syntax (inherits/implements/type-reference) edges across every supported language grammar; by far the largest and most language-branchy file in the structural subsystem.
nodes.languageNotes: buildImports alone is ~300 lines handling import/require/use syntax for roughly 20 language families, one grammar-specific branch at a time.

nodes.name: query-pack-registry.ts
nodes.summary: Central lookup table mapping each structural language to its StructuralQueryPack and declaring the full set of query capabilities every pack must implement.

nodes.name: query-pack.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestrates a single structural parse of one file: executes the language's query pack, then composes imports, symbols, call edges, and syntax edges into the final StructuralQueryResult, tying together captures, edges, and symbol-signature building.

nodes.name: data-document.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the tree-sitter query packs for markup/data-document languages: Vue, Markdown, JSON, and YAML.

nodes.name: inspectLanguageManifest
nodes.summary: Cross-checks the language manifest against an expected extension list, returning duplicate/missing/extra extensions plus resolved sets for exhaustiveness testing.

nodes.name: assertLanguageManifestExhaustive
nodes.summary: Throws with a detailed diagnostic if inspectLanguageManifest finds the manifest doesn't exactly match an expected extension set.

nodes.name: resolveStructuralLanguage
nodes.summary: Looks up a file extension's manifest entry and returns its structural language identifier, or undefined if the extension is unsupported.

nodes.name: resolveStructuralParseLanguage
nodes.summary: Resolves an extension plus optional header evidence (e.g. shebang) to the concrete grammar/parse language to use, layering evidence-based overrides on top of the plain manifest lookup.

nodes.name: descendants
nodes.summary: Breadth-first collects every descendant node beneath a given tree-sitter node.

nodes.name: symbolName
nodes.summary: Extracts a declaration's display name from a tree-sitter node across dozens of language-specific grammar shapes (JS/TS, Python, Rust, Elixir, Haskell, Kotlin, Swift, C#, and more).

nodes.name: ancestor
nodes.summary: Walks up a node's parent chain to find the nearest ancestor of a given type.

nodes.name: unquote
nodes.summary: Strips matching quote characters from a raw source token, used when reading string-literal import paths and names.

nodes.name: frozenSpan
nodes.summary: Builds an immutable SourceSpan object from a SourceIndex and a pair of byte offsets.

nodes.name: ParserAcquireTimeoutError
nodes.summary: Error thrown when no pooled tree-sitter parser becomes available before the configured acquire timeout elapses.

nodes.name: StructuralParserPool
nodes.summary: Fixed-capacity pool of native tree-sitter Parser instances with FIFO waiter queuing and timeout-based acquisition, preventing unbounded parser creation under concurrent structural indexing.

nodes.name: ParserReadinessError
nodes.summary: Error type raised when one or more grammars fail native validation at startup.

nodes.name: boundedDiagnostic
nodes.summary: Classifies a grammar-loading error message into a short, size-bounded diagnostic string safe for inclusion in readiness reports.

nodes.name: runValidation
nodes.summary: Loads every grammar via the injected loader, parses a fixture with each one, and records per-language pass/fail results with timing and diagnostics after first verifying native package integrity.

nodes.name: validateAllGrammars
nodes.summary: Runs (and memoizes per process generation) the full grammar validation pass, returning a promise that resolves once for the whole process lifetime.

nodes.name: getValidatedNativeGrammarSet
nodes.summary: Returns the already-loaded and validated native grammar set, throwing a ParserReadinessError if grammars haven't been validated yet.

nodes.name: assertParserReadyForIndexing
nodes.summary: Guard called before indexing starts that fails fast if grammar validation hasn't completed successfully.

nodes.name: resetParserReadinessForTests
nodes.summary: Test-only hook that resets the module's cached validation state and generation counter, optionally injecting a custom grammar loader.

nodes.name: normalizeQueryCaptures
nodes.summary: Sorts tree-sitter query captures by source position and removes duplicate (name, node) pairs.

nodes.name: frozenBindings
nodes.summary: Deduplicates a list of import bindings by imported/local/typeOnly/arity key and deep-freezes the result.

nodes.name: importBindings
nodes.summary: Extracts the list of imported names, aliases, and type-only flags from an import-statement capture across JS/TS-family grammars.

nodes.name: rustUseLeaves
nodes.summary: Recursively flattens a Rust use tree, including nested use_list groups, into individual leaf import paths.

nodes.name: functionalCaptures
nodes.summary: Builds captures for functional-language definition forms such as Clojure's defn/defrecord, classifying them by symbol family.

nodes.name: collectEmbeddedChildren
nodes.summary: Detects embedded-language regions such as Vue SFC blocks and fenced Markdown code blocks, slicing out their source range plus declared language tag for delegated parsing.

nodes.name: buildImports
nodes.summary: The all-languages import-edge builder: reads import/require/use statements across every supported grammar family and normalizes them into resolved or unresolved structural import edges.

nodes.name: callKind
nodes.summary: Classifies a call target's raw name and qualifier into a call-kind tag (HTTP client, listener registration, GraphQL operation, or generic) for annotation on call edges.

nodes.name: buildCallEdges
nodes.summary: Builds call-graph edges from edge.call captures, resolving callee names/qualifiers and deriving call kinds from the first argument.

nodes.name: buildSyntaxEdges
nodes.summary: Builds non-call structural edges (extends/implements/type-reference relationships) from syntax captures across languages.

nodes.name: dedupeEdges
nodes.summary: Removes duplicate structural edges keyed by a composite of kind, span, and target.

nodes.name: enabled
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given query capability is present in a capability set.

nodes.name: queryPackFor
nodes.summary: Looks up the registered StructuralQueryPack for a structural language identifier.

nodes.name: structuralQueryPackForDialect
nodes.summary: Public alias of queryPackFor used by consumers that key off dialect rather than language.

nodes.name: executeQueryPack
nodes.summary: Runs a query pack's queries against a parsed tree, then composes imports, symbols, call edges, and syntax edges (gated by declared capabilities) into one StructuralQueryResult.

nodes.name: executeStructuralQueryPack
nodes.summary: Resolves the query pack for a language and delegates to executeQueryPack; the public single-file parse entry point.

nodes.name: functional.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the tree-sitter query packs for functional languages: Elixir, Erlang, Clojure, OCaml, and Haskell.

nodes.name: managed.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the tree-sitter query packs for managed/VM languages: Java, Kotlin, Scala, C#, Swift, and Dart.

nodes.name: scripting.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the tree-sitter query packs for scripting languages: Python, Ruby, PHP, and Lua.

nodes.name: systems.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the tree-sitter query packs for systems languages: C, C++, Go, Rust, and Zig.

nodes.name: typescript.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the tree-sitter query packs for TypeScript and JavaScript, the project's own primary implementation languages.

nodes.name: source-span.ts
nodes.summary: SourceIndex wraps a file's raw bytes with a precomputed line-start table to convert between byte offsets and line/column points, validate spans, and take UTF-8-safe snippets; the shared coordinate system every structural component uses to describe source locations.

nodes.name: structural-runtime.ts
nodes.summary: StructuralRuntime is the top-level facade that wraps native tree-sitter parsers with a byte-offset node adapter, per-parser query/constructor caches, a parser pool, and startup grammar validation, then runs a query pack over the resulting tree to produce a StructuralParseResult.
nodes.languageNotes: byteNodeAdapter exists specifically to remap tree-sitter's native UTF-16-based offsets onto byte offsets, since the rest of the pipeline (SourceIndex, spans) is byte-oriented.

nodes.name: symbol-signature.ts
nodes.summary: Derives a symbol's kind, modifiers, human-readable signature text, and qualified name from its tree-sitter AST location, including cross-language heuristics for functions/methods/classes, Markdown heading nesting, and export-wrapper detection, culminating in buildSymbols which turns raw captures into the final StructuralSymbol array.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the structural subsystem's core vocabulary: symbol kinds, edge kinds, capability flags, and schema-version constants that every other file in services/structural/ and the ETL pipeline imports as its shared type contract.
nodes.languageNotes: A dependency-free leaf module (zero imports) that acts as the root of the structural subsystem's type graph; nearly every other file in the batch imports it.

nodes.name: deriveLegacyLineRange
nodes.summary: Converts a SourceSpan's start/end points into a legacy 1-based [startLine, endLine] tuple for backward-compatible consumers.

nodes.name: SourceIndex
nodes.summary: Precomputes line-start offsets for a source buffer and exposes byte-to-point conversion, span validation, UTF-8-safe snippet extraction, and child-span remapping; the shared coordinate system for every structural span in the codebase.

nodes.name: byteNodeAdapter
nodes.summary: Wraps native tree-sitter nodes in a byte-offset-based adapter (instead of tree-sitter's default UTF-16 offsets) with an identity cache so the same native node always maps to the same wrapped node.

nodes.name: executeBoundedNativeQuery
nodes.summary: Runs a compiled native tree-sitter query with the match-count safety limit applied, freezing and returning the resulting captures.

nodes.name: compiledQuery
nodes.summary: Two-level (grammar, query-source) cache of compiled native Query objects, avoiding recompilation of the same query on every parse.

nodes.name: processPoolFor
nodes.summary: Returns, creating if needed, the StructuralParserPool for a given loaded grammar generation.

nodes.name: startupGrammarSet
nodes.summary: Triggers grammar validation and returns the validated native grammar set, used at process startup before any file is parsed.

nodes.name: failed
nodes.summary: Builds a failed StructuralParseResult with a classified failure kind and bounded diagnostics.

nodes.name: StructuralRuntime
nodes.summary: The facade class that parses a source buffer with the pooled native parser for its language, adapts the tree to byte offsets, and runs the language's query pack; the single entry point the rest of the codebase uses to get structural data for a file.

nodes.name: symbolKind
nodes.summary: Maps a query capture name plus AST context (e.g. detecting export default wrapping, arrow-function assignment) to a StructuralSymbolKind.

nodes.name: declarationExportWrapper
nodes.summary: Finds the export/export-default ancestor node wrapping a declaration, if any.

nodes.name: structuralSignature
nodes.summary: Builds the final trimmed, single-line signature string for a symbol from its owner node and declared type.

nodes.name: signatureMaterial
nodes.summary: Gathers a symbol's parameter types, modifiers (visibility, static, async, etc.), and export status across many language grammars into the raw material used to build its signature.

nodes.name: buildSymbols
nodes.summary: The central symbol-building function: turns raw capture groups into fully-formed StructuralSymbol entries with kind, name, signature, documentation, and Markdown heading-level nesting resolved via a heading stack.

nodes.name: logger.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the shared Logger utility, covering log-level filtering, stderr-only output for stdio MCP safety, JSON metadata formatting, metrics logging, and scoped child loggers.

nodes.name: metrics.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for MetricsCollector and PerformanceTracker, verifying per-model token-cost calculation, fallback pricing, compression-event recording, and aggregated report generation.

nodes.name: rate-limiter.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the token-bucket RateLimiter and the combined SmartRateLimiter, covering refill timing, tryConsume/consume behavior, and capacity status reporting.

nodes.name: sanitizer.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the input-sanitization helpers, covering HTML/control-character stripping, FTS5 query escaping, and email/user-ID/file-path/JSON validators.

nodes.name: types.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests validating the shape and values of the core shared enums (MemoryLevel, MemoryType) and the structural-transport symbol-kind taxonomy re-exported through types/index.ts.

nodes.name: config-loader.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the config-loader module that spy on the real `fs` module and drive an in-memory virtual filesystem to verify config load/save/init, env-derived config, and the one-time legacy data-dir migration without touching the real config.json.

nodes.name: xdg.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the pure XDG Base Directory resolution helpers, covering env-var precedence and default fallbacks for config/data/cache/runtime/state home directories.

nodes.name: config-loader.ts
nodes.summary: Reads, deep-merges, and persists the on-disk `~/.config/massa-ai/config.json` file against `defaultMassaAiConfig`, and performs a one-time migration of the legacy data directory to the unified XDG location.
nodes.languageNotes: Exposes both a throwing `loadConfig` and a never-throwing `loadConfigSafe` wrapper — the latter is what env.ts and config/index.ts use so a missing or corrupt config.json can never abort startup.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the in-memory `ServerConfig` shape and the central `Config` manager class (deep-merge, validate, get/getNested/getAll/set), aggregating defaults for cache, search, LLM, memory/Synapse, hooks, rate-limiting and security, and re-exporting the config-loader surface as the package's single configuration entry point.
nodes.languageNotes: `mergeConfig` performs a deep, path-aware merge (cache.l1/l2/embedding, search.queryUnderstanding/rerank, synapse.inhibition/scoring/metacognition/buffer) so partial overrides never silently drop untouched nested defaults, unlike a shallow spread.

nodes.name: massa-ai-config.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the `MassaAiConfig` TypeScript interface — the on-disk schema for `config.json` (database, embedding provider, compression, capture policy, cache, LLM, memory, hooks) — and exports `defaultMassaAiConfig`, the literal defaults consumed by the config-loader.

nodes.name: xdg.ts
nodes.summary: Pure XDG Base Directory Specification resolver (config/data/cache/runtime/state home plus per-app subdirectory helpers) with zero project-module imports, deliberately breaking the config-loader/massa-ai-config circular dependency.
nodes.languageNotes: Explicitly zero-import by design (file docstring cites spec AC1/N36): only Node's `path`/`os` builtins are used so both config-loader.ts and massa-ai-config.ts can import it without forming a cycle.

nodes.name: env.ts
nodes.summary: Bootstraps environment variables at process startup: resolves and loads the nearest `.env` file (walking up directories for monorepo layouts), then seeds `process.env` (DATABASE_URL, LLM/embedding API keys) from config.json as a lower-precedence fallback, and triggers the one-time legacy data-dir migration.
nodes.languageNotes: Loads config-loader via a deferred `require()` instead of a static import specifically to avoid a circular static import, while still running the seed logic at module-eval time before any consumer reads process.env.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Core shared type definitions for the memory hierarchy (MemoryLevel, MemoryType, Memory, MemoryMetadata), cache entries, search results, and compression contracts used across package boundaries; also re-exports the structural-transport symbol taxonomy.

nodes.name: interfaces.ts
nodes.summary: Repository- and service-layer contract interfaces (IMemoryRepository, ICacheManager, ILogger, and related filter/stats types) defining the Repository and Strategy pattern boundaries that concrete classes elsewhere implement.
nodes.languageNotes: `Logger` in utils/logger.ts implements the `ILogger` interface declared here (no dedicated node exists for TypeScript interfaces in this graph schema).

nodes.name: structural-transport.ts
nodes.summary: Canonical symbol-kind taxonomy (STRUCTURAL_SYMBOL_KINDS) and FQN-resolution transport types shared by the HTTP and MCP structural/graph surfaces for definitions, references, and symbol traces.

nodes.name: logger.ts
nodes.summary: Structured `Logger` class (debug/info/warn/error, metrics, child loggers) that writes every level to stderr only, keeping stdout clean for the stdio MCP JSON-RPC protocol; exports a lazily-configured singleton `logger` instance.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately routes all log levels to `console.error`/stderr — a single stray stdout write would break the stdio MCP transport's JSON-RPC framing, per CLAUDE.md and the dedicated `mcp-stdout-clean.test.ts` guard in apps/mcp-client.

nodes.name: metrics.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks LLM token usage, compression ratios, and cost savings (MetricsCollector) plus generic async-operation timing (PerformanceTracker), with a fallback per-model pricing table when the live pricing API is unavailable.

nodes.name: rate-limiter.ts
nodes.summary: Token-bucket `RateLimiter` primitive plus a `SmartRateLimiter` that combines separate request-count and token-count buckets (sized from config) to throttle LLM API calls, with async wait-for-capacity support.

nodes.name: sanitizer.ts
nodes.summary: Input-sanitization and validation helpers — HTML/control-character stripping, FTS5 full-text-search query escaping, and email/user-ID/file-path/JSON validators — gated by the `security` config block.

nodes.name: loadConfig
nodes.summary: Reads and JSON-parses config.json, deep-merging it over defaultMassaAiConfig section by section; returns the defaults on any missing file or parse error.

nodes.name: loadConfigSafe
nodes.summary: Never-throwing wrapper around loadConfig, used by env.ts and config/index.ts so a corrupt or missing config.json never aborts startup.

nodes.name: migrateDataDirOnce
nodes.summary: One-time migration of the legacy ~/.massa-ai-data/ directory to the unified XDG data location, guarded to run once per process before any consumer resolves dataDir.

nodes.name: saveConfig
nodes.summary: Serializes and writes a MassaAiConfig object to config.json, creating the config directory first if it does not exist.

nodes.name: initConfig
nodes.summary: Initializes config.json with the default configuration on first run, skipping the write if a config file already exists.

nodes.name: getConfigForEnv
nodes.summary: Loads the current config and applies environment-specific string coercion so downstream env-driven consumers get normalized values.

nodes.name: validateCapturePolicyConfig
nodes.summary: Validates a capturePolicy config block at load time — rejects unknown fields, invalid rule dispositions, and Drop-rule counts exceeding maxIgnorePatterns/maxMatchWork — mirroring core's validatePolicy without depending on @massa-ai/core.

nodes.name: getGlobalDataDir
nodes.summary: Resolves the global data directory using precedence MASSA_AI_DATA_DIR env var > config.json dataDir > ~/.config/massa-ai/data default.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.summary: In-memory configuration manager that deep-merges defaultConfig with caller overrides, validates invariants such as targetCompressionRatio bounds, and exposes get/getNested/getAll/set accessors; instantiated once as the package-wide `config` singleton.

nodes.name: findEnvFile
nodes.summary: Walks up from process.cwd() to the filesystem root looking for the nearest .env file, supporting monorepo layouts where packages run from subdirectories.

nodes.name: Logger
nodes.summary: Structured logger implementing ILogger, with lazy config-driven log-level initialization, JSON metadata formatting, stderr-only output, and a child() factory for module-scoped prefixed loggers.
nodes.languageNotes: All output goes through a single private write() that calls console.error — the whole class exists to guarantee stdout stays pristine for the stdio MCP JSON-RPC transport.

nodes.name: MetricsCollector
nodes.summary: Static collector that computes per-request LLM cost from token counts and model pricing (with a fallback pricing table), records compression events, and aggregates them into a human-readable savings report.

nodes.name: PerformanceTracker
nodes.summary: Wraps an arbitrary async function to time its execution and record success/failure duration stats, exposing aggregate getStats() (avg/min/max, success rate) per operation name.

nodes.name: RateLimiter
nodes.summary: Token-bucket rate limiter primitive with time-based refill, a synchronous tryConsume, and an async consume that sleeps until capacity is available.

nodes.name: SmartRateLimiter
nodes.summary: Combines a request-count RateLimiter and a token-count RateLimiter (both sized from config) into one throttle for LLM API calls, with checkRequest, async waitForCapacity, and status reporting.

nodes.name: sanitizeInput
nodes.summary: Strips HTML angle-brackets and control characters from a string and truncates it to security.maxInputLength, unless sanitization is disabled via config.

nodes.name: sanitizeFTS5Query
nodes.summary: Converts a space-separated search query into an FTS5-safe OR-joined term list, quoting terms that contain special characters to avoid SQLite FTS5 syntax errors.

nodes.name: sanitizeFilePath
nodes.summary: Strips ../ and ..\ path-traversal sequences and leading slashes from a file path before it is used in filesystem operations.

nodes.name: code-compressor.test.ts
nodes.summary: Characterization tests for CodeCompressor's regex-based structure-extraction compression path, asserting current behavior across TypeScript/JavaScript-like inputs without invoking the LLM.

nodes.name: compress-context.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the compress_context MCP tool, exercising CodeCompressor's deterministic regex path with the LLM explicitly disabled via a test seam for reproducibility.

nodes.name: compressed-content.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the CompressedContent model, covering its constructor, static factories (create, identity, merge), and instance methods (calculateRatio, isEffective, getQualityScore, validate, toJSON).

nodes.name: dart-support.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression tests verifying Dart source files are chunked as code by the smart chunker and that CodeCompressor's heuristic language detector correctly identifies Dart.

nodes.name: llm-client-json-schema.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for Ollama json_schema constrained-decoding support in llmObject, covering the version-gated fallback to json_object and graceful degradation on schema errors, with the AI SDK network layer mocked.

nodes.name: llm-client.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit tests for the shared LLM client (llmComplete/llmObject), asserting the timeout, silent-degradation, and default-off contract guarantees with the ai SDK mocked and only the enabled flag toggled via a test seam.

nodes.name: llm-judge.benchmark.test.ts
nodes.summary: Opt-in, Ollama-gated non-regression benchmark that drives a real local LLM through consolidator/salience/reranker judge paths and asserts scores stay above committed baseline floors, skipping cleanly when Ollama is unreachable.
nodes.languageNotes: Live-network gated test distinct from the mocked unit suite; floors are set conservatively below a recorded baseline to tolerate sampling noise rather than catch every dip.

nodes.name: query-understanding.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for query rewrite + HyDE expansion, cache TTL/eviction, RRF fan-out fusion, and degradation paths, using injected fake LLM/embed surfaces so no config or network is touched.

nodes.name: reranker.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for LLMJudgeReranker covering verdict application, window sizing, and silent degradation to input order on disabled or failed LLM calls, using an injected fake LLM surface.

nodes.name: salience-judge.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for SalienceJudge's memory-importance scoring, covering the auto-importance config gate, neutral-default degradation paths, and clamping of LLM-returned scores, with config and the LLM surface mocked.

nodes.name: CompressedContent.ts
nodes.summary: Data model representing semantically compressed content with token-savings metadata, offering static factories (create, identity, merge) and quality/validation helpers used by the compression pipeline.

nodes.name: code-compressor.ts
nodes.summary: Structure-preserving code compressor that strips implementation bodies via regex extraction and optionally upgrades the result with an LLM pass gated by isLlmEnabled, always falling back to the deterministic regex output on any LLM failure.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes a hand-rolled multi-language signature detector (TypeScript/JavaScript/Python/Rust/Go/Kotlin/Dart) driven by regex heuristics rather than a parser.

nodes.name: llm-client.ts
nodes.summary: Shared local-first LLM client wrapping the Vercel AI SDK over an OpenAI-compatible Ollama endpoint; provides llmComplete/llmObject with timeout enforcement, default-off gating, and reasoning-channel recovery for thinking models like qwen3.
nodes.languageNotes: The `modelRole` routing knob (instruct vs code model) and reasoning-channel fallback are load-bearing for qwen3-class 'thinking' models that can return empty content on the primary channel; every consumer treats {ok:false} as a signal to fall through to a non-LLM path.

nodes.name: salience-judge.ts
nodes.summary: LLM-backed judge that scores a memory's importance (0-1) for MemoryController's auto-importance path, degrading silently to a neutral 0.5 default whenever the LLM or the feature flag is off.

nodes.name: query-understanding.ts
nodes.summary: Query understanding service that expands a search query via LLM rewrite (expansions + keywords) and HyDE (hypothetical-document embedding) behind a TTL-bounded per-project cache, returning null on any LLM failure so the caller falls back to the original search path.

nodes.name: reranker.ts
nodes.summary: LLM-judge reranker that re-scores the top-K fused search results via a single structured llmObject call, applying the returned permutation while guaranteeing no results are dropped or duplicated; degrades to the verbatim input order on any failure.

nodes.name: ollamaUp
nodes.summary: Checks whether a local Ollama instance is reachable and has the required qwen2.5 models pulled, used to gate the benchmark test's early skip.

nodes.name: probeMerge
nodes.summary: Test helper that asks the real LLM whether a set of memory-entry contents are semantic duplicates, mirroring the consolidator's merge-judgment prompt for benchmark scoring.

nodes.name: fakeSurface
nodes.summary: Builds a fake QueryLlmSurface test double with configurable rewrite/HyDE responses, used to drive QueryUnderstandingService without touching config or network.

nodes.name: fakeEmbed
nodes.summary: Fake embedding function test double that records call arguments and returns a deterministic vector, used to verify HyDE's embed-only-after-success behavior.

nodes.name: rrfFuse
nodes.summary: Test-local reimplementation of reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) used to build a deterministic baseline for asserting that added rewrite/HyDE streams do not regress retrieval ranking quality.

nodes.name: fakeSurface
nodes.summary: Builds a fake QueryLlmSurface returning a configurable rerank verdict, used to drive LLMJudgeReranker.rerank in tests without a real LLM.

nodes.name: makeSurface
nodes.summary: Builds a fake LLM surface with a configurable importance verdict, isEnabled flag, and call-count tracking for SalienceJudge tests.

nodes.name: CompressedContent
nodes.summary: Value object for a compression result, bundling original/compressed text with token-savings metadata; exposes static factories (create, identity, merge) plus quality-scoring and validation instance methods.

nodes.name: buildLlmCompressPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the prompt sent to the LLM compression pass, capping content length and listing the regex-extracted 'must-preserve' signatures so LLM output keeps the same load-bearing structure as the regex fallback.

nodes.name: CodeCompressor
nodes.summary: Implements ICompressor for source code: extracts structural signatures (imports/classes/functions/exports) via regex, optionally refines the result through an injectable LLM-complete function gated by isLlmEnabled, and always falls back to the regex output on LLM failure.

nodes.name: _checkJsonSchemaSupport
nodes.summary: Probes the configured Ollama instance's /api/version endpoint to determine whether it supports json_schema constrained decoding (Ollama >= 0.5.0), caching the result for the process lifetime and defaulting to false on any error.

nodes.name: isLlmEnabled
nodes.summary: Central feature-flag check for whether any LLM-driven path is enabled (config.llm.enabled), honoring a test override seam; every LLM consumer in the codebase gates on this before calling out.

nodes.name: getLlmConfig
nodes.summary: Reads the llm config block with defensive defaults, resolving the per-call model from the instruct/code modelRole routing knob.

nodes.name: _wrapFetchDisableThink
nodes.summary: Wraps the fetch used by the OpenAI-compatible provider to inject a top-level think:false into chat/completion request bodies, best-effort disabling qwen3's reasoning mode.

nodes.name: buildProvider
nodes.summary: Constructs the OpenAI-compatible AI SDK provider bound to the configured Ollama baseURL, optionally wrapping fetch to disable model thinking.

nodes.name: _reasoningToText
nodes.summary: Normalizes the AI SDK's reasoning channel (array parts, raw string, provider metadata, or Responses-API error shape) into a single trimmed string, used to recover answers when qwen3-class models leave the content channel empty.

nodes.name: _extractJsonObject
nodes.summary: Best-effort extraction of the first balanced JSON object from free-text (typically the reasoning channel), stripping markdown code fences before a brace-depth scan; pure and unit-testable.

nodes.name: llmComplete
nodes.summary: Generates a free-form text completion via the AI SDK, honoring the configured timeout and never throwing: returns {ok:false} on disabled/timeout/error, and recovers from the reasoning channel when content comes back empty.

nodes.name: llmObject
nodes.summary: Generates a zod-validated structured object via the AI SDK, preferring Ollama's json_schema constrained decoding when supported and falling back to manual validation of json_object output, with reasoning-channel JSON recovery before degrading to {ok:false}.

nodes.name: getSalienceJudge
nodes.summary: Module-level singleton accessor for the default-configured SalienceJudge, lazily constructed on first call.

nodes.name: buildPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the salience-scoring prompt from truncated memory content and its type, instructing the LLM to return a single JSON importance field in [0,1].

nodes.name: SalienceJudge
nodes.summary: Scores a memory's importance in [0,1] via an injectable LLM surface, returning the neutral default 0.5 whenever the auto-importance flag is off, the LLM is disabled, content is empty, or the call fails.

nodes.name: rewriteQuery
nodes.summary: Expands a search query into structured expansions + keywords via an injected LLM surface and zod schema, returning null on any failure so the caller falls back to the original query.

nodes.name: hyde
nodes.summary: Generates a hypothetical implementation paragraph via the LLM and embeds it with the injected embedFn only after the LLM step succeeds, returning the resulting vector or null on any failure.

nodes.name: buildRewrittenFTSQuery
nodes.summary: Builds a quoted FTS5 OR query from the original query plus rewrite-derived keywords, falling back to the sanitized original query when no keywords survive cleaning.

nodes.name: QueryUnderstandingCache
nodes.summary: Bounded TTL cache for query-understanding results keyed by projectId+query, evicting the entry with the earliest expiry when over capacity and supporting per-project invalidation.
nodes.languageNotes: Eviction is TTL-earliest-expiry based rather than true LRU, a deliberate choice per spec to avoid a new dependency.

nodes.name: QueryUnderstandingService
nodes.summary: Orchestrates query rewrite and HyDE behind a per-(projectId, query) cache, reusing the shared EmbeddingService singleton for HyDE embedding and returning null on any failure path so the caller falls through to the original 2-stream search.

nodes.name: buildPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the rerank judge prompt listing the top-K candidates with truncated content and score, instructing the LLM to return a strict best-first id ordering.

nodes.name: applyVerdict
nodes.summary: Applies the LLM's ranked-id permutation to the candidate head, placing verdict-ordered ids first, appending any omitted ids in original order, and dropping verdict duplicates so output length always equals input length.

nodes.name: LLMJudgeReranker
nodes.summary: Re-scores the top-K fused search results via a single structured llmObject call against an injectable LLM surface, degrading to the verbatim input order whenever the feature is off, disabled, or the call fails.

nodes.name: executor-controller.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for ExecutorController covering intent progressive-disclosure application on execute/executeFile, error handling, batch_execute input validation and size bounds, and singleton lifecycle (getInstance/resetInstance).

nodes.name: executor-extra.test.ts
nodes.summary: Supplementary PolyglotExecutor tests covering runtime/projectRoot getters, error handling for missing runtimes, background-timeout detachment, cleanupBackgrounded, and Rust compile-and-run paths including a no-rustc fallback.

nodes.name: executor.test.ts
nodes.summary: Broad test suite spanning runtime detection, PolyglotExecutor code execution across languages, intent progressive disclosure on large outputs, the runPool concurrency primitive, and ExecutorController.batchExecute.

nodes.name: runtime-extra.test.ts
nodes.summary: Exhaustive tests for runtime-detection helpers: getRuntimeSummary, getAvailableLanguages, buildCommand success/error/shell paths, commandExists, runnableExists, getVersion, and detectRuntimes against the real host.

nodes.name: sandbox.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests for the OS-level sandbox wrapper covering getSandboxMode selection logic, wrapSpawn command wrapping for none/seatbelt/docker modes, and cached tool-availability checks.

nodes.name: security-executor-symlink.test.ts
nodes.summary: Security regression tests verifying execute_file's realpath-based symlink defense blocks project-boundary escapes and deny-glob bypasses via symlinked paths.

nodes.name: executor-controller.ts
nodes.summary: Controller that orchestrates the execute/execute_file/batch_execute MCP tools by owning a singleton PolyglotExecutor, validating language enums, applying intent-based output trimming, and fanning batch commands out through runPool.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a private static singleton (getInstance/resetInstance) specifically so tests can reset executor state including backgrounded-process cleanup between runs.

nodes.name: executor.ts
nodes.summary: Core PolyglotExecutor service that spawns user-supplied code in a detected language runtime inside a temp sandbox directory, enforcing timeouts with process-group kill, an env-var injection denylist, byte-capped output, OS-level sandbox wrapping, and a realpath-based project-boundary plus deny-glob guard for execute_file.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ES2022 private class fields (#hardCapBytes, #spawn, etc.) and per-language source-wrapping (Go package wrapping, PHP opening tag, Rust compile-then-run) to normalize 10 different language runtimes behind one execute() call.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the executor service, re-exporting PolyglotExecutor, the runPool concurrency primitive, runtime-detection helpers, and intent-search progressive disclosure as the service's public surface.

nodes.name: runtime.ts
nodes.summary: Detects installed language runtimes on the host (js/ts/python/shell/ruby/go/rust/php/perl/r) via command-existence and version probes, and builds the per-language invocation command used to run a sandboxed script.

nodes.name: sandbox.ts
nodes.summary: OS-level sandbox wrapper that selects and applies macOS seatbelt or Linux Docker isolation around a spawned command, with an auto-detected best-effort fallback controlled by the MASSA_AI_EXECUTOR_SANDBOX env var.
nodes.languageNotes: The seatbelt path emits a literal `sandbox-exec` policy-language profile string (deny-default, explicit allow rules) rather than calling an API — a macOS-specific DSL worth recognizing when editing it.

nodes.name: batch_execute.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler (ctx_batch_execute) that defines the schema for running N shell commands in parallel via run-pool and delegates execution to an injected run callback.

nodes.name: execute.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler (ctx_execute) defining the schema for running code in a detected polyglot runtime and delegating to an injected run callback (the ExecutorController).

nodes.name: execute_file.ts
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler (ctx_execute_file) defining the schema for reading a file into a sandboxed FILE_CONTENT variable and running code over it, delegating to an injected run callback.

nodes.name: makeExecResult
nodes.summary: Test helper building a default ExecResult fixture with overridable fields for controller tests.

nodes.name: makeFakeExecutor
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing a fake PolyglotExecutor-shaped object with stubbed execute/executeFile/cleanupBackgrounded methods for isolated controller testing.

nodes.name: makeProject
nodes.summary: Test helper that creates a temp project directory containing a symlink pointing outside the project root, used to exercise execute_file's boundary-escape defenses.

nodes.name: applyIntent
nodes.summary: Applies intent-based progressive disclosure to an ExecResult's stdout, replacing large output with a trimmed intent summary plus a bounded tail when a matching intent query is supplied.

nodes.name: ExecutorController
nodes.summary: Singleton controller that owns the PolyglotExecutor instance and exposes execute, executeFile, and batchExecute orchestration methods for the corresponding MCP tools, applying enum validation and intent trimming around the underlying executor service.

nodes.name: matchesDenyPattern
nodes.summary: Tests whether a lowercased absolute path matches a secrets/credentials deny pattern, using substring matching for directory-style patterns and word-boundary-anchored matching for filename markers.

nodes.name: cleanupTmpDir
nodes.summary: Best-effort recursive removal of a sandbox temp directory that never throws, relying on OS temp-dir reclamation as a fallback.

nodes.name: killTree
nodes.summary: Kills an entire spawned process tree, using taskkill /T on Windows and a negative-PID SIGKILL to the process group on POSIX so orphaned children cannot outlive a killed parent.

nodes.name: buildSafeEnv
nodes.summary: Builds a child-process environment that strips known code-injection vectors (NODE_OPTIONS, LD_PRELOAD, shell startup files, etc.) from the inherited env before spawning user-supplied code.

nodes.name: PolyglotExecutor
nodes.summary: Spawns user-supplied code in a detected language runtime inside an isolated temp directory, enforcing timeouts with process-group kill, byte-capped output, OS-level sandbox wrapping, and — for executeFile — a realpath-based project-boundary and deny-glob guard against symlink escapes.

nodes.name: commandExists
nodes.summary: Cheap `command -v`/`where` probe reporting whether a binary is on PATH, without running a --version check.

nodes.name: runnableExists
nodes.summary: Combines commandExists and getVersion to determine whether a runtime is both present on PATH and actually invocable.

nodes.name: getVersion
nodes.summary: Runs a command's version flag (shell or execFileSync path, chosen for argument-escaping safety) and returns the first line of output, or a placeholder on failure.

nodes.name: detectRuntimes
nodes.summary: Probes the host for all 10 supported language runtimes (node/python/bash/ruby/go/rustc/php/perl/Rscript) and returns a RuntimeMap of resolved commands or null for each unavailable language.

nodes.name: getRuntimeSummary
nodes.summary: Formats a human-readable multi-line summary of each detected runtime's availability and version, used for diagnostics.

nodes.name: getAvailableLanguages
nodes.summary: Returns the subset of supported languages that have a detected runtime available on the host.

nodes.name: buildCommand
nodes.summary: Builds the per-language invocation command array for a given script file path, mapping each of the 10 supported languages to its interpreter/compiler invocation, including a special Rust compile-then-run marker.

nodes.name: isDockerAvailable
nodes.summary: Checks (with caching) whether the `docker` CLI is available, used to decide Linux sandbox mode.

nodes.name: isSeatbeltAvailable
nodes.summary: Checks (with caching) whether macOS `sandbox-exec` is available, used to decide seatbelt sandbox mode.

nodes.name: _resetSandboxAvailabilityCache
nodes.summary: Test seam that clears the cached docker/seatbelt availability flags so tests can simulate different host configurations.

nodes.name: getSandboxMode
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective sandbox mode (docker/seatbelt/none) from the MASSA_AI_EXECUTOR_SANDBOX env var, platform, and tool availability, throwing a teaching error when a forced sandbox is unavailable.

nodes.name: _buildSeatbeltProfile
nodes.summary: Builds a macOS seatbelt policy string that allows reads under the realpath-resolved project root and tmp dir, restricts writes to the tmp dir, and denies network access.

nodes.name: wrapSpawn
nodes.summary: Wraps a command array with the platform-specific sandbox launcher prefix — sandbox-exec for seatbelt, a locked-down `docker run` for Linux, or the command unchanged for none mode.

nodes.name: BatchExecuteTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler class defining the batch_execute schema (commands, concurrency, timeout, cwd) and delegating invocation to an injected run callback.

nodes.name: ExecuteTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler class defining the execute schema (language, code, timeout, background, cwd, intent) and delegating invocation to an injected run callback.

nodes.name: ExecuteFileTool
nodes.summary: MCP tool handler class defining the execute_file schema (path, language, code, timeout, intent) and delegating invocation to an injected run callback.

nodes.name: scheduler-catchup.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for Scheduler.catchUpMissedJobs, covering the missed-run skip policy after downtime and the success/failure split (lastSuccessAt/lastFailureAt/consecutiveFailures) bookkeeping on job fire.

nodes.name: scheduler-safe-defaults.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests verifying the MASSA_AI_SCHEDULER_SAFE_DEFAULTS preset applied inside registerDefaultJobs correctly bumps consolidation/decay intervals and enables those jobs while leaving auto-improve and observation-bridge untouched.

nodes.name: scheduler-store-pg.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests exercising PgScheduledJobStore against a real PostgreSQL database, covering hydration, mirror consistency across separate store instances, and write-mutation ordering.
nodes.languageNotes: Requires a live PostgreSQL connection (uses prisma.$executeRaw/$queryRaw directly) and is skipped when DATABASE_URL is not a postgres URL; not a pure in-memory unit test.

nodes.name: scheduler.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit-test suite for the Scheduler class and cron parser, covering handler registration, tick execution, the concurrency guard, missed-run skip policy, persistence across simulated restarts, lifecycle, status reporting, and the getScheduler/resetScheduler singleton.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public barrel for the scheduler module, re-exporting the Scheduler engine, its store implementation/factory, cron utilities, shared domain types, and default-job registration.

nodes.name: scheduler-cron.ts
nodes.summary: Standalone 5-field cron expression parser (parseCron) and next-run-time calculator (nextCronRun) used by the Scheduler to compute a job's next fire time without any external cron library.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements cron scheduling semantics (wildcards, steps, ranges, lists) from scratch using pure UTC date arithmetic.

nodes.name: scheduler-defaults.ts
nodes.summary: Wires the existing memory-consolidation, decay-sweep, auto-improve, and observation-bridge job implementations to the Scheduler as default-disabled, conservative-interval jobs, with handlers lazily dynamic-imported to avoid pulling heavy job-layer dependencies into the scheduler module.
nodes.languageNotes: Handlers are registered via dynamic import() inside registerDefaultJobs (targets packages/core/src/services/jobs/*.ts) to keep the scheduler module free of direct job-layer dependencies; MASSA_AI_SCHEDULER_SAFE_DEFAULTS applies a conservative-interval preset before the per-kind env overrides are read.

nodes.name: scheduler-store-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Factory that lazily constructs and caches the singleton PgScheduledJobStore, guarding against a missing PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL and matching the getJobStore()/getMemoryRepository() factory pattern used elsewhere in the codebase.

nodes.name: scheduler-store-pg.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed ScheduledJobStore implementation that serves synchronous reads from an in-memory mirror hydrated from PG on first use, and serializes per-job writes through a fire-and-forget async mutation queue using raw SQL via the shared Prisma client.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses raw $executeRaw/$queryRaw (not the Prisma query builder) to avoid a Prisma 7.7.0 + adapter-pg incompatibility, mirroring the same pattern used by PgJobStore and MemoryRepositoryPg elsewhere in the codebase.

nodes.name: scheduler-store.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the backend-neutral ScheduledJobStore interface — the synchronous persistence contract (save/get/listAll/listEnabled/delete) that any scheduler storage backend must implement.

nodes.name: scheduler-types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript types for the scheduler domain: JobKind, ScheduleSpec, ScheduledJob (the persisted row shape including the success/failure split fields), JobHandler, TickResult, and SchedulerStatus.

nodes.name: scheduler.ts
nodes.summary: Core in-process Scheduler engine: a clock-driven tick loop that fires registered job handlers by jobKind on their cron/interval schedule, with a concurrency guard and cap, a missed-run skip-and-reschedule catch-up policy, and a module-level getScheduler()/resetScheduler() singleton.
nodes.languageNotes: Handlers are registered separately from job definitions (JobKind to JobHandler registry) so the scheduler never depends directly on job implementations; the tick timer is .unref()'d so it never keeps the process alive solely for scheduling.

nodes.name: makeInMemoryStore
nodes.summary: Test fixture building an in-memory Map-backed ScheduledJobStore stand-in used across the catch-up test suite.

nodes.name: makeJob
nodes.summary: Test factory producing a default ScheduledJob fixture with override support for individual catch-up test scenarios.

nodes.name: makeInMemoryStore
nodes.summary: Test fixture building an in-memory Map-backed ScheduledJobStore stand-in used by the safe-defaults preset test suite.

nodes.name: job
nodes.summary: Test factory building a ScheduledJob fixture with a UUID-derived, test-prefixed id for PgScheduledJobStore integration tests, with override support.

nodes.name: makeInMemoryStore
nodes.summary: Test fixture building an in-memory Map-backed ScheduledJobStore stand-in used throughout the main Scheduler unit-test suite.

nodes.name: makeJob
nodes.summary: Test factory producing a default ScheduledJob fixture with override support for individual test scenarios.

nodes.name: parseField
nodes.summary: Parses one cron field (minute/hour/day/month/weekday) supporting wildcards, steps (*/n), ranges (a-b), and comma-separated lists into a sorted array of valid values within [min, max].

nodes.name: parseCron
nodes.summary: Parses a standard 5-field cron expression string into a ParsedCron structure by delegating each field to parseField, normalizing day-of-week 7 to 0 (Sunday).

nodes.name: nextCronRun
nodes.summary: Computes the next UTC timestamp at or after a given time that satisfies a ParsedCron schedule, incrementally advancing month, day, hour, and minute until all field constraints match.

nodes.name: applySafeDefaults
nodes.summary: Applies the MASSA_AI_SCHEDULER_SAFE_DEFAULTS preset to a single default job definition, enabling consolidation and decay jobs at conservative minimum intervals (>=30min / >=60min) while leaving auto-improve and observation-bridge untouched.

nodes.name: registerDefaultJobs
nodes.summary: Boot-time wiring function that registers handlers for the four existing job kinds (memory-consolidation, decay-sweep, auto-improve, observation-bridge) on a Scheduler instance and upserts their default-disabled job definitions, applying the safe-defaults preset and per-kind env overrides.

nodes.name: getScheduledJobStore
nodes.summary: Returns the cached singleton ScheduledJobStore, constructing a PgScheduledJobStore on first call after verifying a PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL is configured.

nodes.name: resetScheduledJobStore
nodes.summary: Clears the cached ScheduledJobStore singleton, forcing the next getScheduledJobStore() call to reconstruct it; used by tests.

nodes.name: rowToJob
nodes.summary: Maps a raw scheduled_jobs SQL row (with bigint-friendly columns) into the domain ScheduledJob shape, JSON-parsing the payload and reconstructing the interval/cron ScheduleSpec.

nodes.name: PgScheduledJobStore
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL-backed ScheduledJobStore implementation that hydrates an in-memory mirror from PG on first access, serves all reads synchronously from that mirror, and serializes writes per job ID through a fire-and-forget async mutation queue against the scheduled_jobs table.

nodes.name: getScheduler
nodes.summary: Returns the module-level cached Scheduler singleton, constructing it with default options on first call.

nodes.name: resetScheduler
nodes.summary: Stops and clears the cached Scheduler singleton and resets the underlying ScheduledJobStore singleton; used by tests to get a clean scheduler between cases.

nodes.name: Scheduler
nodes.summary: In-process clock-driven job scheduler: maintains a jobKind-to-handler registry, ticks on a setInterval to fire enabled jobs whose nextRunAt has passed, enforces a concurrency guard and cap, and provides a missed-run catch-up policy (skip-and-reschedule) plus status/lifecycle methods.

nodes.name: chunker-coverage.test.ts
nodes.summary: Targeted unit tests covering edge cases in the chunker submodules — chunkJSON, chunkYAML, chunkCode, and the shared post-processing/fixed chunker — that the broader smart-chunker dispatch tests don't reach, such as malformed JSON, oversized chunks, and code-boundary detection quirks.

nodes.name: smart-chunker.characterization.test.ts
nodes.summary: Byte-identical characterization tests that pin exact Chunk[] output (content, line ranges, labels) per format for smartChunk, acting as a strict mutation-killer safety net around the chunker module split.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately kept alongside the coarser smart-chunker.test.ts by design — the file's own docstring documents that both must be updated intentionally whenever chunking behavior changes.

nodes.name: smart-chunker.test.ts
nodes.summary: Coarser-grained characterization tests for smartChunk covering markdown, JSON, YAML, and code chunking behavior (label presence, chunk type, merge behavior) as a broad smoke test alongside the stricter byte-identical suite.

nodes.name: intent-search.ts
nodes.summary: Self-contained intent-driven progressive disclosure for execute/execute_file output — chunks large command output via smartChunk, builds an in-memory TF keyword index with title-boost scoring, and returns only sections matching the caller's intent plus distinctive vocabulary hints, avoiding the persistent FTS/PG index entirely.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a lightweight, ephemeral TF + title-boost ranking (not full TF-IDF) purely in memory, deliberately avoiding the persistent FTS/PG-backed search stack so it can never OOM the shared index or trigger a full-repo reindex.

nodes.name: chunker-code.ts
nodes.summary: Structural code chunker that detects top-level and method-level declaration boundaries via regex and brace-depth tracking across many languages (class/interface/function/struct/impl/etc.), and extracts leading import statements for chunk metadata.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a single regex set (CONTAINER_RE, TOP_LEVEL_RE, METHOD_RE) applied line-by-line to approximate an AST-free, multi-language boundary detector spanning C-family, Python, Rust, and Go-style declarations, with a container stack tracking brace depth to distinguish top-level from nested code.

nodes.name: chunker-json-yaml.ts
nodes.summary: Format-aware chunkers for JSON (splits top-level object keys, falls back to fixed-size chunking for arrays/invalid JSON) and YAML (splits by document separators and top-level keys).

nodes.name: chunker-markdown.ts
nodes.summary: Markdown chunker that splits content by heading hierarchy, building a breadcrumb-style label chain per section, or falls back to fixed-size chunking when no headings are present.

nodes.name: chunker-post.ts
nodes.summary: Shared post-processing pass for all chunkers — merges undersized chunks into neighbors, splits oversized chunks by line/char budget, and provides the fixed-size fallback chunker used when no format-specific strategy applies.

nodes.name: chunker-types.ts
